# Next release: 0.1.129

**Released 2026-10-16:** 0.1.128 (build 132, tag `v0.1.128`) is the latest release; record `docs/validation/Bello-Agent-0.1.128-2026-10-16.md`.

## 0.1.129

- [x] Cost limit pauses the whole family at once and only Resume continues it (owner, 2026-10-16): in-flight requests and tools are cancelled like Stop, unsealed sub-agent turns are parked (queued, never not_executed), the pause survives relaunch and helper restart, raising the limit resumes nothing, and Resume (refused at the limit) continues the chat, its sub-agents and every paused side. Sides can no longer start or message sub-agents; offered tools unchanged. Branch `dev/a129-limit-pause`. [Validation](docs/validation/limit-pause-0.1.129.md).

## 0.1.126 decisions made while the owner was away (2026-10-13 night)

- RL-04 (capture lost at graceful shutdown): fixed with a bounded drain. The helper keeps delivering, and the app keeps acknowledging, queued capture packets until the outbox is empty or the existing shutdown deadline arrives. A drain cut short is marked partial. A durable spool-and-replay design was built and dropped: two review rounds found data-boundary bugs in it, including cleared chats' bodies surviving on disk.
- SCROLL-11 (measuring every line of an expanded long diff before first paint): not fixed. Deferring the measurement produced reading-position edge cases in five review rounds, so it was reverted to the synchronous measurement. The cost is one-time per expansion; it is left as a known item.
- UI-05 (send during image paste): Send waits while an image is importing. The button is disabled and a notice says "Adding image…". This replaces a deferred auto-send, which kept producing races in review (navigation, eviction, draft reload, deletion).

# Completed release: 0.1.120

**Released, 2026-10-06:** 0.1.120 (build 124, tag `v0.1.120`) is the latest release. The complete AppKit migration is shipped. Source/tag and website changes are pushed; the public page, identical update feeds and downloaded DMG hash/signature pass verification at 01:07:03 UTC. See `docs/validation/Bello-Agent-0.1.120-2026-10-06.md` for evidence and the explicit manual/measurement limits. `docs/HANDOVER-0.1.120.md` preserves the original implementation snapshot.

**Scope (owner, 2026-10-04): no SwiftUI.** Every view, window and the app itself move to AppKit, for predictable layout and real performance across the board. The look stays pixel-identical (screenshot gallery before/after) apart from run-to-run data. Behaviour, keyboard, focus and accessibility stay the same or better. **One release at the end**, when no file imports SwiftUI, the gate passes and the hour soak is clean.

**All work goes on `dev/next`.** Workstream branches (`dev/appkit-*`) are merged here by the integrator. `main` holds released versions only — never push to `main` outside a release.

## How work is done
- Parallel workstream agents, each in its own worktree, build folder and Codex session (gpt-6.1-sol, xhigh, read-only) that plans every step and reviews every diff before commit.
- Port, don't redesign: same layout, spacing, colours, motion, copy and behaviour. Compare gallery captures before and after (`scripts/compare-captures.py`); differences must be run-to-run data only.
- Performance discipline: reuse views, draw only what is visible, never relayout what didn't change, no work per token across the window. Measure against the baseline below.
- Existing tests keep passing; tests that read SwiftUI structure are rewritten to read AppKit/accessibility instead, never deleted without an equivalent.
- Checks: `scripts/check-next.sh` (build, `test <Class>…`, `helper`, `gate`). Serial-lane classes run alone.

## Rules for code on this branch
- AppKit only for new code. A file stops importing SwiftUI when its port is done.
- Keep the app's Pi look; no stock-looking controls.
- Keep `packages/bello-views` free of app types; macOS 13. App target macOS 14.
- Motion policy unchanged. Accessibility (A1) must not regress: native AppKit accessibility roles, labels, values and selected states.
- Tick items here in the commit that finishes them.

--- guidance ---
# Repository workflow

- After completing requested repository changes, commit them and push to the
  configured GitHub upstream. This is the owner's standing instruction as of
  2026-09-26; a separate request to push is not needed.
- For releases, also push the relevant release tag and any final validation-record
  commit. Follow `docs/Release.md` for packaging and website publication.
- Preserve unrelated work and existing release commit identities. Do not force-push
  or rewrite published history unless explicitly requested.
- A later request to keep work local or read-only takes precedence.

# Next release

- All work for the next release goes on the branch `dev/next`. Read
  `NEXT-RELEASE.md` first: it lists the state, what is left, and the rules.
- An agent that cannot run code commits and pushes to `dev/next` and says what
  to check; the owner's Mac runs `scripts/check-next.sh` to pull, build and test.

 # Sub-agents in Bello Agent — Design v2
 
+## 0.1.129 owner decisions, 2026-10-16
+
+These supersede the limit-stop and side-delegation text further down.
+
+**The cost limit pauses the family at once, and only Resume continues it.**
+When the shared budget is reached by any charge source (main, side, nested
+side, sub-agent or side-owned sub-agent), every in-flight provider request,
+retry wait and running tool in the family is cancelled the way Stop cancels it.
+Nothing new starts. Aborted requests keep what they reported; unknown cost stays
+unknown. Work that was under way becomes a durable **Paused at the cost limit**
+state (`costPaused` in the run state, `cost.paused` and `costPaused` in
+snapshots), which survives quit, relaunch and a helper restart. Unsealed
+sub-agent turns are *parked*, not sealed: running and queued turns are saved as
+`queued` with no result, keep their acceptance order and their undelivered
+parent messages, and their runtimes are released. Raising the limit resumes
+nothing. While the spend is still at the limit, Resume is refused with the reason
+shown. After a raise, Resume (`run.continue`) on the root resumes its own run and
+parked turns and returns the sides that paused (`pausedMembers`); the app resumes
+each of them the same way. A resumed turn continues under the parent's new
+execution (`AgentChildTurn.continuations`, one appended per Resume and ignored by
+older helpers); one whose task was delivered continues from its own context
+without being sent the task again, and one that had already answered is sealed
+with that answer. A message sent while paused waits for Resume. See
+`docs/validation/limit-pause-0.1.129.md` for the state machine.
+
+**Sides never start or message sub-agents.** At any depth a side refuses
+`subagent_start`, `subagent_send` and v2 `subagent` with `read_only` before any
+acceptance, pointing to the main chat. Its offered tools stay byte-identical to
+its parent's for the prompt cache. Waiting on, reading and stopping children that
+a 0.1.128 side already owns remain available; their history is unchanged.
+

import XCTest
@testable import PiAgentCore

/// The shared cost limit pauses the whole family at once and resumes only on
/// Resume (owner, 2026-10-16). Replaces 0.1.128's drain-then-block table.
final class FamilyLimitPauseTests: XCTestCase {
    enum Phase: String, CaseIterable { case idle, ownRequest, childrenDispatched, sideRequest, preLedgerRequest, tools }
    enum Crosser: String, CaseIterable { case own, backgroundChild, waitedChild, nestedSide, sideChild }

    /// Every phase × charge source: the crossing settlement cancels every
    /// other dispatched request at once (no drain), with one Stop, and those
    /// requests can still record what they reported; unknown stays unknown.
    func testEveryPhaseAndChargeSourceAbortsInFlightWorkAtOnce() async throws {
        for phase in Phase.allCases { for crosser in Crosser.allCases {
            let label = "\(phase)/\(crosser)", root = try temporaryDirectory()
            defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
            let owner = try familyFixture(root:root)
            await owner.enableFamilyBudget(); await owner.beginPresentedTask("turn"); await owner.setCostLimit(0.5)
            let side = try await self.side("side",parent:owner,root:root)
            let nested = try await self.side("nested",parent:side,root:root)
            let child = try await self.child("child",parent:owner,root:root)
            let sideChild = try await self.child("side-child",parent:side,root:root)
            let source: AgentSession
            switch crosser {
            case .own: source = owner
            case .backgroundChild, .waitedChild: source = child
            case .nestedSide: source = nested
            case .sideChild: source = sideChild
            }
            let crossing = try await start(source,"crossing")
            var held: (RequestLifecycle,RequestPermit)?
            switch phase {
            case .ownRequest: held = try await start(owner,"held")
            case .childrenDispatched: held = try await start(child,"held")
            case .sideRequest: held = try await start(nested,"held")
            default: break
            }
            await owner.limitFixturePhase(model:phase == .ownRequest || phase == .preLedgerRequest,
                tools:phase == .tools || crosser == .waitedChild)
            try await finish(crossing.0,"crossing",cost:0.6)
            // No drain fence: the Stop is issued by the crossing settlement.
            let stopped = await owner.stopCount
            XCTAssertEqual(stopped,1,"\(label): the family stops at once")
            if let held {
                // A side's request is cancelled by its own pause, delivered
                // from the root without waiting for anything to settle.
                try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(2)) { (try? held.1.check()) == nil }
                // An aborted request still records what it reported.
                let reported = phase != .childrenDispatched
                try await finish(held.0,"held",cost:reported ? 0.1 : nil)
            }
            await owner.stopFamilyAtLimit()
            let again = await owner.stopCount, spend = await owner.spend
            XCTAssertEqual(again,1,"\(label): one Stop per exhaustion")
            XCTAssertEqual(spend.usd,held == nil || phase == .childrenDispatched ? 0.6 : 0.7,accuracy:1e-9,label)
            XCTAssertEqual(spend.unreported,phase == .childrenDispatched ? 1 : 0,"\(label): unknown cost stays unknown")
            do { _ = try await crossing.0.admitAttempt("denied"); XCTFail("\(label): admitted past the limit") }
            catch { XCTAssertEqual((error as? AgentError)?.code,"cost_limit",label) }
            await sideChild.close(); await child.close(); await nested.close(); await side.close(); await owner.close()
        } }
    }

    /// Sixteen dispatched and two queued children, crossed by every source:
    /// the dispatched requests are cancelled at once, all 18 turns stay
    /// queued (never not_executed), runtimes are released, and Resume runs
    /// each from where it stopped under the resumed execution.
    func testQueuedAndRunningChildrenParkForEveryChargeSourceAndResumeInPlace() async throws {
        for crosser in Crosser.allCases {
            let label = "\(crosser)", root = try temporaryDirectory()
            defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
            let client = LimitRunClient(mode:"queued"), runtimes = LimitChildRuntimes()
            let coordinator = AgentSteeringCoordinator(open:{ try await runtimes.open($0,$1) },settled:{ await runtimes.settle($0) })
            let owner = try AgentSession(id:"parent",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,
                readOnly:true,resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore())
            await owner.enableFamilyBudget(); await owner.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await owner.enableAgentSteering(coordinator)

            XCTAssertEqual(idle,16,"\(label): raising the limit starts nothing"); XCTAssertTrue(stillPaused,label)

            _ = await owner.endCostPause()

            await client.releaseAll()
            try await coordinator.resumeParked(owner:owner)
            try await eventually { await coordinator.jobs.isEmpty }
            let resumed = await owner.agentState(), dispatched = await client.children
            XCTAssertTrue(resumed.turns.values.allSatisfy { $0.status == .completed },label)
            XCTAssertTrue(resumed.turns.values.allSatisfy { $0.continuations?.count == 1 && $0.currentParentExecutionID == execution },label)
            XCTAssertEqual(dispatched.count,34,"\(label): 16 resumed and 2 first runs, nothing replayed twice")
            for id in accepted {
                let opened = await runtimes.opened[id], reopened = try XCTUnwrap(opened)
                let mirror = await reopened.agentState().turns[AgentTurnTarget(childID:id,turn:1).id]
                XCTAssertEqual(mirror,resumed.turns[AgentTurnTarget(childID:id,turn:1).id],"\(label): child and owner agree")
                let users = await reopened.history.filter { $0.role == "user" }.count
                XCTAssertEqual(users,1,"\(label): a resumed task is not sent again")
            }
            await runtimes.close(); await sideChild.close(); await child.close(); await nested.close(); await side.close(); await owner.close()
        }
    }

    /// A real parent run in every delegation shape: the crossing aborts the
    /// other child requests and the parent at once, executes no tool, keeps
    /// the family paused, and Resume finishes everything once raised.
    func testRealRunPausesTheFamilyAndResumesItAfterTheLimitIsRaised() async throws {
        for mode in ["background","wait","tool-reply","queued"] {
            let root = try temporaryDirectory(); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
            let client = LimitRunClient(mode:mode), coordinator = AgentSteeringCoordinator(), tools = RecordingTools()
            let parent = try AgentSession(id:"parent",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
                resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:tools,traces:TraceStore())
            await parent.enableFamilyBudget(); await parent.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await parent.enableAgentSteering(coordinator)
            await parent.setCostLimit(0.5)
            _ = try await parent.submit(Submission(commandID:"command",turnID:"turn",text:"Two workers"),steer:false)
            let expected = mode == "queued" ? 16 : 2
            try await eventually { await client.children.count == expected }
            if mode == "queued" || mode == "tool-reply" { try await eventually { await client.parentCount == 2 } }
            await client.releaseFirst()
            try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(3)) { !(await parent.isRunning) }
            try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(3)) { await coordinator.jobs.isEmpty }
            let state = await parent.state, code = await parent.errorCode, paused = await parent.costPaused
            let cancelled = await client.cancelled, calls = await tools.calls, family = await parent.agentState()
            XCTAssertEqual(state,.paused,mode); XCTAssertEqual(code,"cost_limit",mode); XCTAssertTrue(paused,mode)
            XCTAssertEqual(cancelled.count,expected - 1,"\(mode): other dispatched children are cancelled without release")
            XCTAssertTrue(calls.isEmpty,"\(mode): no tool runs once the family is paused")
            XCTAssertFalse(family.turns.values.contains { $0.status == .notExecuted || $0.status == .interrupted },mode)
            let snapshot = await parent.snapshot()
            XCTAssertEqual(snapshot["costPaused"].flag,true,mode); XCTAssertEqual(snapshot["cost"]["paused"].flag,true,mode)
            XCTAssertEqual(snapshot["continuable"].flag,true,mode)
            // A message sent after raising waits for Resume.
            await parent.setCostLimit(20)
            let sent = try await parent.submit(Submission(commandID:"later",turnID:"later",text:"Afterwards"),steer:false)
            XCTAssertEqual(sent["delivery"].text,"after-resume",mode)
            let running = await parent.isRunning; XCTAssertFalse(running,"\(mode): raising or sending resumes nothing")
            await client.releaseAll()
            try await parent.requireCostResumeRoom()
            let reply = try await parent.continueRun(commandID:"resume")
            XCTAssertEqual(reply["resumedFamily"].flag,true,mode)
            try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(10)) { let busy = await parent.isRunning, jobs = await coordinator.jobs.isEmpty; return !busy && jobs }
            let final = await parent.agentState(), finalState = await parent.state, after = await parent.costPaused
            XCTAssertTrue(final.turns.values.allSatisfy { $0.status == .completed },"\(mode): \(final.turns.values.map(\.status))")
            XCTAssertEqual(finalState,.idle,mode); XCTAssertFalse(after,mode)
            let users = await parent.history.filter { $0.role == "user" }.map(\.text)
            XCTAssertEqual(users.last,"Afterwards","\(mode): the waiting message goes after the resumed run")
            await coordinator.drain(); await parent.close()
        }
    }

    /// Quit or helper restart while paused, and a crash before the pause
    /// parked its turns: reopening keeps the pause and the queued turns;
    /// nothing runs until Resume, which completes the family.
    func testPauseSurvivesReopenAndACrashBeforeParkingThenResumes() async throws {
        for crashed in [false, true] {
            let label = crashed ? "crash" : "reopen", root = try temporaryDirectory()
            defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
            let client = LimitRunClient(mode:"background"), coordinator = AgentSteeringCoordinator()
            let parent = try AgentSession(id:"parent",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
                resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore())
            await parent.enableFamilyBudget(); await parent.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await parent.enableAgentSteering(coordinator)
            await parent.setCostLimit(0.5)
            _ = try await parent.submit(Submission(commandID:"command",turnID:"turn",text:"Two workers"),steer:false)
            try await eventually { await client.children.count == 2 }
            await client.releaseFirst()
            try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(3)) { let busy = await parent.isRunning, jobs = await coordinator.jobs.isEmpty; return !busy && jobs }
            let saved = await parent.path, path = try XCTUnwrap(saved)
            var parked = await parent.agentState().turns.values.filter { !$0.status.terminal }
            XCTAssertFalse(parked.isEmpty,label)
            await parent.close()
            if crashed {
                // The helper died after the pause was saved but before its
                // turns were parked: they still read as running.
                let journal = try SessionJournal(url:URL(fileURLWithPath:path),id:"parent",cwd:root,binding:nil,create:false)
                for var turn in parked { turn.status = .running
                    try journal.append(["type":"custom","customType":JSON(JournalRecordKind.agentTurnState),"ownerID":"parent","data":try subagentJSON(turn)],flush:true) }
            }
            let reopenedCoordinator = AgentSteeringCoordinator()
            let reopened = try AgentSession(id:"parent",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
                resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore(),resumePath:path)
            await reopened.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await reopened.enableAgentSteering(reopenedCoordinator)
            await reopened.setCostLimit(0.5)
            let state = await reopened.state, code = await reopened.errorCode, paused = await reopened.costPaused
            XCTAssertEqual(state,.paused,label); XCTAssertEqual(code,"cost_limit",label); XCTAssertTrue(paused,label)
            parked = await reopened.agentState().turns.values.filter { !$0.status.terminal }
            XCTAssertFalse(parked.isEmpty,label)
            XCTAssertTrue(parked.allSatisfy { $0.status == .queued },"\(label): reopening holds the turns, never interrupts them")
            for turn in parked {
                let child = try AgentSession(id:turn.childID,profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
                    resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:DisabledTools(),traces:TraceStore(),resumePath:root.appendingPathComponent(turn.childID + ".jsonl").path)
                let mirror = await child.agentState().turns[turn.id]
                XCTAssertEqual(mirror?.status,.queued,"\(label): the child mirror agrees"); await child.close()
            }
            do { try await reopened.requireCostResumeRoom(); XCTFail("\(label): resumed at the limit") }
            catch { XCTAssertEqual((error as? AgentError)?.code,"cost_limit",label) }
            await reopened.setCostLimit(20); await client.releaseAll()
            try await reopened.requireCostResumeRoom()
            _ = try await reopened.continueRun(commandID:"resume")
            try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(10)) { let busy = await reopened.isRunning, jobs = await reopenedCoordinator.jobs.isEmpty; return !busy && jobs }
            let final = await reopened.agentState()
            XCTAssertTrue(final.turns.values.allSatisfy { $0.status == .completed },"\(label): \(final.turns.values.map(\.status))")
            await reopenedCoordinator.drain(); await reopened.close()
        }
    }

    /// Sides and nested sides with running tools stop at once when another
    /// member crosses. Each paused side registers with the root, whose
    /// Resume names them; each side resumes only below the root's limit.
    func testSidesPauseImmediatelyAndTheRootsResumeNamesThem() async throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory(); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
        let owner = try familyFixture(root:root), tools = LimitHeldTools()
        await owner.setCostLimit(0.5)
        let side = try await side("side",parent:owner,root:root)
        let nested = try await self.side("nested",parent:side,root:root,client:LimitRunClient(mode:"side-tool"),tools:tools)
        _ = try await nested.submit(Submission(commandID:"command",turnID:"turn",text:"Work"),steer:false)
        try await eventually { await tools.started }
        let held = try await start(owner,"held"), crossing = try await start(side,"crossing")
        try await finish(crossing.0,"crossing",cost:0.6)
        // No request has to settle first: the root's dispatched request and
        // the nested side's tool are both cancelled.
        XCTAssertThrowsError(try held.1.check())
        try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(2)) { !(await nested.isRunning) }
        let cancelled = await tools.cancelled, code = await nested.errorCode, state = await nested.state, paused = await nested.costPaused
        XCTAssertTrue(cancelled); XCTAssertEqual(code,"cost_limit"); XCTAssertEqual(state,.paused); XCTAssertTrue(paused)
        try await eventually { await owner.costPausedMembers == ["nested"] }
        let rootPaused = await owner.costPaused, sidePaused = await side.costPaused
        XCTAssertTrue(rootPaused,"The root shows the family's pause"); XCTAssertFalse(sidePaused,"An idle side has nothing to resume")
        do { try await nested.requireCostResumeRoom(); XCTFail("A side resumed at the root's limit") }
        catch { XCTAssertEqual((error as? AgentError)?.code,"cost_limit") }
        await owner.setCostLimit(20)
        let stillPaused = await nested.costPaused, running = await nested.isRunning
        XCTAssertTrue(stillPaused); XCTAssertFalse(running)
        try await owner.requireCostResumeRoom()
        let reply = try await owner.continueRun(commandID:"resume-root")
        XCTAssertEqual(reply["pausedMembers"].list.compactMap(\.text),["nested"])
        XCTAssertEqual(reply["continued"].flag,false)
        try await nested.requireCostResumeRoom()
        let resumed = try await nested.continueRun(commandID:"resume-nested")
        XCTAssertEqual(resumed["continued"].flag,true)
        try await eventually { await tools.starts == 2 }
        let after = await nested.costPaused, members = await owner.costPausedMembers
        XCTAssertFalse(after); XCTAssertTrue(members.isEmpty)
        await nested.stop()
        try await finish(held.0,"held",cost:0.1)
        await nested.close(); await side.close(); await owner.close()
    }

    /// Lowering the limit below the spend pauses work in flight; raising it
    /// again changes nothing until Resume. Repeated readings stop once.
    func testLoweringTheLimitPausesAndRaisingItResumesNothing() async throws {

    }

    /// A child that reaches its final boundary as the pause lands is not
    /// sealed (Stop would read as interrupted): its turn waits for Resume.
    func testChildFinalBoundaryDuringThePauseDefersItsSeal() async throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory(); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
        let coordinator = AgentSteeringCoordinator()
        let owner = try AgentSession(id:"parent",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,
            readOnly:true,resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:LimitRunClient(mode:"queued"),tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore())
        await owner.enableFamilyBudget(); await owner.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await owner.enableAgentSteering(coordinator)
        let call = ToolCall(id:"start",name:"subagent_start",arguments:["task":"Worker","mode":"background"])
        let key = try await owner.agentFixtureCall(call,newTask:true)
        // Paused before the turn gets a slot: it stays queued with its
        // prepared child, which then reaches a final boundary.
        await coordinator.fixturePause("parent")
        let receipt = try await coordinator.prepare(call,key:key,parent:owner)
        let id = try XCTUnwrap(receipt["child_id"].text), target = AgentTurnTarget(childID:id,turn:1)
        let job = await coordinator.jobs[target.id], child = try XCTUnwrap(job?.child)
        await child.stop()
        do { _ = try await coordinator.boundary(child,final:true); XCTFail("A paused family's child sealed its turn") }
        catch { XCTAssertTrue(error is CancellationError) }
        let turn = await owner.agentState().turns[target.id]
        XCTAssertEqual(turn?.status,.queued); XCTAssertNil(turn?.result)
        await child.close(); await owner.close()
    }

    /// Retry backoff is not a request in flight: the pause cuts it short.
    func testRetryBackoffIsCutShortByThePause() async throws {
        let root = try temporaryDirectory(); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
        let owner = try familyFixture(root:root,client:LimitRunClient(mode:"retry"))

        _ = try await owner.submit(Submission(commandID:"command",turnID:"turn",text:"Retry"),steer:false)

    private func side(_ id: String, parent: AgentSession, root: URL, client: any ModelClient = ScriptClient([]), tools: any ToolExecuting = DisabledTools()) async throws -> AgentSession {
        let seed = await parent.sideSeed()
        let side = try AgentSession(id:id,profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
            resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:tools,traces:TraceStore(),seed:seed.messages,parent:seed.info)
        try await side.bindSideBudget(to:parent); await side.beginPresentedTask("turn")
        return side
    }
    private func child(_ id: String, parent: AgentSession, root: URL) async throws -> AgentSession {
        var origin = subagentFixtureOrigin()
        let parentID = await parent.id
        origin.link.childSessionID = id; origin.link.budgetOwnerSessionID = parentID
        origin.link.call.parentSessionID = parentID
        origin.link.parentExecutionID = await parent.activeTaskPresentation!.executionID
        try await parent.installAdmissionFixturePlan(SubagentPlan(origin:origin,task:"Task",resultMessageID:"result-\(id)"))
        let child = try AgentSession(id:id,profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
            resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:ScriptClient([]),tools:DisabledTools(),traces:TraceStore(),prepared:nil,subagentOrigin:origin)
        try await child.bindBudgetOwner(parent,generation:0)
        return child
    }
    private func start(_ session: AgentSession, _ attempt: String) async throws -> (RequestLifecycle,RequestPermit) {
        let value = try await session.requestLifecycle(turnID:"turn",purpose:"turn"), hooks = try XCTUnwrap(value)
        let permit = try await hooks.admitAttempt(attempt); try await hooks.willDispatch(attempt)
        return (hooks,permit)
    }
    private func finish(_ hooks: RequestLifecycle, _ attempt: String, cost: Double?) async throws {
        let observation = billingObservation(profile:try fixtureProfile(),session:hooks.scope.sourceSessionID,attempt:attempt,cost:cost)
        try await hooks.settleAttempt(.init(scope:hooks.scope,observation:observation,dispatched:true))
    }
}

private extension AgentSteeringCoordinator {
    func fixturePause(_ owner: String) { paused.insert(owner) }
}

private extension AgentSession {
    func limitFixturePhase(model: Bool, tools: Bool) { modelActive = model; runStatus = tools ? .waitingTool : .running }
    /// What a Resume's run establishes before it resumes parked turns.
    func beginResumeFixture() { queuePaused = false; beginPresentedTask(UUID().uuidString) }
}

/// Uses the same unload guard as HostService's open/release callbacks rather
/// than closing every child unconditionally, which would hide a pinned runtime.
private actor LimitChildRuntimes {
    var opened: [String:AgentSession] = [:]
    var settled: [String] = []
    var released: Set<String> = []
    func open(_ environment: SubagentEnvironment, _ plan: SubagentPlan) async throws -> AgentSession {
        let id = plan.origin.link.childSessionID
        if let previous = opened[id], !(await previous.unloadIfIdle()) {
            throw AgentError("session_busy","Child is still settling")
        }
        let child = try AgentSteeringCoordinator.makeChild(environment,plan)
        opened[id] = child; return child
    }
    func settle(_ child: AgentSession) async {
        guard let turn = await child.agentLease else { return }
        settled.append(turn.id)
        if await child.unloadIfIdle() { released.insert(turn.childID) }
    }
    func close() async { for child in opened.values { await child.close() } }
}

/// Children hold their requests until released. A cancelled child request
/// settles as unreported (its usage unknown) and is listed in `cancelled`.
/// A child's first request after `releaseFirst` costs $0.60; others $0.20.
private actor LimitRunClient: ModelClient {
    let mode: String
    var parentCount = 0, children: [String] = [], cancelled: [String] = []
    var firstReleased = false, allReleased = false, firstSettled = false, firstTaken = false
    init(mode: String) { self.mode = mode }
    private func observation(_ profile: Profile, _ session: String, _ turn: String, _ attempt: String, cost: Double?) -> RequestObservation {
        var observation = RequestObservation(sessionID:session,turnID:turn,attemptID:attempt,purpose:"turn",fingerprint:"fixture",profile:profile)
        observation.monitoring = ["outcome":"completed","gateway":["cost":["status":JSON(cost == nil ? "unreported" : "reported"),"usd":cost.map { JSON($0) } ?? .null]]]
        return observation
    }
    func releaseFirst() { firstReleased = true }
    func releaseAll() { allReleased = true }
    func complete(profile:Profile,apiKey:String,messages:[ChatMessage],instructions:String,tools:[ToolDefinition],sessionID:String,turnID:String,purpose:String,onDelta:@escaping @Sendable(StreamDelta) async throws -> Void) async throws -> ModelReply {
        throw AgentError("fixture_unscoped","Expected admission")
    }
    func complete(profile:Profile,apiKey:String,messages:[ChatMessage],instructions:String,tools:[ToolDefinition],sessionID:String,cacheSessionID:String,turnID:String,purpose:String,lifecycle:RequestLifecycle?,onObservation:@escaping @Sendable(RequestObservation) async -> Void,onDelta:@escaping @Sendable(StreamDelta) async throws -> Void) async throws -> ModelReply {
        let hooks = try XCTUnwrap(lifecycle), attempt = UUID().uuidString
        let permit = try await hooks.admitAttempt(attempt); defer { permit.finish() }
        try await hooks.willDispatch(attempt)
        var reply = answer("Finished"), cost = 0.01
        if mode == "side-tool" { reply = toolReply(["first"]) }
        else if sessionID == "parent" {
            parentCount += 1
            if parentCount == 1 {
                reply = ModelReply(message:ChatMessage(role:"assistant",content:[]))
                for n in 0..<(mode == "queued" ? 18 : 2) {
                    let start = agentCallReply("start-\(n)","subagent_start",["task":JSON("Worker \(n)"),"mode":JSON(mode == "wait" && n == 1 ? "wait" : "background")])
                    reply.calls += start.calls; reply.message.content += start.message.content
                }
            }
            else if mode == "tool-reply" && parentCount == 2 {
                do { while !firstSettled { try permit.check(); try await Task.sleep(for:.milliseconds(2)) } }
                catch {
                    let final = observation(profile,sessionID,turnID,attempt,cost:nil)
                    try await hooks.settleAttempt(.init(scope:hooks.scope,observation:final,dispatched:true)); throw error
                }
                reply = toolReply(["first"])
            }
        } else {
            children.append(sessionID)
            do {
                while !(allReleased || (firstReleased && !firstTaken)) { try permit.check(); try await Task.sleep(for:.milliseconds(2)) }
                try permit.check(); try Task.checkCancellation()
            } catch {
                cancelled.append(sessionID)
                let final = observation(profile,sessionID,turnID,attempt,cost:nil)
                try await hooks.settleAttempt(.init(scope:hooks.scope,observation:final,dispatched:true))
                throw error
            }
            let first = !firstTaken && !allReleased
            if first { firstTaken = true }
            cost = first ? 0.6 : 0.2
        }
        let observation = observation(profile,sessionID,turnID,attempt,cost:cost)
        try await hooks.settleAttempt(.init(scope:hooks.scope,observation:observation,dispatched:true))
        if cost == 0.6 { firstSettled = true }
        await onObservation(observation); reply.message.requestAttemptIDs = [attempt]
        if mode == "retry" { throw AgentError("provider_http","HTTP 503 server unavailable",attemptID:attempt) }
        return reply
    }
}

private actor LimitHeldTools: ToolExecuting {
    var started = false, cancelled = false
    var starts = 0, cancellations = 0
    func definitions(readOnly:Bool) -> [ToolDefinition] { [ToolDefinition("first","Held fixture tool",[:])] }
    func invoke(_ call:ToolCall,readOnly:Bool) async throws -> JSON {
        started = true; starts += 1
        do { while true { try await Task.sleep(for:.milliseconds(2)) } }
        catch { cancelled = true; cancellations += 1; throw error }
    }
}

import Foundation

// Resume: the run a Stop, a quit, a restart or an update cut off goes on
// from the chat's history as it stands, with no new user message. This is
// pi 0.85.1's continue (agent.ts `continue`, agent-loop `agentLoopContinue`):
// the model is asked again from the context; a context that ends with an
// assistant reply has nothing to continue, and only then do pending steering
// and follow-ups go instead, as a prompt would send them.
//
// The no-replay rule stays: nothing here runs a tool. A call that was cut
// off already has its result in the context (cancelled before it ran, or
// interrupted with its effects unknown), and the model reads that and
// decides. A reply cut off mid-stream is kept as its interrupted row, which
// is never sent again (`replayEligible` is false); the continuation is a new
// assistant turn after it.

extension AgentSession {
    /// The receipt key a continuation's command is kept under. It never names
    /// a user turn, so a continuation's receipt cannot replace a message's.
    static let continuePrefix = "continue:"

    /// The last message a request would carry: what a continuation answers.
    var continuationTail: ChatMessage? {
        context.last { $0.replayEligible && !requestExclusions.contains($0.id) }
    }
    /// Whether `run.continue` would run the model now: nothing is running,
    /// no queued edit holds the chat, and the context ends with something the
    /// model has not answered — a user message, or tool results (cut-off
    /// ones included). The snapshot says so, and the app offers Resume.
    var hasPendingAgentEvents: Bool { !(subagents.family?.pending(author:"subagent").isEmpty ?? true) }
    var canContinue: Bool {
        guard !isSubagent, runTask == nil, !closed, queueEdit == nil, !titleTask, !isConnectionTest else { return false }
        // A family paused at its cost limit always has its Resume.
        if costPaused { return true }
        guard let tail = continuationTail else { return false }
        return Self.continues(from: tail) || hasPendingAgentEvents
    }
    /// Unsealed sub-agent turns this owner parked at a cost-limit pause.
    var hasParkedAgentTurns: Bool {
        !isSubagent && agentCoordinator != nil && subagents.family?.turns.values.contains { !$0.status.terminal } == true
    }
    /// Ends a cost-limit pause for a Resume, in memory: the caller persists
    /// (and restores `CostPauseState` if that fails). The next run resumes the
    /// parked turns. Returns the sides the app resumes as well.
    func endCostPause() -> [String] {
        guard costPaused else { return [] }
        costPaused = false; budgetStopIssued = false
        if familyStopReason?.code == Self.costLimitCode { familyStopReason = nil }
        if errorCode == Self.costLimitCode { errorCode = nil; errorMessage = nil }
        resumingCostPause = hasParkedAgentTurns
        let members = costPausedMembers; costPausedMembers = []
        if let root = sideBudgetParents.last { let side = id; Task { await root.forgetPausedMember(side) } }
        return members
    }
    struct CostPauseState { var paused: Bool, members: [String], reason: AgentError?, issued: Bool, code: String?, message: String? }
    var costPauseState: CostPauseState { .init(paused:costPaused,members:costPausedMembers,reason:familyStopReason,issued:budgetStopIssued,code:errorCode,message:errorMessage) }
    func restoreCostPause(_ saved: CostPauseState) {
        costPaused = saved.paused; costPausedMembers = saved.members; familyStopReason = saved.reason
        budgetStopIssued = saved.issued; errorCode = saved.code; errorMessage = saved.message
        resumingCostPause = false; familyWaitResume = false
    }
    /// The whole family's limit, checked before a Resume of a paused chat:
    /// a side reads its root's. Raising the limit alone resumes nothing.
    public func requireCostResumeRoom() async throws {
        guard costPaused else { return }
        do { try await enforceSharedCostLimit() }
        catch let error as AgentError where error.code == Self.costLimitCode {
            throw AgentError(Self.costLimitCode, "Still at the cost limit. Raise the limit above the current spend, then choose Resume.")
        }
    }
    /// A context ending in a user message, tool results, or a compaction
    /// summary (a compaction that summarized the whole tail, before the
    /// request it made room for) has a run to go on with.
    static func continues(from tail: ChatMessage) -> Bool {
        tail.role == "user" || tail.role == "toolResult" || (tail.role == "system" && tail.kind == "compaction")
    }
    /// The turn a continuation belongs to: the newest user message's, or —
    /// when a compaction summarized it and kept its replies — the turn those
    /// replies carry; else the newest shown user message's.
    var continuedTurn: String? {
        let newest = context.last { $0.role == "user" || ($0.role != "system" && $0.turn?.isEmpty == false) }
        return newest.flatMap { $0.role == "user" ? $0.id : $0.turn } ?? visible.last { $0.role == "user" }?.id
    }

    /// `run.continue`. `overrides` are the chat's current choices (model,
    /// thinkingLevel, contextWindow, maxOutputTokens, modelOutputLimit, input),
    /// as for a send or a retry; absent keys mean the connection's defaults.
    ///
    /// Idempotent by `commandID`: the receipt is saved with the run state
    /// before the run starts, so the same command sent again — a reply lost
    /// to a helper that then restarted — finds it and runs nothing. A second
    /// Resume with a new identity while this one runs is refused as busy.
    public func continueRun(commandID: String, overrides: JSON = [:]) throws -> JSON {
        try requireIndependentSession()
        try requireAgentExecution()
        guard !closed else { throw AgentError("session_closed", "Session runtime is unloaded") }
        let receiptKey = Self.continuePrefix + commandID
        if let receipt = commands.last(where: { $0["commandId"].text == commandID }) {
            guard receipt["turnId"].text == receiptKey else { throw AgentError("command_conflict", "Command identity already used for another command") }
            return ["accepted": true, "duplicate": true, "continued": true, "state": receipt["state"]]
        }
        guard runTask == nil else { throw AgentError("session_busy", "Run already active") }
        guard queueEdit == nil else { throw Self.editHeldError }
        // A family paused at its limit resumes only below it. Its parked
        // sub-agent turns go on with the run; its sides are named for the app.
        let paused = costPauseState
        var members: [String] = []
        if costPaused {
            try enforceCostLimit()
            members = endCostPause()
        }
        let familyOnly = paused.paused && hasParkedAgentTurns
        let tailContinues = continuationTail.map { Self.continues(from: $0) } ?? false || hasPendingAgentEvents
        // With nothing of its own cut off, the run waits for the resumed
        // family first, as its turn's end did; follow-ups go after it.
        guard !titleTask, !isConnectionTest, tailContinues || familyOnly else {
            if paused.paused, queue.isEmpty, steering.isEmpty {
                // Nothing of its own waits: the pause is over once saved.
                commandState(Submission(commandID: commandID, turnID: receiptKey, text: ""), "completed")
                queuePaused = false
                if state != .error { state = .idle; runStatus = .idle }
                do { try persistState() } catch {
                    commands.removeAll { $0["turnId"].text == receiptKey }; restoreCostPause(paused); queuePaused = true; throw error
                }
                event("state")
                return ["accepted": true, "continued": false, "resumedFamily": true, "pausedMembers": .array(members.map(JSON.string))]
            }
            // Pi: from an answered context (or none: a first message stopped
            // before it was delivered), continue sends what waits instead.
            // So does a chat the model is never asked to go on in by itself
            // (a connection test, a title).
            guard !queue.isEmpty || !steering.isEmpty else {
                throw AgentError(AgentErrorCode.nothingToContinue, "There is nothing to resume; send a new message instead")
            }
            // Its receipt goes with the queue's release, in the same record:
            // the same command sent again releases nothing twice.
            commandState(Submission(commandID: commandID, turnID: receiptKey, text: ""), "completed")
            do { try resumeQueue() } catch { commands.removeAll { $0["turnId"].text == receiptKey }; restoreCostPause(paused); throw error }
            var reply: JSON = ["accepted": true, "continued": false, "resumedQueue": true]
            if paused.paused { reply["resumedFamily"] = true; reply["pausedMembers"] = .array(members.map(JSON.string)) }
            return reply
        }
        var submission = Submission(commandID: commandID, turnID: receiptKey, text: "")
        submission.model = overrides["model"].text; submission.thinkingLevel = overrides["thinkingLevel"].text
        submission.contextWindow = overrides["contextWindow"].int; submission.maxOutputTokens = overrides["maxOutputTokens"].int
        submission.modelOutputLimit = overrides["modelOutputLimit"].int; submission.input = try NativeHostService.turnInput(overrides["input"])
        _ = try profile.overriding(submission)
        // The continuation's rows belong to the turn they continue.
        let previous = (turn: currentTurnID, paused: queuePaused, message: errorMessage, code: errorCode)
        if let turn = continuedTurn { currentTurnID = turn }
        activeSubmission = submission; continuing = true; queuePaused = false; errorMessage = nil; errorCode = nil
        familyWaitResume = !tailContinues
        commandState(submission, "queued")
        // Saved as a run under way, with its receipt: a helper that dies
        // before the run's own first record leaves the chat interrupted, so
        // it offers Resume again after the restart, never idle.
        do { try persistState(active: true) } catch {
            commands.removeAll { $0["turnId"].text == receiptKey }
            activeSubmission = nil; continuing = false
            currentTurnID = previous.turn; queuePaused = previous.paused; errorMessage = previous.message; errorCode = previous.code
            restoreCostPause(paused)
            throw error
        }
        launch()
        var reply: JSON = ["accepted": true, "continued": true]
        if paused.paused { reply["resumedFamily"] = true; reply["pausedMembers"] = .array(members.map(JSON.string)) }
        return reply
    }
}

--- run setup ---
import Foundation

// The run loop: one task per session that answers a turn, executes the
// tool calls it asks for, and retries transient gateway failures.

extension AgentSession {
    func launch(compactOnly: Bool = false) {
        turnSubagentModels = activeSubmission?.subagentModels ?? subagentModelGrants
        if !costLimitReached, accountingFailure == nil { familyStopReason = nil; budgetStopIssued = false }
        presentationUtility = compactOnly || titleTask
        if retrying || continuing, let root = taskRootID {
            beginPresentedTask(root)
            activeTaskPresentation?.activeInputID = currentTurnID.isEmpty ? root : currentTurnID
            activeTaskPresentation?.anchorSourceID = visible.last?.id ?? root
        }
        state = .running; runStatus = .running; errorMessage=nil; errorCode=nil; begin=nowMS(); end=nil; turnModelMs=0; turnToolMs=0
        runTask=Task { await run(compactOnly:compactOnly) }; event("state")
    }
    func flushRequestLinks() async {
        let pending = pendingRequestLinks; pendingRequestLinks = [:]
        for (attempt, ids) in pending { await traces.outputs(attempt, messageIDs: ids) }
    }
    /// Pi 0.85.1's retry (agent-session.ts _isRetryableError and _prepareRetry):
    /// a failure whose text pi's isRetryableAssistantError reads as transient
    /// (overload, rate limits, 5xx, transport and cut streams), never a
    /// context overflow, is retried up to settings.retry.maxRetries times (3),
    /// after 2, 4 and 8 seconds. Anything else, and a cancellation, fails at once.
    /// Ours (owner 2026-10-15): an incomplete with no reason also retries;
    /// an explicit incomplete reason never becomes transient through its text.
    static func isRetryable(_ error: AgentError) -> Bool {
        guard error.code != "provider_incomplete", !isContextOverflow(error) else { return false }
        return error.code == "provider_incomplete_unexplained" || PiProviderRules.isRetryableText(error.piMessage)
    }
    /// Case 1 of pi's isContextOverflow: the provider's text names an overflow.
    /// Ours: the gateway's structured overflow codes count too.
    static func isContextOverflow(_ error: AgentError) -> Bool {
        guard error.code != "provider_incomplete" else { return false }
        return error.failure?.contextRejection == true || PiProviderRules.isOverflowText(error.piMessage)
    }
    static func httpStatus(in message: String) -> Int? {
        guard let range = message.range(of: #"HTTP (\d{3})"#, options: .regularExpression) else { return nil }
        return Int(message[range].dropFirst(5))
    }
    /// `refresh` runs after a retry's back-off. Pi retries by continuing its
    /// agent loop, which first delivers queued steering; when it does, the
    /// retried request is the one it returns.
    func completeWithRetries(profile: Profile, messages: [ChatMessage], instructions: String, tools: [ToolDefinition], turnID: String, purpose: String, operation: JSON = .null, onDelta: @escaping @Sendable (StreamDelta) async throws -> Void, reset: () throws -> Void,
                             refresh: () async throws -> (profile: Profile, messages: [ChatMessage], instructions: String, tools: [ToolDefinition])? = { nil }) async throws -> ModelReply {
        var profile = profile, messages = messages, instructions = instructions, tools = tools
        // One policy for the whole request: a setting changed meanwhile applies from the next one.
        let retry = retrySettings
        let attempts = retry.enabled ? 1 + max(0, retry.maxRetries) : 1
        var attempt = 0
        modelRequestsMs = 0; modelReplyMs = 0
        // The retry notice describes this request only. It goes whichever way
        // the request ends: a reply, a failure, or a Stop that cancels the
        // retried request itself (thrown as a CancellationError, not an
        // AgentError, so no catch below would see it).
        defer { retryInfo = .null }
        while true {
            attempt += 1
            // Every attempt, the first and each retry, is a model request:
            // none goes once the chat's reported spend reaches its limit.
            try enforceCostLimit()
            let generation=beginObservationGeneration(profile:profile)
            // Each attempt's own duration; the back-off below is not model time.
            let started=nowMS(); var measured=false
            defer { if !measured { modelRequestsMs += nowMS()-started } }
            do {
                modelActive = true
                let reply = try await client.complete(profile:profile,apiKey:apiKey,messages:messages,instructions:instructions,tools:tools,sessionID:id,cacheSessionID:promptCacheSessionID,turnID:turnID,purpose:purpose,lifecycle:try await requestLifecycle(turnID:turnID,purpose:purpose,requestMessages:messages),onObservation:{ [weak self] observation in await self?.observeOperation(observation,generation:generation,operation:operation) },onDelta:onDelta)
                modelReplyMs = nowMS()-started; modelRequestsMs += modelReplyMs; measured = true
                return reply
            } catch is UnexplainedIncompleteCancellation {
                modelActive = false
                try discardIncompleteReply()
                throw CancellationError()
            } catch let error as AgentError {
                modelActive = false
                modelRequestsMs += nowMS()-started; measured = true
                if error.code == "provider_incomplete_unexplained" || error.discardIncompleteReply {
                    // Discard this attempt even when retrying is disabled or
                    // exhausted. Its ledger/capture and accounting remain;
                    // neither a retry nor crash recovery may adopt its reply.
                    try discardIncompleteReply()
                }
                guard attempt < attempts, Self.isRetryable(error), !Task.isCancelled else {
                    throw attempt > 1 ? AgentError(error.code, "Failed after \(attempt) attempts. " + error.message,failure:error.failure,attemptID:error.attemptID,providerMessage:error.providerMessage) : error
                }
                try reset()
                retryInfo = ["attempt": JSON(attempt + 1), "of": JSON(attempts), "reason": JSON(error.message)]
                runStatus = .retrying; event("retry", retryInfo)
                try await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: UInt64(retry.delayMs(attempt: attempt) * 1_000_000))
                runStatus = .running; event("state")
                if let next = try await refresh() { (profile, messages, instructions, tools) = next }
            }
        }
    }
    func observeOperation(_ observation: RequestObservation, generation: UInt64, operation: JSON) async {
        countAttempt(observation)
        startResponseLedger(observation)
        monitor(observation)
        observe(observation,generation:generation)
        if observation.phase == "awaiting", !operation.isNull { await traces.operation(observation.attemptID,operation) }
    }
    /// A model request as the context stands: the tools it offers, its
    /// instructions, its body, and its count, which the chat's figures show.
    struct PreparedRequest {
        var snapshot: ResourceSnapshot
        var definitions: [ToolDefinition]
        var instructions: String
        var body: JSON
        var count: RequestContextCount
    }
    /// The next request, built from `snapshot`, the chat's resources as
    /// applied, and the context as it now stands: before the first request,
    /// and again whenever a compaction or delivered steering changed it.
    func prepareRequest(_ snapshot: ResourceSnapshot) async throws -> PreparedRequest {
        let definitions=await sessionDefinitions()
        let instructions=Self.requestInstructions(snapshot.prompt, tools: definitions)
        let body=try ProviderClient.requestBody(profile:turnProfile,messages:requestContext,instructions:instructions,tools:definitions,sessionID:id,cacheSessionID:promptCacheSessionID)
        let count=try countContext(requestContext,request:body); currentContextCount=count
        return PreparedRequest(snapshot:snapshot,definitions:definitions,instructions:instructions,body:body,count:count)
    }
    /// The reply streamed so far, as the row a cut-off request leaves: kept
    /// and shown, never sent to the model again. Nil when nothing arrived.
    func interruptedPartial(attemptIDs: [String]?) -> ChatMessage? {
        guard let partialID, !partialText.isEmpty || !partialThinking.isEmpty || !partialTimeline.segments.isEmpty else { return nil }
        return Self.interruptedReply(id:partialID,text:partialText,thinking:partialThinking,timeline:partialTimeline,attemptIDs:attemptIDs)
    }
    func run(compactOnly: Bool) async {
        do {
            try Task.checkCancellation(); state = .running; runStatus = .running; try persistState(active:true); event("state")
            if compactOnly { try await compactContext();if let activeSubmission { commandState(activeSubmission,"completed") } }
            else {
                // Deliver the next eligible input before sizing the pending request.
                var startedFollowUp=false
                if steering.isEmpty, !retrying, !continuing {
                    // A follow-up that cannot be answered stays queued, paused.
                    if !queue.isEmpty, queueEdit == nil { try enforceCostLimit() }
                    startedFollowUp=try await startFollowUp()
                }
                let retryFirstRequest=retrying
                retrying=false
                // A Resume asks the model from the context as it stands. Unlike
                // a retry, the request is a new one: steering waiting at its
                // start is delivered first (pi's loop polls it before the first
                // request), and the context may be compacted before it.
                let continued=continuing
                continuing=false
                if continued { try startAgentEpoch() }
                // Resume after a cost-limit pause: parked sub-agent turns go on
                // under this run's execution, before anything is asked again.
                if resumingCostPause, !isSubagent {
                    resumingCostPause=false
                    try await agentCoordinator?.resumeParked(owner:self)
                }
                // Nothing of the parent's own was cut off: wait for the resumed
                // family as the turn's end would, and ask the model only once
                // something arrives for it.
                var familyOnly=false
                if familyWaitResume {
                    familyWaitResume=false
                    if let coordinator=agentCoordinator, try await coordinator.boundary(self,final:true) {} else { familyOnly=true }
                }
                // Pi's _overflowRecoveryAttempted: one compact-and-retry until a
                // user message arrives or a reply completes.
                var overflowRecoveryAttempted=retryFirstRequest && contextRecovery["consumed"].flag == true
                var rounds=0
                if familyOnly {
                    try finishPresentedTask("completed")
                    if let activeSubmission { commandState(activeSubmission,"completed") }; self.activeSubmission=nil
                }
                while !familyOnly {
                    // Pi's agent loop has no limit on model requests per run.
                    try Task.checkCancellation(); rounds += 1
                    // Retry repeats the failed model request before pending steering
                    // reaches its next complete model/tool boundary.
                    let resumingFailedRequest=retryFirstRequest && rounds == 1
                    // Each round makes a model request. At the chat's cost
                    // limit it stops here, before pending steering is delivered.
                    try enforceCostLimit()
                    let humanDrained=resumingFailedRequest ? false : try await drainSteering()
                    let agentDrained=resumingFailedRequest || agentCoordinator == nil ? false : try await agentCoordinator!.boundary(self,final:false)
                    let drained = humanDrained || agentDrained
                    if drained { overflowRecoveryAttempted=false }
                    // A run started for pending input that delivered none (a
                    // queued edit took the hold first, or the message left)
                    // settles without asking the model about the old context.
                    if rounds == 1, !retryFirstRequest, !continued, !startedFollowUp, !drained { break }
                    // A resumed sub-agent turn that had already answered when
                    // its family paused has nothing to ask the model again.
                    if rounds == 1, continued, isSubagent, !drained, let tail=continuationTail, !Self.continues(from:tail) {
                        try finishPresentedTask("completed")
                        if let activeSubmission { commandState(activeSubmission,"completed") }; self.activeSubmission=nil
                        break
                    }
                    let resourceSnapshot: ResourceSnapshot
                    if let appliedSnapshot { resourceSnapshot=appliedSnapshot }
                    else { resourceSnapshot=try await resources.resolve(); appliedSnapshot=resourceSnapshot }
                    appliedRevision=resourceSnapshot.revision
                    var prepared=try await prepareRequest(resourceSnapshot)
                    // Include delivered input and complete tool results. Leave
                    // room for an intact-history summary before this request.
                    let threshold = autoCompaction && !titleTask && !resumingFailedRequest
                        ? try compactionThreshold(requestContext,instructions:prepared.instructions,profile:turnProfile) : Int.max
                    if prepared.count.requestTokens >= threshold, canCompact {
                        do { try await compactContext(reason:"threshold") }
                        catch let error as AgentError where error.code == "compact_unavailable" && prepared.count.fits { /* Nothing useful to replace; keep the intact request. */ }
                        if !drained && !resumingFailedRequest, try await drainSteering() { overflowRecoveryAttempted=false }

--- run end ---
                    partialTimeline.finish(reply.truncated ? "incomplete":"completed")
                    saveResponseLedger(persist:true,terminal:reply.truncated ? "incomplete":"completed"); partialLedgerID=nil
                    var assistant=reply.message
                    if !partialTimeline.segments.isEmpty { assistant.responseTimeline=partialTimeline }
                    // The reply's model time is its own request's; the turn's counts every attempt.
                    assistant.id=partialID ?? assistant.id; assistant.modelMs=modelReplyMs; partialID=nil; currentAttemptIDs=assistant.requestAttemptIDs ?? []
                    // An incomplete reply is a complete row with a reason, not a
                    // failed run, and its calls never run. Only a reply cut at
                    // the output budget is output-limited; the provider can end
                    // one early for another reason (its content filter), which
                    // the row names instead of claiming the limit.
                    let stoppedEarly = reply.truncated ? (reply.terminal?.incompleteReason ?? "max_output_tokens") : nil
                    let outputLimited = stoppedEarly == "max_output_tokens"
                    if let stoppedEarly { assistant.stopReason = outputLimited ? "length" : stoppedEarly }
                    // The reply keeps its usage in pi's shape: the next count rests on it.
                    assistant.usage=PiContext.usage(reply.usage,api:turnProfile.api)
                    assistant.contextUsageBinding = try reply.message.contextUsageBinding ?? RequestContextCounter.usageBinding(prepared.body,profile:turnProfile)
                    // A reply the journal refuses keeps its log, set aside when the run settles.
                    do { try append(assistant) } catch { partialReplyUnsaved=true; flushStreamed(as:assistant.id); throw error }
                    cumulativeUsage.observe(reply.usage)
                    if !outputLimited { overflowRecoveryAttempted=false }
                    event("message_end")
                    await flushRequestLinks()
                    guard !titleTask || reply.calls.isEmpty else { throw AgentError("title_tool_call", (utilityPurpose == "webhook" ? "The webhook's mini model request" : "Title generation") + " returned a tool call. No tool ran and no extra model request was made.") }
                    if let stoppedEarly {
                        for call in reply.calls {
                            let reason = outputLimited ? "Tool call \"\(call.name)\" was not executed: the response hit the output token limit, so its arguments may be truncated. Re-issue the tool call with complete arguments." : "Not executed: the provider ended the reply early (\(stoppedEarly)), so its arguments may be incomplete. Re-issue a complete tool call if it is still needed."
                            try recordTool(call,result:resultText(reason,error:true),started:nil,state:.failed)
                        }
                    } else if !reply.calls.isEmpty {
                        if Task.isCancelled {
                            for pending in reply.calls { try recordTool(pending,result:resultText("Not executed: cancelled before invocation",error:true),started:nil,state:.cancelled) }
                            throw CancellationError()
                        }
                        try await runToolBatch(reply.calls)
                    }
                    await flushRequestLinks()
                    boundary=context; runStatus = .running; try persistState(active:true); event("turn_end")
                    // Pi 0.85.1: steering is consumed after a COMPLETE tool batch.
                    // Follow-ups are consulted only when the agent would stop.
                    if !steering.isEmpty, queueEdit == nil { continue }
                    // Pi continues after any tool batch, also one it failed because the
                    // reply stopped at its output limit, so the model can re-issue the calls.
                    if !reply.calls.isEmpty { continue }
                    // A reply that stopped at the output budget ends the turn like any
                    // other: the row says so, and queued follow-ups go on.
                    if outputLimited { event("output_limit") }
                    // A completed or output-limited answer stays in context.
                    // Compaction runs only before another pending model request.
                    if let coordinator = agentCoordinator, try await coordinator.boundary(self,final:true) { continue }
                    if !steering.isEmpty, queueEdit == nil { continue }
                    try finishPresentedTask(outputLimited ? "output-limited" : "completed")
                    if let activeSubmission { commandState(activeSubmission,"completed") }; self.activeSubmission=nil
                    if !queue.isEmpty, queueEdit == nil { try enforceCostLimit() }
                    if try await startFollowUp() { overflowRecoveryAttempted=false; continue }
                    break
                }
            }
            state = .idle; runStatus = .idle; errorMessage=nil; errorCode=nil
        } catch {
            // Settling a failed family cancels this task too. Preserve the
            // original outcome before that internal Stop, and leave ordinary
            // chats on their existing failure path until a family is accepted.
            let cancelled = Task.isCancelled || error is CancellationError
            modelActive = false
            let budgetError = familyStopReason?.code == Self.costLimitCode ? familyStopReason : (error as? AgentError).flatMap { $0.code == Self.costLimitCode ? $0 : nil }
            // At the family's limit the family pauses (`pauseAtCostLimit`):
            // its sub-agent turns are parked, not cancelled or waited for.
            if let budgetError, familyBudgetEnabled || isSubagent {
                stopFamilyAtLimit(budgetError)
            } else if budgetError == nil, !costPaused, !isSubagent, subagents.family != nil, let coordinator = agentCoordinator {
                let owner = id, runtime = displayEpoch, generation = stopCount
                stop()
                await Task { await coordinator.cancel(owner:owner,runtimeID:runtime,through:generation); await coordinator.drain(owner:owner) }.value
            }
            let error: Error = familyStopReason ?? error
            setFamilyWaiting(false)
            // Paused, not failed: Resume goes on from here once the limit is
            // raised. A managed child's turn is parked by its coordinator.
            let pausedAtLimit = costPaused || isSubagent && budgetError != nil
            queuePaused=true; runStatus=pausedAtLimit || familyStopReason == nil && cancelled ? .cancelled : .failed; state=runStatus == .cancelled ? .paused : .error
            errorMessage=pausedAtLimit ? (isSubagent ? "Paused at the shared cost limit." : costPausedMessage) : (error as? AgentError)?.message ?? (runStatus == .cancelled ? "Run cancelled. Pending messages are paused; inspect tool effects before retrying." : "Run failed.")
            errorCode=pausedAtLimit ? Self.costLimitCode : runStatus == .failed ? (error as? AgentError)?.code : nil
            if let activeSubmission { commandState(activeSubmission,runStatus.rawValue) }
            if let partial=interruptedPartial(attemptIDs:partialTimeline.segments.first.map { [$0.part.attemptID] } ?? requestObservation.map { [$0.attemptID] }) {
                // Publishing links can suspend below. Once the durable row
                // exists, its former streaming placeholder must not duplicate
                // the same row ID in snapshots taken during that suspension.
                do { try append(partial); partialID=nil } catch { partialReplyUnsaved=true; flushStreamed() }
            }
            do { try finishPresentedTask(runStatus == .cancelled ? "cancelled" : "failed", detail:errorMessage, code:errorCode) }
            catch { activeTaskPresentation=nil; errorMessage="Task outcome could not be saved. Inspect the retained conversation and tool effects before retrying." }
            event("error",["message":JSON(errorMessage ?? "Interrupted")])
        }
        await beforeFinalRequestLinks?()
        await flushRequestLinks()
        if partialID != nil { invalidateDisplay() }
        modelActive=false; partialID=nil; partialText=""; partialThinking=""; resetPartialRow(); end=nowMS(); runTask=nil
        // A run stopped before it began never read these: the next run is a
        // plain one, not a retry or a Resume of this one.
        retrying=false; continuing=false
        // A Retry after a failed Resume answers the turn it continued, never
        // the continuation's own receipt.
        retrySubmission = runStatus == .idle || activeSubmission?.turnID.hasPrefix(Self.continuePrefix) == true ? nil : activeSubmission; activeSubmission=nil
        if let pending=pendingConfiguration { apply(profile:pending.profile, apiKey:pending.apiKey) }
        // The pause landed as the run was settling: the run's own outcome
        // stays, but the chat waits for the family's Resume.
        if costPaused, state != .error {
            queuePaused=true; state = .paused; runStatus = .cancelled
            errorCode=Self.costLimitCode; errorMessage=errorMessage ?? costPausedMessage
        }
        // A reply the journal refused has its log set aside before the run
        // is saved as settled: a reopen of a settled run removes the log.
        if partialReplyUnsaved { removeStreamedLog() }
        do { try persistState(active:false); removeStreamedLog() } catch { errorMessage="Could not durably save session state. Do not replay tool actions without inspecting their effects."; errorCode=nil; state = .error; runStatus = .failed; queuePaused=true }
        event("agent_settled")
        // submit() may accept another message while the last request links
        // are being flushed above. It sees a runTask and queues instead of
        // launching. Manual compaction also bypasses the follow-up loop.
        // Recheck after the final await and hand off atomically, or those
        // accepted messages can sit idle forever. Failed/stopped work stays
        // paused and still requires an explicit Resume.
        if !closed, !queuePaused, queueEdit == nil, state == .idle, !queue.isEmpty || !steering.isEmpty { launch() }
        // A background load of older rows waits for the chat to be idle.
        adoptHistoryFillIfIdle()
        if keepRequested && ephemeral && isIdle { do { _ = try keepNow() } catch { errorMessage="Could not keep side; in-memory content is intact"; event("side.keep-failed") } }
    }
}
