    static var editHeldError: AgentError { AgentError("queue_edit_active", "Finish or cancel the queued edit first") }
    /// Delivers the steering due at this boundary; whether any was delivered.
    /// Every claim checks for a queued edit first, after any wait: once an
    /// edit holds the chat's pending input, nothing more of the batch goes.
    func drainSteering() async throws -> Bool {
        if steering.isEmpty || queueEdit != nil { return false }
        var delivered=false
        let count=steeringMode == "all" ? steering.count : 1
        let selected=Set(steering.prefix(count).map(\.turnID))
        // A delivery failure (revoked skill, moved attachment) must not destroy
        // the user's text: the submission stays at the head so it can be
        // inspected, edited or removed after the queue pauses. But if the user
        // journal append committed and only its following checkpoint failed,
        // history already owns the text: requeueing would duplicate that ID.
        for _ in 0..<count {
            // Delivery awaits resource validation. Pending entries may be removed,
            // edited or moved while suspended; new entries belong to the next batch.
            guard queueEdit == nil, let index=steering.firstIndex(where: { selected.contains($0.turnID) }) else { break }
            let next=steering.remove(at:index); delivering=("steering", next)
            // Steering joins the task that is running. With none running (a
            // resume that found only steering pending), the first message
            // starts one, with its live indicator, turn clock and receipt.
            let starts = activeTaskPresentation == nil && !titleTask
            do { try await deliver(next,lane:"steering",newTask:starts); delivered=true; skillRefreshedTurns.remove(next.turnID) }
            catch {
                delivering=nil
                let kept = !hasDelivered(next)
                if kept { steering.insert(next,at:0) }
                commandState(next,"failed")
                throw kept ? await refreshingQueuedSkills(next, after: error) : error
            }
        }
        return delivered
    }
    /// Starts the follow-ups due when the run would stop; whether any started.
    func startFollowUp() async throws -> Bool {
        if queue.isEmpty || queueEdit != nil { return false }
        var delivered=false
        let count=followUpMode == "all" ? queue.count : 1
        let selected=Set(queue.prefix(count).map(\.turnID))
        for _ in 0..<count {
            guard queueEdit == nil, let index=queue.firstIndex(where: { selected.contains($0.turnID) }) else { break }
            let next=queue.remove(at:index); delivering=("follow-up", next)
            do { try await deliver(next,newTask:!delivered); delivered=true; skillRefreshedTurns.remove(next.turnID) }
            catch {
                delivering=nil
                let kept = !hasDelivered(next)
                if kept { queue.insert(next,at:0) }
                commandState(next,"failed")
                throw kept ? await refreshingQueuedSkills(next, after: error) : error
            }
        }
        return delivered
    }
    /// A queued message `deliver` refused because a skill it carries changed
    /// or went away (`skill_revoked`), already back at the head of its lane:
    /// each such skill is pinned to its current file, or taken off if it is
    /// gone or no longer allowed (`Resources.repin`), and the run stops on a
    /// notice naming them (`skill_updated`). Only an explicit selection
    /// activates a skill: the queue stays paused, nothing is sent, and the
    /// reader's Resume confirms the updated version. A second change before it
    /// goes says the skill keeps changing rather than looping. Any other
    /// failure, or one that cannot be refreshed, is returned as it was.
    func refreshingQueuedSkills(_ submission: Submission, after error: Error) async -> Error {
        guard (error as? AgentError)?.code == "skill_revoked", !submission.skills.isEmpty else { return error }
        let tools = await tools.capabilityIDs(readOnly: readOnly)
        guard let refreshed = try? await resources.repin(submission.skills, tools: tools), !refreshed.updated.isEmpty || !refreshed.removed.isEmpty else { return error }
        // The message waited at the head of its lane while the files were
        // read, and a queued rewrite may have been saved meanwhile: it is
        // changed only where it still waits, not under an edit, and from what
        // it holds now, its skills alone (text a rewrite saved is kept).
        // A run cancelled meanwhile (a stop, a shutdown) leaves the message as
        // it was: its notice would not be saved with a cancelled run.
        guard queueEdit?.turnID != submission.turnID, !Task.isCancelled else { return error }
        let inQueue = queue.firstIndex(where: { $0.turnID == submission.turnID }), inSteering = steering.firstIndex(where: { $0.turnID == submission.turnID })
        guard let waiting = inQueue.map({ queue[$0] }) ?? inSteering.map({ steering[$0] }),
              waiting.skills.map({ $0.id + "|" + $0.metadataHash + "|" + $0.contentHash }) == submission.skills.map({ $0.id + "|" + $0.metadataHash + "|" + $0.contentHash }) else { return error }
        let removed = refreshed.removed.map(\.name)
        // What the reader wrote for a skill that is gone (`/name request`)
        // stays in the message, ahead of its text.
        let written = refreshed.removed.map(\.arguments).filter { !$0.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty }
        var next = waiting; next.skills = refreshed.skills
        if !written.isEmpty {
            next.text = (written + (next.text.isEmpty ? [] : [next.text])).joined(separator: "\n\n")
            guard next.text.utf8.count <= 262144 else { return error }
            next.textRevision = (next.textRevision ?? 0) + 1
        }
        if next.text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty && next.attachments.isEmpty && next.skills.isEmpty {
            return AgentError("skill_revoked", "\(Resources.quoted(removed)) \(removed.count == 1 ? "is" : "are") no longer available, so this queued message has nothing left to send. Remove it from the queue.")
        }
        if let inQueue { queue[inQueue] = next } else if let inSteering { steering[inSteering] = next }
        // A larger skill body must still fit the saved queue, or the message stays as it was.
        if (try? savedState()) == nil {
            if let inQueue { queue[inQueue] = waiting } else if let inSteering { steering[inSteering] = waiting }
            return error
        }
        let again = !skillRefreshedTurns.insert(submission.turnID).inserted
        skillUpdatedTurnID = submission.turnID
        var notice: [String] = []
        if !refreshed.updated.isEmpty {
            let names = Resources.quoted(refreshed.updated), one = refreshed.updated.count == 1
            notice.append(again
                ? "\(names) changed again after this queued message was updated, so \(one ? "it seems" : "they seem") to be changing right now. The message now uses the latest version; press Resume once \(one ? "the skill has" : "the skills have") stopped changing."
                : "\(names) changed after this message was queued. The message now uses the updated version\(one ? "" : "s").")
        }
        if !removed.isEmpty {
            let one = removed.count == 1
            notice.append("\(Resources.quoted(removed)) \(one ? "is" : "are") no longer available, so \(one ? "it was" : "they were") taken off this queued message"
                          + (written.isEmpty ? "." : "; what you wrote for \(one ? "it" : "them") is kept in the message."))
        }
        if !(again && !refreshed.updated.isEmpty) { notice.append("Press Resume to send it.") }
        return AgentError(Self.skillUpdatedCode, notice.joined(separator: " "))
    }
    /// A paused queue whose head message had its skills pinned again to their
    /// current files: the app draws the notice with Resume.
    static let skillUpdatedCode = "skill_updated"
    /// What a `skill_updated` stop says once its message no longer waits:
    /// the run's own failure, which Retry request finishes.
    static let skillUpdateWithdrawn = "The run stopped for a queued message whose skill had changed, and that message is no longer waiting. Retry request finishes the stopped turn."
    /// Whether the message a `skill_updated` stop re-pinned still waits.
    var skillUpdateWaiting: Bool { (queue + steering).contains { $0.turnID == skillUpdatedTurnID } }
    func hasDelivered(_ submission: Submission) -> Bool {
        history.contains { $0.role == "user" && $0.id == submission.turnID }
    }
}

--- replay shortcut ---
import Foundation

/// What a chat's journal replays to: its rows and model context, and what its
/// records add up to. Opening a chat replays its journal this way, from its
/// metadata file's checkpoint when that still matches the journal
/// (`JournalCheckpoint`), and a chat opened from a checkpoint loads its older
/// rows the same way when something asks for them (`ensureFullHistory`).
struct JournalReplay: Sendable {
    var history: [ChatMessage] = [], visible: [ChatMessage] = [], context: [ChatMessage] = []
    var versions = MessageVersionStore()
    var spend = SessionSpend(), spendTracked = false
    var subagents = SubagentJournalState()
    var accounting = AttemptAccounting()
    var assistantMessageCount = 0, latestAssistantMessageID: String?
    var pendingRequestLinks: [String: [String]] = [:]
    var recentTaskPresentations: [TaskPresentationRecord] = []
    var compactionState: JSON = .null, contextRecovery: JSON = .null, failedCompactionFingerprint: String?, parentInfo: JSON = .null
    var presentationOrdinal = 0
    var rowSpans: [String: JournalCheckpoint.Row] = [:]
    /// Shown rows before the loaded ones, when resumed from a checkpoint.
    var olderRows = 0
    var stateRecord: JSON?
    /// The latest point the next open can resume from, if any.
    var captured: JournalCheckpoint?
    /// Whether this replay resumed from the metadata file's checkpoint, and
    /// the checkpoint it resumed from.
    var resumed = false
    var resumedFrom: JournalCheckpoint?
    /// The newest run state's record: its bytes, where it is, and its key.
    var stateSource: StateSource?
    /// How much of the journal the records replayed so far take up, from its
    /// start: where the next record goes, once they are the whole journal.
    var coveredBytes: UInt64 = 0
}

/// A run-state record a checkpoint points at.
struct StateSource: Sendable {
    var line: Data
    var offset: UInt64
    var key: String
}

/// A journal's replay, one line at a time: what `AgentSession.replay` reads
/// from a journal, and what a fork feeds it as it writes one, so the fork's
/// state is the one its journal replays to without reading it again.
struct JournalReplayConsumer {
    private(set) var r = JournalReplay()
    private var id: String
    private var header: JournalCheckpoint.Check?
    private var marker: JournalCheckpoint.Check?
    // The newest run state's record, for a checkpoint: its bytes, where it
    // is, and the key it holds the state under.
    private var stateSource: (line: Data, offset: UInt64, key: String)?
    // The latest point the next open can resume from, and the highest
    // presentation ordinal so far (`JournalCheckpoint`).
    private var ordinalMax = 0
    // The run state is written several times a turn and only the newest
    // counts; in a long chat those snapshots were most of the journal and
    // most of the time it took to open. Keep the newest one's line and
    // parse it once, at the end; a superseded one is not read at all. A
    // line of another shape is read as before.
    private var newestStateLine: Data?
    // The receipts: the newest record with the whole list, and the
    // records with changes only after it, read once at the end
    // (`CommandReceipts`). A checkpoint carries them as they stood there.
    private var receiptsBase = CommandReceipts.Base.none, receiptChanges: [Data] = []
    private var capturedReceipts: (base: CommandReceipts.Base, changes: [Data])?
    // For a replay resumed from a checkpoint: the newest edit marker among the
    // shown rows it did not load, when the checkpoint says (`older`).
    private enum Older { case none, marker(String), unknown }
    private var older = Older.none
    // The chat's moves to another connection so far, which every checkpoint
    // names: they change nothing a replay builds, but an open checks them.
    private var rebinds: [JournalCheckpoint.Check] = []

    /// `header` and `marker` are the journal's, as a checkpoint names them;
    /// `spendTracked` is what a journal with no cost record counts as.
    init(id: String, header: JournalCheckpoint.Check?, marker: JournalCheckpoint.Check?, spendTracked: Bool) {
        self.id = id; self.header = header; self.marker = marker; r.spendTracked = spendTracked
    }

    /// Starts from the metadata file's checkpoint: the rows it names, then
    /// only the records after it. Rows shown before them load when asked for.
    mutating func resume(from checkpoint: JournalCheckpoint, loaded: (rows: [ChatMessage], context: [ChatMessage], state: JSON?, stateLine: Data?)) {
        r.resumed=true; r.resumedFrom=checkpoint; r.coveredBytes=checkpoint.start; rebinds=checkpoint.rebinds ?? []
        // The checkpoint's lineage is the newest marker among all its shown
        // rows. One not among the rows it names is among those not loaded, and
        // the newest there; one among them leaves the newest before it unknown.
        if let lineage=checkpoint.lineage { older = checkpoint.rows.contains { $0.id == lineage } ? .unknown : .marker(lineage) }
        r.history=loaded.rows; r.visible=loaded.rows; r.context=loaded.context
        for (row, message) in zip(checkpoint.rows, loaded.rows) {
            r.rowSpans[row.id]=row
            if row.kind != .branch { for attempt in message.requestAttemptIDs ?? [] { r.pendingRequestLinks[attempt, default: []].append(message.id) } }
        }
        r.olderRows=checkpoint.rowsBefore
        r.assistantMessageCount=checkpoint.assistantMessageCount; r.latestAssistantMessageID=checkpoint.latestAssistantMessageID
        r.versions.ledger=checkpoint.versions; r.recentTaskPresentations=checkpoint.tasks
        let saved=(try? JSON.parse(Data(checkpoint.helper.utf8))) ?? [:]
        r.subagents = (try? JSONDecoder().decode(SubagentJournalState.self, from: saved["subagents"].data())) ?? SubagentJournalState()
        r.subagents.retarget(id)
        r.accounting = (try? JSONDecoder().decode(AttemptAccounting.self, from: saved["accounting"].data())) ?? AttemptAccounting()
        r.spend.add(record: saved["spend"]); r.spendTracked=saved["spendTracked"].flag == true
        r.accounting.restoreUsageCoverage(spend:r.spend)
        r.failedCompactionFingerprint=saved["failedCompactionFingerprint"].text
        r.contextRecovery=saved["contextRecovery"]; r.compactionState=saved["compactionState"]; r.parentInfo=saved["parentInfo"]
        ordinalMax=saved["presentationOrdinal"].int ?? 0
        r.stateRecord=loaded.state
        if let check=checkpoint.state, let key=checkpoint.stateKey, let line=loaded.stateLine { stateSource=(line, check.offset, key) }
        // A record with changes only stands for the list the file carries.
        if let state=loaded.state { receiptsBase = .list(state[CommandReceipts.deltaKey].flag == true ? saved["commands"].list : state["commands"].list) }
    }

    /// One record: `line`, not empty, which starts `lineStart` bytes into the journal.

        r.coveredBytes = lineStart + UInt64(line.count) + 1

        try r.subagents.consume(item, sessionID: id)
        if try r.accounting.consumeRecord(item,sessionID:id,spend:&r.spend) { r.spendTracked = true; return }
        if item["customType"].text == JournalRecordKind.rebind {

import Foundation

// Opening a chat from its journal's metadata file (`JournalCheckpoint`):
// what a checkpoint records while the journal is replayed, and loading the
// rows it names. Static: the synchronous initializer calls them.

extension AgentSession {
    /// A checkpoint just after the record `lastLine`, which set the model
    /// context (a compaction, an edit or a fork boundary). nil when some row
    /// it would name has no known place in the journal: the next open then
    /// replays the whole journal, as every open did before.
    static func checkpoint(sessionID: String, header: JournalCheckpoint.Check?, marker: JournalCheckpoint.Check?,
                           last lastLine: Data, at lastOffset: UInt64, lastID: String,
                           visible: [ChatMessage], context: [ChatMessage], spans: [String: JournalCheckpoint.Row],
                           state: (line: Data, offset: UInt64, key: String)?, assistantMessageCount: Int, latestAssistantMessageID: String?,
                           versions: MessageVersionLedger, tasks: [TaskPresentationRecord], helper: JSON,
                           rebinds: [JournalCheckpoint.Check] = []) -> JournalCheckpoint? {
        guard let header, let marker, !context.isEmpty else { return nil }
        // The rows shown from the context's first one on: the context is
        // mostly the latest rows, so look for it from the end.
        var remaining = Set(context.map(\.id)), first = visible.count
        while first > 0, !remaining.isEmpty { first -= 1; remaining.remove(visible[first].id) }
        guard remaining.isEmpty else { return nil }
        var rows: [JournalCheckpoint.Row] = []
        rows.reserveCapacity(visible.count - first)
        for message in visible[first...] {
            guard let span = spans[message.id] else { return nil }
            rows.append(span)
        }
        let stateCheck = state.map { JournalCheckpoint.Check(offset: $0.offset, length: $0.line.count, sha256: JournalCheckpoint.digest($0.line)) }
        return JournalCheckpoint(sessionID: sessionID, header: header, marker: marker,
                                 last: .init(offset: lastOffset, length: lastLine.count, sha256: JournalCheckpoint.digest(lastLine)), lastID: lastID,
                                 rows: rows, rowsBefore: first, context: context.map(\.id), lineage: visible.last(where: { $0.kind == "branch" })?.id,
                                 state: stateCheck, stateKey: state?.key,
                                 assistantMessageCount: assistantMessageCount, latestAssistantMessageID: latestAssistantMessageID,
                                 versions: versions, tasks: tasks, helper: helper.encoded(), rebinds: rebinds.isEmpty ? nil : rebinds)
    }

    /// What a checkpoint carries for the session besides its rows and
    /// context, in its `helper` field, for an open that resumes from it to
    /// take over (`replay`). The receipts are added where they are known.
    static func checkpointHelper(spend: SessionSpend, spendTracked: Bool, failedCompactionFingerprint: String?, contextRecovery: JSON,
                                 compactionState: JSON, parentInfo: JSON, presentationOrdinal: Int, subagents: SubagentJournalState = SubagentJournalState(), accounting: AttemptAccounting = AttemptAccounting()) -> JSON {
        var helper: JSON = ["accounting": (try? subagentJSON(accounting)) ?? .null, "subagents": (try? subagentJSON(subagents)) ?? .null, "spend": spend.record, "spendTracked": JSON(spendTracked), "failedCompactionFingerprint": failedCompactionFingerprint.map { JSON($0) } ?? .null,
         "contextRecovery": contextRecovery, "compactionState": compactionState, "parentInfo": parentInfo, "presentationOrdinal": JSON(presentationOrdinal)]
        if subagents.family != nil || subagents.origin != nil || !subagents.plans.isEmpty { helper["subagentEffortVersion"] = 1 }
        return helper
    }
    /// A compaction's progress row once the compaction's record is in the
    /// journal: finished, and saying so. A replay and a checkpoint's rows
    /// both make it, and must make it alike.
    static func adoptCompactionProgress(_ row: inout ChatMessage) {
        row.responseTimeline?.finish("completed"); row.detail = "Compaction · Checkpoint durably adopted"
    }

    /// The rows and context a checkpoint names, and the run state it points
    /// at, read from the journal; nil when any record is not what it recorded.
    static func loadCheckpoint(_ checkpoint: JournalCheckpoint, url: URL) -> (rows: [ChatMessage], context: [ChatMessage], state: JSON?, stateLine: Data?)? {
        guard let saved = try? JSON.parse(Data(checkpoint.helper.utf8)),
              let subagents = try? JSONDecoder().decode(SubagentJournalState.self, from: saved["subagents"].data()),
              let accounting = try? JSONDecoder().decode(AttemptAccounting.self, from: saved["accounting"].data()),
              let file = try? FileHandle(forReadingFrom: url) else { return nil }
        defer { try? file.close() }
        // Old caches reconstructed carried seed dollars by subtraction. Read
        // the original numeric records once, then retain their exact sum.
        if saved["parentInfo"]["parentSessionId"].text != nil, saved["parentInfo"]["relationship"].text != "fork", accounting.unkeyedUSD == nil { return nil }
        // An older helper's cache decodes away effort/capabilities even when
        // their original journal rows survive. Replay those families in full;
        // ordinary chats and current caches retain the checkpoint shortcut.
        guard saved["subagentEffortVersion"].int == 1 || (subagents.family == nil && subagents.origin == nil && subagents.plans.isEmpty) else { return nil }
        var rows: [ChatMessage] = []
        rows.reserveCapacity(checkpoint.rows.count)
        for row in checkpoint.rows {
            guard let message = journalRow(row, in: file) else { return nil }
            rows.append(message)
        }
        // A compaction record adopts its progress row, as the replay does,
        // unless that row was replaced after it.
        for (index, row) in checkpoint.rows.enumerated() where row.kind == .compaction {
            guard let operation = rows[index].operationID,
                  let position = rows.firstIndex(where: { $0.kind == "execution" && $0.operationID == operation }),
                  checkpoint.rows[position].offset < row.offset else { continue }
            adoptCompactionProgress(&rows[position])
        }
        let byID = Dictionary(rows.map { ($0.id, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
        let context = checkpoint.context.compactMap { byID[$0] }
        guard context.count == checkpoint.context.count else { return nil }
        var state: JSON?, stateLine: Data?
        if let check = checkpoint.state {
            guard let key = checkpoint.stateKey, let line = JournalCheckpoint.verified(check, in: file), let record = try? JSON.parse(line) else { return nil }
            state = record[key]; stateLine = line
            // A record with changes only needs the whole list the file carries
            // (`CommandReceipts`); a file written before those had none.
            if state?[CommandReceipts.deltaKey].flag == true {
                guard let carried = try? JSON.parse(Data(checkpoint.helper.utf8)), !carried["commands"].isNull else { return nil }
            }
        }
        return (rows, context, state, stateLine)
    }

    /// The row the record at `row` holds, as a replay makes it from that
    /// record; nil when the record there is not the one named.
    static func journalRow(_ row: JournalCheckpoint.Row, in file: FileHandle) -> ChatMessage? {
        JournalCheckpoint.rowBytes(row, in: file).flatMap { journalRow(row, bytes: $0) }
    }
    static func journalRow(_ row: JournalCheckpoint.Row, bytes: Data) -> ChatMessage? {
        guard let record = try? JSON.parse(bytes) else { return nil }
        switch row.kind {
        case .message:
            guard record["type"].text == "message", record["id"].text == row.id else { return nil }
            return try? ChatMessage(id: row.id, pi: record["message"])
        case .update:
            guard record["customType"].text == JournalRecordKind.presentationUpdate, record["data"]["id"].text == row.id,
                  var message = try? ChatMessage(id: row.id, pi: record["message"]) else { return nil }
            message.replayEligible = false
            return message
        case .compaction:
            guard record["type"].text == "compaction", record["id"].text == row.id else { return nil }
            return try? CompactionCheckpoint.summary(record)
        case .branch:
            guard record["type"].text == "branch", record["id"].text == row.id else { return nil }
            return branchMarker(row.id)
        }
    }

    /// Loads every row a chat opened from its metadata file left in the
    /// journal (shown rows before the loaded ones, and earlier versions an
    /// edit hid): the whole journal replayed, as a full open does. The model
    /// context, the queue and the run stay the live ones; the rows, their
    /// versions, and the links and task records they carry come from the
    /// journal, which holds every record this chat has written. A row loaded
    /// already keeps its live content. An edit, a fork and a version read
    /// need this; a read of older rows reads them where they are instead
    /// (`loadOlderRows`).
    func ensureFullHistory() throws {
        guard partialHistory, let journal else { return }
        let whole=try Self.replayConsumer(journal, url: journal.url, id: id, binding: profile.binding, spendTracked: spendTracked, resume: false)
        adoptFullHistory(try whole.finished()); durable=whole
    }
    /// The whole of the chat's rows, as a replay of its whole journal made
    /// them (`ensureFullHistory`, or the replay a fork of the whole chat makes
    /// of what it copies), in place of the part an open from the metadata
    /// file loaded. The rows' places are in this chat's own journal.
    func adoptFullHistory(_ replayed: JournalReplay) {
        guard let journal else { return }
        commitFullHistory(Self.fullHistory(replayed, live: history, liveTasks: recentTaskPresentations), through: journal.size)
        // The replay kept from the open held only the rows it loaded; one of
        // the whole journal is made when next asked for (`durableReplay`).
        durable = nil
    }
    /// The chat's rows from a replay of its whole journal, the live versions
    /// of the rows it holds kept, and what goes with them: made apart from
    /// the chat (`commitFullHistory` takes them), so a background load can
    /// make them off the actor.
    struct FullHistory: Sendable {
        var history: [ChatMessage], visible: [ChatMessage], versions: MessageVersionStore
        var pendingRequestLinks: [String: [String]], rowSpans: [String: JournalCheckpoint.Row]
        var recentTaskPresentations: [TaskPresentationRecord], toolHistory: ToolHistoryIndex
    }
    static func fullHistory(_ replayed: JournalReplay, live: [ChatMessage], liveTasks: [TaskPresentationRecord]) -> FullHistory {
        let byID = Dictionary(live.map { ($0.id, $0) }, uniquingKeysWith: { _, latest in latest })
        let history = replayed.history.map { byID[$0.id] ?? $0 }, visible = replayed.visible.map { byID[$0.id] ?? $0 }
        return FullHistory(history: history, visible: visible, versions: replayed.versions, pendingRequestLinks: replayed.pendingRequestLinks,
                           rowSpans: replayed.rowSpans, recentTaskPresentations: mergedTasks(replayed.recentTaskPresentations, live: liveTasks, shown: Set(visible.map(\.id))),
                           toolHistory: ToolHistoryIndex(history))
    }
    /// Takes the chat's whole history in one step, with nothing to wait on.
    func commitFullHistory(_ full: FullHistory, through size: UInt64) {
        history = full.history; visible = full.visible; versions = full.versions
        pendingRequestLinks = full.pendingRequestLinks; rowSpans = full.rowSpans

+        let parentTools = await parent.sessionDefinitions()
+        XCTAssertTrue(parentTools.contains { $0.name == "subagent_start" },"The fixture parent can delegate")
+        var ancestor = parent, sides: [AgentSession] = []
+        for depth in 1...3 {
+            let seed = await ancestor.sideSeed()
+            let side = try AgentSession(id:"side-\(depth)",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+                resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:ScriptClient([]),tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore(),seed:seed.messages,parent:seed.info)
+            _ = try await side.preserveSide()
+            await side.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await side.enableAgentSteering(AgentSteeringCoordinator())
+            let offered = await side.sessionDefinitions()
+            XCTAssertEqual(offered,parentTools,"depth \(depth): the side offers the parent's exact tools")
+            for name in ["subagent_start","subagent_send","subagent"] {
+                let call = ToolCall(id:name,name:name,arguments:["task":"Work","mode":"background","child_id":"child","message":"More"])
+                let refusal = await side.sideRefusal(call)
+                XCTAssertEqual(refusal?.code,"read_only","depth \(depth): \(name)")
+                XCTAssertTrue(refusal?.message.contains("main chat") == true,"depth \(depth): \(name) points to the main chat")
+                do { _ = try await side.invokeTool(call); XCTFail("depth \(depth): \(name) must be refused") }
+                catch { XCTAssertEqual((error as? AgentError)?.code,"read_only") }
+            }
+            // Reading or stopping children a 0.1.128 side already owns stays.
+            for name in ["subagent_wait","subagent_status","subagent_stop"] {
+                let refused = await side.sideDelegationRefusal(ToolCall(id:name,name:name,arguments:[:]))
+                XCTAssertNil(refused,"depth \(depth): \(name)")
+            }
+            let state = await side.agentState(), plans = await side.subagents.plans
+            XCTAssertTrue(state.turns.isEmpty); XCTAssertTrue(plans.isEmpty)
+            ancestor = side; sides.append(side)
+        }
+        // A fork is a chat of its own: it may still delegate.
+        let fork = await parent.sideSeed()

+        let forked = try AgentSession(id:"fork",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,

+        XCTAssertNil(allowed)
+        await forked.close()
+        for side in sides.reversed() { await side.close() }
+        await parent.close()
+    }

    public var isRunning: Bool { runTask != nil }
    public var isEphemeral: Bool { ephemeral }
    public var isIdle: Bool { runTask == nil && queue.isEmpty && steering.isEmpty }
    /// Nothing runs, and what waits is held for Resume: a Stop, a failure or
    /// a restart paused it, and only a command sends it. An update may take
    /// the chat as it is; the relaunch restores it paused.
    public var isHeldForResume: Bool { runTask == nil && queuePaused && queueEdit == nil }
    /// Takes a saved connection's new profile and key. An idle session takes
    /// them now; one with a run going keeps what it started with and switches
    /// when the run ends, so a turn in flight never changes route or key midway.
    /// Returns whether the settings are in use already.
    public func configure(profile: Profile, apiKey: String) throws -> Bool {
        try requireIndependentSession()
        guard !closed else { throw AgentError("session_closed", "Session runtime is unloaded") }
        guard profile.binding == self.profile.binding else { throw AgentError("session_conflict", "Changed API, endpoint or model requires a separately bound session") }
        guard runTask == nil else { pendingConfiguration = (profile, apiKey); event("state"); return false }
        apply(profile: profile, apiKey: apiKey); return true
    }
    func apply(profile: Profile, apiKey: String) {
        self.profile = profile; self.apiKey = apiKey; pendingConfiguration = nil
        replayInputsChanged()
        // The count described requests under the old settings.
        currentContextCount = nil; clearRequestObservation()
        event("configured")
    }
    public var path: String? { journal?.url.path }
    public var isConnectionTest: Bool { tools is DisabledTools }
    public var resourceRevision: String? { appliedRevision }
    /// The retained event window. Trimming to an exact bound moved the whole
    /// array on every event once a long chat had filled it; dropping a batch
    /// at a slack line costs the same amortised and keeps strictly more
    /// history for a reader that has to catch up.
    static let retainedEvents = 4096, retainedEventSlack = 512
    func event(_ type: String, _ payload: JSON = [:]) {
        if type == "cost.spend" { childCostObserver?(payload) }
        monitoring.activity(activityPhase, at: nowMS())
        sequence += 1; events.append(["seq":JSON(sequence),"type":JSON(type),"payload":payload])
        if events.count > Self.retainedEvents+Self.retainedEventSlack { events.removeFirst(events.count-Self.retainedEvents) }
        changed(id,sequence)
        scheduleSubagentProgress()
    }
    /// Set while a retry starts, so the run answers the failed turn before it
    /// looks at queued follow-ups.
    var retrying=false
    /// Set while a Resume starts (`continueRun`): the run asks the model from
    /// the context as it stands before it looks at queued follow-ups.
    var continuing=false
    /// The submission of a turn that failed or was stopped, kept so a retry
    /// sends the same request: its model, reasoning effort and budgets.
    var retrySubmission: Submission?
    /// Stops the run and pauses the queue. `stopCount` lets work that awaited
    /// a run winding down tell that the chat was stopped again meanwhile.
    public func stop() {
        let cancelledGeneration = stopCount
        stopCount &+= 1; queuePaused=true; runTask?.cancel()
        for permit in requestPermits.values { permit.cancel() }
        // A cost-limit pause parks this owner's sub-agent turns for Resume
        // instead of cancelling them. The coordinator stops their runs.
        if costPaused, !isSubagent, let coordinator = agentCoordinator { Task { await coordinator.pause(owner:self) } }
        else { familyCancelled?(cancelledGeneration) }
        managedCancellation?()
        // The run may already have reached its terminal state while its
        // final links are flushing. Nothing after that await enters the
        // cancellation catch again, so do not turn it back into Stopping.
        if runTask != nil, state == .running || state == .stopping { state = .stopping }
        else if state != .error { state = .paused }
        event("state")
    }
    var canUnload: Bool {
        isIdle && !ephemeral && requestPermits.isEmpty && inFlightBudgetAttempts.isEmpty &&
        (managedCancellation == nil || subagents.terminal != nil || subagents.family?.latest(id)?.status.terminal == true || costPaused)
    }
    public func unloadIfIdle() -> Bool {
        guard canUnload else { return false }
        cancelHistoryLoads(); closed=true; journal=nil
        if !isSubagent, let coordinator = subagentCoordinator {
            let owner = id, runtimeID = displayEpoch
            Task { await coordinator.release(owner: owner, runtimeID: runtimeID) }
        }
        return true
    }
    public func close() async {
        cancelHistoryLoads(); closed=true; stop(); await runTask?.value
        // A paused family keeps its turns for Resume after the next open.
        if !isSubagent, costPaused { await agentCoordinator?.pause(owner:self) }
        if !isSubagent { await agentCoordinator?.drain(owner:id) }
        if !isSubagent { await subagentCoordinator?.release(owner: id, runtimeID: displayEpoch) }
        journal=nil
    }
}

--- side budget ---
import Foundation

extension AgentSession {
    /// Runtime ownership is bound by the host from the journal's side origin,
    /// never from a provider or a tool argument. Forks keep independent budgets.
    func bindSideBudget(to parent: AgentSession) async throws {
        guard isSideChat, parentInfo["parentSessionId"].text == parent.id, parent.id != id else { throw AttemptAccounting.damaged() }
        guard !(await parent.isSubagent) else { throw AttemptAccounting.damaged() }
        let ancestors = await parent.sideBudgetParents
        guard !ancestors.contains(where: { $0.id == id }), ancestors.count < 128 else { throw AttemptAccounting.damaged() }
        sideBudgetParents = [parent] + ancestors
        sideBudgetIDs = sideBudgetParents.map(\.id)
        familyBudgetEnabled = true; costLimitUSD = nil
        for ancestor in sideBudgetParents {
            try await ancestor.registerSideBudget(self, id: id, parents: sideBudgetIDs)
        }
        // Old saved sides and a lost owner acknowledgement are repaired from
        // numeric accounting only. No side messages, titles or prompts travel.
        for entry in accounting.attempts.values {
            guard let record = SideBudgetRecovery.record(entry,side:id,parents:sideBudgetIDs) else { continue }
            for ancestor in sideBudgetParents.reversed() { try await ancestor.importSideRecord(record, side:id, parents:sideBudgetIDs) }
        }
        if let seed = SideBudgetRecovery.unkeyedCharge(spend:spend,accounting:accounting,side:id,parents:sideBudgetIDs) {
            let record = SideBudgetRecovery.AccountingRecord(kind:JournalRecordKind.cost,data:seed)
            for ancestor in sideBudgetParents.reversed() { try await ancestor.importSideRecord(record, side:id, parents:sideBudgetIDs) }
        }
        try await refreshSideCharges()
    }

    func refreshSideCharges() async throws {
        for parent in sideBudgetParents.reversed() {
            let costs = await parent.sharedCharges(Array(accounting.attempts.keys))
            for cost in costs {
                let changed = try mirrorSharedCharge(cost)
                if changed, let delegation = cost["delegationId"].text, let plan = subagents.plans[delegation] {
                    try SubagentRecovery.mirrorCapturedCost(cost, plan:plan, directory:directory)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    func sharedCharges(_ attempts: [String]) -> [JSON] { attempts.compactMap { accounting.attempts[$0]?.contribution } }
    func committedSideCharges() -> [JSON] { accounting.sideCharges(owner:id) }
    @discardableResult func mirrorSharedCharge(_ cost: JSON, acceptedOrigin: SubagentOrigin? = nil) throws -> Bool {
        guard let attempt = cost["attemptId"].text else { return false }
        let entry = accounting.attempts[attempt]
        let child: FamilyCharge.Child?
        if let origin = subagents.origin {
            if entry == nil, cost["sourceSessionId"].text != id { return false }
            child = .init(accepted:acceptedOrigin ?? origin,observed:origin)
        } else {
            guard let entry else { return false }
            if entry.admission == nil {
                guard let owner = cost["budgetOwnerSessionId"].text,
                      owner == id || sideBudgetMembers[owner]?.contains(id) == true ||
                        FamilyCharge.retainedSideCharge(cost,entry:entry,owner:id) else { throw AttemptAccounting.damaged() }
            }
            child = nil
        }
        guard let update = try FamilyCharge.merge(cost,into:entry,revision:accounting.revision,child:child,
            legacySession:isSideChat ? id : nil) else { return false }
        try appendAccounting(kind:update.kind,data:update.data)
        stopFamilyAtLimit()
        return true
    }

    private func registerSideBudget(_ runtime: AgentSession, id side: String, parents: [String]) throws {
        guard !closed, parents.contains(id), side != id else { throw AttemptAccounting.damaged() }
        if !familyBudgetEnabled { accounting.restoreUsageCoverage(spend:spend) }
        sideBudgetMembers[side] = parents; familyBudgetEnabled = true
        sideBudgetStops[side] = { [weak self, weak runtime] in
            guard let self, let runtime else { return }
            // A raised limit/new run may retire a scheduled stop before it is
            // delivered. Read the current authority instead of a stale flag.
            do { try await self.enforceSharedCostLimit() }
            catch let error as AgentError where error.code == AgentSession.costLimitCode { await runtime.stopFamilyAtLimit(error) }
            catch { }
        }
    }

    func enforceSharedCostLimit() async throws {
        for parent in sideBudgetParents.reversed() { try await parent.enforceCostLimit() }
        try enforceCostLimit()
    }

    func enforceToolBudget() async throws {
        guard familyBudgetEnabled || isSubagent else { return }
        if let budgetOwner { try await budgetOwner.enforceSharedCostLimit() }
        else { try await enforceSharedCostLimit() }
    }

    func sharedRequestScope(_ scope: RequestScope) -> RequestScope {
        var scope = scope
        if !sideBudgetIDs.isEmpty { scope.sideParents = sideBudgetIDs }
        return scope
    }

    func admitSharedAttempt(scope: RequestScope, attemptID: String, allowsPausedQueue: Bool) async throws -> RequestPermit {
        try validateRequestOwner(scope)
        var recorded: [AgentSession] = []
        do {
            for parent in sideBudgetParents.reversed() {
                try await parent.recordSideAdmission(scope, attempt: attemptID, state: "admitted")
                recorded.append(parent)
            }
            return try admitAttempt(scope: scope, attemptID: attemptID, allowsPausedQueue: allowsPausedQueue)
        } catch {
            for parent in recorded { try? await parent.recordSideAdmission(scope, attempt: attemptID, state: "not_dispatched") }
            throw error
        }
    }

    func dispatchSharedAttempt(scope: RequestScope, attemptID: String, allowsPausedQueue: Bool) async throws {
        for parent in sideBudgetParents.reversed() { try await parent.recordSideAdmission(scope, attempt: attemptID, state: "dispatched") }
        try dispatchAttempt(scope: scope, attemptID: attemptID, allowsPausedQueue: allowsPausedQueue)
    }

    private func recordSideAdmission(_ scope: RequestScope, attempt: String, state: String) throws {
        guard scope.valid, sideBudgetMembers[scope.budgetOwnerSessionID] == scope.sideParents, !closed else { throw AttemptAccounting.damaged() }
        if state != "not_dispatched" { try enforceCostLimit() }
        var data: JSON = ["attemptId":JSON(attempt), "sourceSessionId":JSON(scope.sourceSessionID),
            "budgetOwnerSessionId":JSON(scope.budgetOwnerSessionID), "purpose":JSON(scope.purpose),
            "state":JSON(state), "scope":try subagentJSON(scope), "accountingRevision":JSON(accounting.revision + 1)]
        if let link = scope.delegation { data["delegationId"] = JSON(link.delegationID) }
        try appendAccounting(kind: JournalRecordKind.budgetAttempt, data: data)
        if state == "dispatched" { inFlightBudgetAttempts.insert(attempt) }
        else if state == "not_dispatched" { inFlightBudgetAttempts.remove(attempt); stopFamilyAtLimit() }
    }

    func settleSharedAttempt(_ settlement: AttemptSettlement) async throws -> JSON? {
        // The outermost owner commits first. A child mirror may be repaired
        // from its owner's admission after interruption, just like sub-agents.
        // A failed append must not skip another ancestor's settlement cleanup
        // or its terminal evidence. Visit every writer and report the first
        // error; cold recovery can repair failed mirrors from surviving ones.
        var firstError: Error?, result: JSON?
        for parent in sideBudgetParents.reversed() {
            do { _ = try await parent.settleOwnedAttempt(settlement) }
            catch { if firstError == nil { firstError = error } }
        }
        do { result = try settleOwnedAttempt(settlement) }
        catch { if firstError == nil { firstError = error } }
        if let firstError { throw firstError }
        return result
    }

    private func importSideRecord(_ incoming: SideBudgetRecovery.AccountingRecord, side: String, parents: [String]) throws {
        guard sideBudgetMembers[side] == parents else { throw AttemptAccounting.damaged() }
        guard var record = try SideBudgetRecovery.adoption(incoming,accounting:accounting) else { return }
        record.data["accountingRevision"] = JSON(accounting.revision + 1)
        try appendAccounting(kind:record.kind,data:record.data)
        stopFamilyAtLimit()
    }
}

import Foundation

// Unsent text and reading position, written behind the typing rather than
// during it. A draft write is debounced per chat and the last write wins;
// `flushDrafts()` is what quit and update wait for.

/// The model's debounced draft writes.
struct DraftWrites {
    /// The write of each chat's draft that is waiting or under way.
    var tasks: [String: Task<Void, Never>] = [:]
    /// Which write owns each entry above: a newer write replaces the token
    /// first, so a cancelled write's own cleanup never drops the newer entry.
    var tokens: [String: UUID] = [:]
    /// A draft write has already failed, so the next failure does not repeat
    /// the same banner.
    var failed = false
    /// Recovery owns the draft until its transaction finishes; typing waits
    /// behind it so it cannot save over the recovered message mid-commit.
    var recoveries: [String: Task<Void, Never>] = [:]
}

extension WorkspaceModel {
    /// Selection may abandon its read, but an explicit submission still needs
    /// this reconciliation without taking the reader back to its chat.
    func reconcileSubmissionDraft(_ item: ChatRecord, view: SessionDisplay, current: () -> Bool) async throws -> Bool {
        guard let store else { throw StoreError.unavailable }
        if item.isSubagent {
            let metadata = try await store.selectionMetadata(id: view.id, draft: false, anchor: view.scrollAnchor == nil)
            guard current() else { return false }
            if view.scrollAnchor == nil { view.scrollAnchor = metadata.anchor }
            view.selectionMetadataLoaded = true; view.draftReady = false
            return true
        }
        let wantsMetadata = !view.selectionMetadataLoaded, draftAtStart = view.savedDraft
        let metadata = try await store.selectionMetadata(id: view.id, draft: wantsMetadata, anchor: wantsMetadata && view.scrollAnchor == nil)
        guard current() else { return false }
        if wantsMetadata {
            if let draft = metadata.draft, view.draft == draftAtStart.text && view.attachments == (draftAtStart.attachments ?? []) && view.skills == (draftAtStart.skills ?? []),
               view.draft.isEmpty && view.skills.isEmpty && view.attachments.isEmpty && view.editingMessageID == nil && view.queueEditingID == nil {
                view.restoreDraft(draft); if let queued = draft.queuedEdit { Task { await self.reconcileQueuedEdit(view, queued) } }
            }
            if view.scrollAnchor == nil { view.scrollAnchor = metadata.anchor }
            view.selectionMetadataLoaded = true
        }
        let recovered = try await recoverableIntents(metadata.recovered, for: item, view: view)
        guard current() else { return false }
        view.recovered = recovered; view.uncertain = !recovered.isEmpty
        // Text alone cannot authorize a resend while acceptance is unread.
        view.draftReady = true
        return true
    }
    /// An acknowledgement may be missing locally after a full disk or crash.
    /// Consult durable helper evidence before exposing any recovery action.
    func recoverableIntents(_ intents: [CommandIntent], for item: ChatRecord, view: SessionDisplay) async throws -> [CommandIntent] {

        view.acceptedCommands.formUnion(accepted)
        try await protectReturnedDrafts(intents, view: view)
        let unaccepted = unchecked.filter { !view.acceptedCommands.contains($0.id) }
        // A Resume the helper never took ran nothing and holds no text: its
        // record goes, and the chat still offers Resume.
        let resumes = unaccepted.filter { $0.turnID.hasPrefix(Self.resumeIntentPrefix) }
        if !resumes.isEmpty, let store {
            for intent in resumes { try await store.remove(kind: "pending:\(item.id)", id: intent.id) }
            pendingIntentsChanged(item.id)
        }
        return unaccepted.filter { !$0.turnID.hasPrefix(Self.resumeIntentPrefix) }
    }
    func protectReturnedDrafts(_ intents: [CommandIntent], view: SessionDisplay) async throws {

/// Orders accepted progress without keeping its prose or making dollars
/// monotonic: a later accounting correction can legitimately reduce them.
struct SubagentCostCursor {
    var turn: Int, revision: Int
    var epoch: String?
    var elapsed: Double
    init?(_ summary: SubagentSummary) {
        guard let progress = summary.progress else { return nil }
        turn = summary.turn ?? 1; revision = summary.revision
        epoch = summary.progressEpoch; elapsed = progress.elapsedMs
    }
    func follows(_ previous: Self) -> Bool {
        if turn != previous.turn { return turn > previous.turn }
        guard revision >= previous.revision else { return false }
        return epoch != previous.epoch || elapsed > previous.elapsed
    }
}

/// What the cost-limit notice in a transcript asks for.

// Each chat's cost limit: the Settings default, a chat's own choice, and the
// helper session that enforces it. The helper checks the chat's reported
// spend against the limit before every model request; the app decides which
// limit that is and tells the helper whenever it changes.
extension WorkspaceModel {
    /// The limit every chat without its own runs under.
    var defaultCostLimit: CostLimit { configuration.defaultChatCostLimit }
    /// Only actual sides inherit budgets; forks also have parentSessionID.
    func sideBudgetParent(_ item: ChatRecord) -> String? {
        guard !item.isSubagent else { return nil }
        if item.path != nil { return item.persistedBudgetParentID }
        // Only an unpublished side draft lacks a journal. A mounted saved
        // fork is pane placement, never an accounting relationship.
        return side(item.id).flatMap { !$0.kept ? $0.parentID : nil }
    }
    func budgetOwner(for item: ChatRecord) -> ChatRecord {
        var current = item, seen: Set<String> = [item.id]
        while let id = current.delegation?.budgetOwnerSessionID ?? sideBudgetParent(current),
              seen.insert(id).inserted, let parent = record(id), parent.workspaceID == item.workspaceID { current = parent }
        return current
    }
    func costLimit(for item: ChatRecord) -> CostLimit { budgetOwner(for: item).costLimit ?? defaultCostLimit }
    func costLimit(for id: String) -> CostLimit { record(id).map(costLimit(for:)) ?? defaultCostLimit }

    /// Metadata is read at restore/open boundaries, never during view layout.
    /// Recheck the chat generation after the actor hop so deletion cannot be
    /// undone by a stale ancestor read. Tombstones are checked by the store.
    func retainBudgetAncestors(for additional: ChatRecord? = nil) async throws {
        guard let store else { return }
        while true {
            let revision = chatsRevision
            var records = chats
            if let additional, record(additional.id) == nil { records.append(additional) }
            let ids = Set(records.map(\.id))
            guard records.contains(where: { $0.persistedBudgetParentID.map { !ids.contains($0) } == true }) else { return }
            let ancestors = try await store.loadBudgetAncestors(of: records, profiles: profiles)
            try Task.checkCancellation()
            guard !isShutDown else { throw CancellationError() }
            if revision != chatsRevision { continue }
            let added = ancestors.filter { record($0.id) == nil && !deletingFamilies.contains($0.id) }
            if !added.isEmpty { chats.append(contentsOf: added) }
            return
        }
    }

+            if root.id == item.id || isCostPaused(root.id) {
+                guard let reply = await performResume(root, view: displays[root.id], member: root.id != item.id) else { return }
+                members = reply["pausedMembers"]?.array?.compactMap(\.string) ?? []
+            }
+            var order = members.filter { $0 != root.id }
+            if item.id != root.id, !order.contains(item.id) { order.append(item.id) }
+            for id in order {
+                guard let member = record(id), !member.isArchived, member.workspaceID == root.workspaceID else { continue }
+                _ = await performResume(member, view: displays[id], member: true)
+            }
+        }
+    }
+
+    /// One `run.continue`, recorded as a pending intent first for a durable
+    /// chat. Returns the helper's reply; nil when it was refused or failed.
+    /// `member`: part of a family Resume, where a chat with nothing of its
+    /// own left (a side the root already resumed) is not an error.
+    func performResume(_ item: ChatRecord, view: SessionDisplay?, member: Bool = false) async -> [String: WireValue]? {
+        let commandID = UUID().uuidString, params = turnOverrides(for: item)
+        let durable = !isEphemeral(item.id)
+        var recorded = false
+        defer { refresh(item.id) }
+        do {
+            let lease = try connectionLease(for: item)
+            // A helper stopped for an update, or restarting, is started
+            // again here: the chat reopens from its journal, paused.
+            let host = try await open(item)
+            if durable {
+                guard let store else { throw StoreError.unavailable }
+                // As for a compaction: the command's record is on disk
+                // before it goes, and the helper's receipt settles it.
+                try await store.put(CommandIntent(id: commandID, sessionID: item.id, turnID: Self.resumeIntentPrefix + commandID, text: "[Resume]",
+                                                  state: "intent", epoch: host.epoch), kind: "pending:\(item.id)", id: commandID)
+                recorded = true; pendingIntentsChanged(item.id)
+            }
+            try requireConnection(lease)
+            resumeSteps?("dispatched")
+            let reply = try await host.request("run.continue", sessionID: item.id, params: params, commandID: commandID)
+            view?.acceptedCommands.insert(commandID)
+            if reply.object?["continued"]?.bool == true || reply.object?["resumedQueue"]?.bool == true { noteChatActivity(item.id) }
+            if durable { try? await store?.acknowledgeCommand(sessionID: item.id, commandID: commandID); pendingIntentsChanged(item.id) }
+            // What comes next is what the reader wants to see.
+            if !member { followSubmittedTurn(item.id) }
+            resumeSteps?("answered")
+            return reply.object ?? [:]
+        } catch {
+            let rejection: String? = { if case HostError.rejected(let code, _) = error { return code }; return nil }()
+            // A refused Resume never ran: its record goes.
+            if recorded, rejection != nil { try? await store?.remove(kind: "pending:\(item.id)", id: commandID); pendingIntentsChanged(item.id) }
+            switch rejection {
+            case "session_busy":
+                // A run is already going (a Send, or another Resume, got
+                // there first): that is the chat's run now.
+                break
+            case "nothing_to_continue":
+                if !member {
+                    view?.continuable = false
+                    view?.notice = "There is nothing to resume. Send a new message to go on."
                 }
-                resumeSteps?("failed")
+            case SessionDisplay.costLimitCode:
+                view?.notice = error.localizedDescription
+            default:
+                self.error = error.localizedDescription
             }
-            refresh(item.id)
+            resumeSteps?("failed")
+            return nil
         }
     }

+import XCTest
+import AppKit
+@testable import PiApp
+
+/// The shared cost limit pauses the whole family at once and only Resume
+/// continues it (owner, 2026-10-16), as the reader meets it: the packaged
+/// helper and the synthetic gateway behind a chat and its side, the app's own
+/// quit between two launches, Raise limit and Resume.
+final class CostPauseFamilyTests: XCTestCase {
+    private typealias Setup = GatewayWorkspace
+
+    @MainActor private func launch(_ setup: Setup) async -> WorkspaceModel {
+        let model = WorkspaceModel(stateRoot: setup.state, vault: setup.vault)
+        let window = NSWindow(contentRect: NSRect(x: 0, y: 0, width: 1280, height: 820), styleMask: [.titled, .resizable], backing: .buffered, defer: false)
+        window.isReleasedWhenClosed = false
+        window.contentView = WorkspaceRootView(model: model)
+        window.makeKeyAndOrderFront(nil)
+        addTeardownBlock { @MainActor in
+            window.contentView = nil; window.close()
+            model.report.suspend(); model.shutdown()
+            for host in model.hosts.values { try? await host.shutdownAndWait() }
+            try? await model.traces.close(); await model.store?.close()
+        }
+        await model.restore()
+        return model
+    }
+
+    @MainActor private func quit(_ model: WorkspaceModel) async throws {
+        await waitFor("The model still had work in flight when the test quit") { !model.hasActiveWork }
+        let lifecycle = ApplicationLifecycle()
+        lifecycle.model = model
+        var answers: [Bool] = []
+        lifecycle.answerTermination = { answers.append($0) }
+        XCTAssertEqual(lifecycle.applicationShouldTerminate(NSApp), .terminateLater)
+        await waitFor("Quitting never answered") { !answers.isEmpty }
+        model.report.suspend()
+        try await model.traces.close(); await model.store?.close()
+    }
+
+    @MainActor private func waitFor(_ what: String, seconds: Double = 60, file: StaticString = #filePath, line: UInt = #line,
+                                    _ condition: () -> Bool) async {
+        let deadline = Date().addingTimeInterval(seconds)
+        while Date() < deadline {
+            if condition() { return }
+            try? await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(15))
+        }
+        XCTFail(what, file: file, line: line)
+    }
+
+    private struct Capture: Decodable { var sessionID: String?; var cancelled: Bool?; var connectionTest: Bool? }
+    private static func captures(_ base: String) async throws -> [Capture] {
+        let (data, _) = try await URLSession.shared.data(from: URL(string: base + "/captures")!)
+        return try JSONDecoder().decode([Capture].self, from: data).filter { $0.connectionTest != true }
+    }
+
+    /// A side streams a slow reply when the chat's own reply crosses the
+    /// shared limit: the side's request is cut at once, both show the pause
+    /// with spend and limit, and it survives a quit. Raising the limit resumes
+    /// nothing; Resume in the chat resumes the side it names, which goes on
+    /// from where it stopped.
+    @MainActor func testSidePausesAtOnceSurvivesRelaunchAndResumesFromTheChatAfterARaise() async throws {
+        // Forty words stream for about nine seconds: the crossing lands mid-reply.
+        let setup = try await gatewayWorkspace("cost-pause-family", projectID: "cost-pause-project", gatewayEnvironment: ["PI_APP_UI_FIXTURE_SLOW_WORDS": "40"])
+        let first = await launch(setup)
+        first.selectedWorkspaceID = setup.workspace.id; first.profileChoice = setup.profile.id
+        let parent = ChatRecord(id: "parent-" + UUID().uuidString, workspaceID: setup.workspace.id, title: "Parent", path: nil, profileID: setup.profile.id)
+        first.chats = [parent]; try await first.store?.put(parent, kind: "chat", id: parent.id)
+        // Each synthetic request costs $0.00125: the second one crosses $0.002.
+        try await first.setCostLimit(.usd(0.002), for: parent.id)
+        await first.select(parent.id)
+        let parentView = try XCTUnwrap(first.displays[parent.id])
+        parentView.draft = "A question for the chat"; first.send(sessionID: parent.id)
+        await waitFor("The chat's first turn never finished") { !parentView.hasWork && !parentView.loading && parentView.messages.last?.role == "assistant" && parentView.messages.last?.isStreaming == false }
+
+        first.openSide(parentID: parent.id)
+        let side = try XCTUnwrap(first.sides[parent.id])
+        let sideView = try XCTUnwrap(first.displays[side.id])
+        sideView.draft = "A slow question for the side"; first.send(sessionID: side.id)
+        await waitFor("The side's reply never started streaming") {
+            first.sides[parent.id]?.kept == true && sideView.messages.last?.isStreaming == true
+        }
+        parentView.draft = "Another question"; first.send(sessionID: parent.id)
+        let crossed = Date()
+        await waitFor("The family never paused") { parentView.costPaused && sideView.costPaused && !sideView.busy && !parentView.busy }
+        XCTAssertLessThan(Date().timeIntervalSince(crossed), 7, "The side's slow reply was cut, not drained")
+        var cut: [Capture] = []
+        for _ in 0..<200 {
+            // The gateway notices the closed stream at its next chunk.
+            cut = try await Self.captures(setup.base).filter { $0.sessionID == side.id }
+            if cut.last?.cancelled == true { break }
+            try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(25))
+        }
+        XCTAssertEqual(cut.last?.cancelled, true, "The side's request in flight was cancelled at the limit")
+        for (view, shared) in [(parentView, false), (sideView, true)] {
+            let card = try XCTUnwrap(view.presentedMessages.last)
+            XCTAssertEqual(card.failureCode, SessionDisplay.costPausedCode)
+            XCTAssertEqual(card.text, shared ? "$0.0025 spent of the main chat’s $0.002 limit." : "$0.0025 spent of the $0.002 limit.")
+            XCTAssertTrue(card.detail?.contains("Nothing resumes until you choose Resume") == true, card.detail ?? "")
+            XCTAssertFalse(view.offersResume, "Resume waits for a raised limit")
+        }
+        XCTAssertEqual(first.runHolds[parent.id]?.state, "paused")
+        let sent = try await Self.captures(setup.base).count, sideSent = cut.count
+        let cutParent = try await Self.captures(setup.base).filter { $0.sessionID == parent.id }.count
+        try await quit(first)
+
+        let second = await launch(setup)
+        await second.select(parent.id)
+        let reopened = try XCTUnwrap(second.displays[parent.id])
+        await waitFor("The chat never read its paused state") { reopened.runStateKnown && reopened.costPaused }
+        // Read from the journal before any helper: the spend is not known
+        // yet, so Resume is offered and the helper refuses it at the limit.
+        XCTAssertEqual(reopened.presentedMessages.last?.failureCode, SessionDisplay.costPausedRaisedCode)
+        XCTAssertEqual(second.runHolds[parent.id]?.state, "paused")
+        second.resumeRun(sessionID: parent.id)
+        await waitFor("Resume at the limit was not refused") { reopened.notice.contains("cost limit") && !reopened.resuming }
+        await waitFor("The helper's reading never held the card") { reopened.presentedMessages.last?.failureCode == SessionDisplay.costPausedCode }
+        XCTAssertFalse(reopened.offersResume)
+        let refused = try await Self.captures(setup.base).count
+        XCTAssertEqual(refused, sent, "A refused Resume sends nothing")
+        try await second.setCostLimit(.usd(1), for: parent.id)
+        await waitFor("The card never offered Resume") { reopened.presentedMessages.last?.failureCode == SessionDisplay.costPausedRaisedCode }
+        XCTAssertTrue(reopened.offersResume)
+        XCTAssertTrue(reopened.presentedMessages.last?.detail?.contains("every paused side and sub-agent") == true)
+        try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(400))
+        let afterRaise = try await Self.captures(setup.base).count
+        XCTAssertEqual(afterRaise, sent, "Raising the limit resumes nothing")
+
+        second.resumeRun(sessionID: parent.id)
+        let host = try XCTUnwrap(second.hosts[setup.workspace.id])
+        var resumed = false
+        for _ in 0..<600 where !resumed {
+            let state = try? await host.request("session.status", sessionID: side.id).object
+            let sideRequests = try await Self.captures(setup.base).filter { $0.sessionID == side.id }.count
+            resumed = state?["state"]?.string == "idle" && state?["costPaused"] == nil && sideRequests > sideSent
+            if !resumed { try await Task.sleep(for: .milliseconds(50)) }
+        }
+        XCTAssertTrue(resumed, "The side the chat named never resumed and finished")
+        await waitFor("The chat's pause never ended") { !reopened.costPaused && !reopened.resuming }
+        let after = try await Self.captures(setup.base)
+        XCTAssertEqual(after.filter { $0.sessionID == side.id }.count, sideSent + 1, "One continuation for the side")
+        XCTAssertEqual(after.filter { $0.sessionID == parent.id }.count, cutParent, "The chat had nothing of its own cut off")
+        XCTAssertNil(second.error, second.error ?? "")
+    }
+}

+/// How a family paused at its shared cost limit reads (owner, 2026-10-16):

+        var card = try XCTUnwrap(view.presentedMessages.last)

+        // Raised: the card changes, and still nothing resumes by itself.

+        XCTAssertEqual(card.detail, "The limit is now $5.00. Resume goes on with this chat and every paused side and sub-agent.")
+        // Later figures reach the card while it is paused.
+        view.applyCostReading(SessionCostReading(limit: .usd(6), spentUSD: 0.7, reportedRequests: 4))
+        XCTAssertEqual(view.presentedMessages.last?.text, "$0.70 spent of the $6.00 limit.")
+        XCTAssertTrue(view.offersResume); XCTAssertTrue(view.costPaused)
+        view.resuming = true
+        XCTAssertEqual(view.presentedMessages.last?.failureCode, SessionDisplay.costPausedResumingCode, "No second Resume while one is on its way")
+        view.resuming = false
+        // Removing the limit reads as such.
+        view.applyCostReading(SessionCostReading(limit: .unlimited, spentUSD: 0.6, reportedRequests: 3))
+        card = try XCTUnwrap(view.presentedMessages.last)
+        XCTAssertEqual(card.text, "$0.60 spent; there is no limit now.")
+        XCTAssertTrue(card.detail?.hasPrefix("There is no limit now.") == true)
+        // The helper ending the pause removes the card.
+        view.observeRunState(["state":.string("idle"), "runStatus":.string("idle"), "queuePaused":.bool(false), "continuable":.bool(false)])
+        XCTAssertFalse(view.presentedMessages.contains { $0.failureCode?.hasPrefix("cost_paused") == true })
+    }

 # Sub-agents in Bello Agent — Design v2
 
+## 0.1.129 owner decisions, 2026-10-16
+
+These supersede the limit-stop and side-delegation text further down.
+
+**The cost limit pauses the family at once, and only Resume continues it.**
+When the shared budget is reached by any charge source (main, side, nested
+side, sub-agent or side-owned sub-agent), every in-flight provider request,
+retry wait and running tool in the family is cancelled the way Stop cancels it.
+Nothing new starts. Aborted requests keep what they reported; unknown cost stays
+unknown. Work that was under way becomes a durable **Paused at the cost limit**
+state (`costPaused` in the run state, `cost.paused` and `costPaused` in
+snapshots), which survives quit, relaunch and a helper restart. Unsealed
+sub-agent turns are *parked*, not sealed: running and queued turns are saved as
+`queued` with no result, keep their acceptance order and their undelivered
+parent messages, and their runtimes are released. Raising the limit resumes
+nothing. While the spend is still at the limit, Resume is refused with the reason
+shown. After a raise, Resume (`run.continue`) on the root resumes its own run and
+parked turns and returns the sides that paused (`pausedMembers`); the app resumes
+each of them the same way. A resumed turn continues under the parent's new
+execution (`AgentChildTurn.continuations`, one appended per Resume and ignored by
+older helpers); one whose task was delivered continues from its own context
+without being sent the task again, and one that had already answered is sealed
+with that answer. A message sent while paused waits for Resume. See
+`docs/validation/limit-pause-0.1.129.md` for the state machine.
+
+**Sides never start or message sub-agents.** At any depth a side refuses
+`subagent_start`, `subagent_send` and v2 `subagent` with `read_only` before any
+acceptance, pointing to the main chat. Its offered tools stay byte-identical to
+its parent's for the prompt cache. Waiting on, reading and stopping children that
+a 0.1.128 side already owns remain available; their history is unchanged.
+

+    /// The records that bring a child's mirror of this (unsealed) turn up to

+    func mirrorSteps(from mirror: AgentChildTurn) -> [AgentChildTurn] {

+/// The shared cost limit pauses the whole family at once and resumes only on
+/// Resume (owner, 2026-10-16). Replaces 0.1.128's drain-then-block table.
+final class FamilyLimitPauseTests: XCTestCase {
+    enum Phase: String, CaseIterable { case idle, ownRequest, childrenDispatched, sideRequest, preLedgerRequest, tools }

+    /// Every phase × charge source: the crossing settlement cancels every
+    /// other dispatched request at once (no drain), with one Stop, and those
+    /// requests can still record what they reported; unknown stays unknown.
+    func testEveryPhaseAndChargeSourceAbortsInFlightWorkAtOnce() async throws {
+        for phase in Phase.allCases { for crosser in Crosser.allCases {
+            let label = "\(phase)/\(crosser)", root = try temporaryDirectory()
+            defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
+            let owner = try familyFixture(root:root)
+            await owner.enableFamilyBudget(); await owner.beginPresentedTask("turn"); await owner.setCostLimit(0.5)
+            let side = try await self.side("side",parent:owner,root:root)
+            let nested = try await self.side("nested",parent:side,root:root)
+            let child = try await self.child("child",parent:owner,root:root)
+            let sideChild = try await self.child("side-child",parent:side,root:root)
+            let source: AgentSession
+            switch crosser {
+            case .own: source = owner
+            case .backgroundChild, .waitedChild: source = child
+            case .nestedSide: source = nested
+            case .sideChild: source = sideChild
+            }
+            let crossing = try await start(source,"crossing")
+            var held: (RequestLifecycle,RequestPermit)?
+            switch phase {
+            case .ownRequest: held = try await start(owner,"held")
+            case .childrenDispatched: held = try await start(child,"held")
+            case .sideRequest: held = try await start(nested,"held")
+            default: break
+            }
+            await owner.limitFixturePhase(model:phase == .ownRequest || phase == .preLedgerRequest,
+                tools:phase == .tools || crosser == .waitedChild)
+            try await finish(crossing.0,"crossing",cost:0.6)
+            // No drain fence: the Stop is issued by the crossing settlement.
+            let stopped = await owner.stopCount
+            XCTAssertEqual(stopped,1,"\(label): the family stops at once")
+            if let held {
+                // A side's request is cancelled by its own pause, delivered
+                // from the root without waiting for anything to settle.

+            let final = await parent.agentState(), finalState = await parent.state, after = await parent.costPaused

+            XCTAssertEqual(finalState,.idle,mode); XCTAssertFalse(after,mode)

+            XCTAssertEqual(users.last,"Afterwards","\(mode): the waiting message goes after the resumed run")
+            await coordinator.drain(); await parent.close()
+        }

+    /// Quit or helper restart while paused, and a crash before the pause
+    /// parked its turns: reopening keeps the pause and the queued turns;
+    /// nothing runs until Resume, which completes the family.
+    func testPauseSurvivesReopenAndACrashBeforeParkingThenResumes() async throws {
+        for crashed in [false, true] {
+            let label = crashed ? "crash" : "reopen", root = try temporaryDirectory()
+            defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
+            let client = LimitRunClient(mode:"background"), coordinator = AgentSteeringCoordinator()
+            let parent = try AgentSession(id:"parent",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+                resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore())
+            await parent.enableFamilyBudget(); await parent.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await parent.enableAgentSteering(coordinator)
+            await parent.setCostLimit(0.5)
+            _ = try await parent.submit(Submission(commandID:"command",turnID:"turn",text:"Two workers"),steer:false)
+            try await eventually { await client.children.count == 2 }
+            await client.releaseFirst()
+            try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(3)) { let busy = await parent.isRunning, jobs = await coordinator.jobs.isEmpty; return !busy && jobs }
+            let saved = await parent.path, path = try XCTUnwrap(saved)
+            var parked = await parent.agentState().turns.values.filter { !$0.status.terminal }
+            XCTAssertFalse(parked.isEmpty,label)
+            await parent.close()
+            if crashed {
+                // The helper died after the pause was saved but before its
+                // turns were parked: they still read as running.
+                let journal = try SessionJournal(url:URL(fileURLWithPath:path),id:"parent",cwd:root,binding:nil,create:false)
+                for var turn in parked { turn.status = .running
+                    try journal.append(["type":"custom","customType":JSON(JournalRecordKind.agentTurnState),"ownerID":"parent","data":try subagentJSON(turn)],flush:true) }
+            }
+            let reopenedCoordinator = AgentSteeringCoordinator()
+            let reopened = try AgentSession(id:"parent",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+                resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore(),resumePath:path)
+            await reopened.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await reopened.enableAgentSteering(reopenedCoordinator)
+            await reopened.setCostLimit(0.5)
+            let state = await reopened.state, code = await reopened.errorCode, paused = await reopened.costPaused
+            XCTAssertEqual(state,.paused,label); XCTAssertEqual(code,"cost_limit",label); XCTAssertTrue(paused,label)
+            parked = await reopened.agentState().turns.values.filter { !$0.status.terminal }
+            XCTAssertFalse(parked.isEmpty,label)
+            XCTAssertTrue(parked.allSatisfy { $0.status == .queued },"\(label): reopening holds the turns, never interrupts them")
+            for turn in parked {
+                let child = try AgentSession(id:turn.childID,profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+                    resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:DisabledTools(),traces:TraceStore(),resumePath:root.appendingPathComponent(turn.childID + ".jsonl").path)
+                let mirror = await child.agentState().turns[turn.id]
+                XCTAssertEqual(mirror?.status,.queued,"\(label): the child mirror agrees"); await child.close()
+            }
+            do { try await reopened.requireCostResumeRoom(); XCTFail("\(label): resumed at the limit") }
+            catch { XCTAssertEqual((error as? AgentError)?.code,"cost_limit",label) }
+            await reopened.setCostLimit(20); await client.releaseAll()
+            try await reopened.requireCostResumeRoom()
+            _ = try await reopened.continueRun(commandID:"resume")
+            try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(10)) { let busy = await reopened.isRunning, jobs = await reopenedCoordinator.jobs.isEmpty; return !busy && jobs }
+            let final = await reopened.agentState()
+            XCTAssertTrue(final.turns.values.allSatisfy { $0.status == .completed },"\(label): \(final.turns.values.map(\.status))")
+            await reopenedCoordinator.drain(); await reopened.close()
+        }
+    }

+    /// Sides and nested sides with running tools stop at once when another
+    /// member crosses. Each paused side registers with the root, whose
+    /// Resume names them; each side resumes only below the root's limit.
+    func testSidesPauseImmediatelyAndTheRootsResumeNamesThem() async throws {
+        let root = try temporaryDirectory(); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
+        let owner = try familyFixture(root:root), tools = LimitHeldTools()

+        let side = try await side("side",parent:owner,root:root)
+        let nested = try await self.side("nested",parent:side,root:root,client:LimitRunClient(mode:"side-tool"),tools:tools)
+        _ = try await nested.submit(Submission(commandID:"command",turnID:"turn",text:"Work"),steer:false)
+        try await eventually { await tools.started }
+        let held = try await start(owner,"held"), crossing = try await start(side,"crossing")
+        try await finish(crossing.0,"crossing",cost:0.6)
+        // No request has to settle first: the root's dispatched request and
+        // the nested side's tool are both cancelled.
+        XCTAssertThrowsError(try held.1.check())
+        try await eventually(timeout:.seconds(2)) { !(await nested.isRunning) }
+        let cancelled = await tools.cancelled, code = await nested.errorCode, state = await nested.state, paused = await nested.costPaused
+        XCTAssertTrue(cancelled); XCTAssertEqual(code,"cost_limit"); XCTAssertEqual(state,.paused); XCTAssertTrue(paused)
+        try await eventually { await owner.costPausedMembers == ["nested"] }
