+        XCTAssertTrue(rootPaused,"The root shows the family's pause"); XCTAssertFalse(sidePaused,"An idle side has nothing to resume")
+        do { try await nested.requireCostResumeRoom(); XCTFail("A side resumed at the root's limit") }
+        catch { XCTAssertEqual((error as? AgentError)?.code,"cost_limit") }
+        await owner.setCostLimit(20)
+        let stillPaused = await nested.costPaused, running = await nested.isRunning
+        XCTAssertTrue(stillPaused); XCTAssertFalse(running)
+        try await owner.requireCostResumeRoom()
+        let reply = try await owner.continueRun(commandID:"resume-root")
+        XCTAssertEqual(reply["pausedMembers"].list.compactMap(\.text),["nested"])
+        XCTAssertEqual(reply["continued"].flag,false)
+        try await nested.requireCostResumeRoom()
+        let resumed = try await nested.continueRun(commandID:"resume-nested")
+        XCTAssertEqual(resumed["continued"].flag,true)
+        try await eventually { await tools.starts == 2 }
+        let after = await nested.costPaused, members = await owner.costPausedMembers
+        XCTAssertFalse(after); XCTAssertTrue(members.isEmpty)
+        await nested.stop()
+        try await finish(held.0,"held",cost:0.1)
+        await nested.close(); await side.close(); await owner.close()
+    }

+    /// Lowering the limit below the spend pauses work in flight; raising it

+    func testLoweringTheLimitPausesAndRaisingItResumesNothing() async throws {

+        XCTAssertEqual(starts,1); XCTAssertTrue(still)

+    /// A child that reaches its final boundary as the pause lands is not

+    /// Retry backoff is not a request in flight: the pause cuts it short.

+    private func side(_ id: String, parent: AgentSession, root: URL, client: any ModelClient = ScriptClient([]), tools: any ToolExecuting = DisabledTools()) async throws -> AgentSession {
+        let seed = await parent.sideSeed()
+        let side = try AgentSession(id:id,profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+            resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:client,tools:tools,traces:TraceStore(),seed:seed.messages,parent:seed.info)
+        try await side.bindSideBudget(to:parent); await side.beginPresentedTask("turn")
+        return side
+    }
+    private func child(_ id: String, parent: AgentSession, root: URL) async throws -> AgentSession {
+        var origin = subagentFixtureOrigin()
+        let parentID = await parent.id
+        origin.link.childSessionID = id; origin.link.budgetOwnerSessionID = parentID
+        origin.link.call.parentSessionID = parentID
+        origin.link.parentExecutionID = await parent.activeTaskPresentation!.executionID
+        try await parent.installAdmissionFixturePlan(SubagentPlan(origin:origin,task:"Task",resultMessageID:"result-\(id)"))
+        let child = try AgentSession(id:id,profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+            resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:ScriptClient([]),tools:DisabledTools(),traces:TraceStore(),prepared:nil,subagentOrigin:origin)
+        try await child.bindBudgetOwner(parent,generation:0)
+        return child
+    }
+    private func start(_ session: AgentSession, _ attempt: String) async throws -> (RequestLifecycle,RequestPermit) {
+        let value = try await session.requestLifecycle(turnID:"turn",purpose:"turn"), hooks = try XCTUnwrap(value)
+        let permit = try await hooks.admitAttempt(attempt); try await hooks.willDispatch(attempt)
+        return (hooks,permit)
+    }
+    private func finish(_ hooks: RequestLifecycle, _ attempt: String, cost: Double?) async throws {
+        let observation = billingObservation(profile:try fixtureProfile(),session:hooks.scope.sourceSessionID,attempt:attempt,cost:cost)
+        try await hooks.settleAttempt(.init(scope:hooks.scope,observation:observation,dispatched:true))
+    }

+private extension AgentSteeringCoordinator {
+    func fixturePause(_ owner: String) { paused.insert(owner) }

+private extension AgentSession {
+    func limitFixturePhase(model: Bool, tools: Bool) { modelActive = model; runStatus = tools ? .waitingTool : .running }
+    /// What a Resume's run establishes before it resumes parked turns.
+    func beginResumeFixture() { queuePaused = false; beginPresentedTask(UUID().uuidString) }

+/// Uses the same unload guard as HostService's open/release callbacks rather
+/// than closing every child unconditionally, which would hide a pinned runtime.
+private actor LimitChildRuntimes {
+    var opened: [String:AgentSession] = [:]
+    var settled: [String] = []
+    var released: Set<String> = []
+    func open(_ environment: SubagentEnvironment, _ plan: SubagentPlan) async throws -> AgentSession {
+        let id = plan.origin.link.childSessionID
+        if let previous = opened[id], !(await previous.unloadIfIdle()) {
+            throw AgentError("session_busy","Child is still settling")
+        }
+        let child = try AgentSteeringCoordinator.makeChild(environment,plan)
+        opened[id] = child; return child
+    }
+    func settle(_ child: AgentSession) async {
+        guard let turn = await child.agentLease else { return }
+        settled.append(turn.id)
+        if await child.unloadIfIdle() { released.insert(turn.childID) }
+    }
+    func close() async { for child in opened.values { await child.close() } }
+}
+
+/// Children hold their requests until released. A cancelled child request
+/// settles as unreported (its usage unknown) and is listed in `cancelled`.
+/// A child's first request after `releaseFirst` costs $0.60; others $0.20.
+private actor LimitRunClient: ModelClient {
+    let mode: String
+    var parentCount = 0, children: [String] = [], cancelled: [String] = []
+    var firstReleased = false, allReleased = false, firstSettled = false, firstTaken = false
+    init(mode: String) { self.mode = mode }
+    private func observation(_ profile: Profile, _ session: String, _ turn: String, _ attempt: String, cost: Double?) -> RequestObservation {
+        var observation = RequestObservation(sessionID:session,turnID:turn,attemptID:attempt,purpose:"turn",fingerprint:"fixture",profile:profile)
+        observation.monitoring = ["outcome":"completed","gateway":["cost":["status":JSON(cost == nil ? "unreported" : "reported"),"usd":cost.map { JSON($0) } ?? .null]]]
+        return observation
+    }
+    func releaseFirst() { firstReleased = true }
+    func releaseAll() { allReleased = true }
+    func complete(profile:Profile,apiKey:String,messages:[ChatMessage],instructions:String,tools:[ToolDefinition],sessionID:String,turnID:String,purpose:String,onDelta:@escaping @Sendable(StreamDelta) async throws -> Void) async throws -> ModelReply {
+        throw AgentError("fixture_unscoped","Expected admission")
+    }
+    func complete(profile:Profile,apiKey:String,messages:[ChatMessage],instructions:String,tools:[ToolDefinition],sessionID:String,cacheSessionID:String,turnID:String,purpose:String,lifecycle:RequestLifecycle?,onObservation:@escaping @Sendable(RequestObservation) async -> Void,onDelta:@escaping @Sendable(StreamDelta) async throws -> Void) async throws -> ModelReply {
+        let hooks = try XCTUnwrap(lifecycle), attempt = UUID().uuidString
+        let permit = try await hooks.admitAttempt(attempt); defer { permit.finish() }
+        try await hooks.willDispatch(attempt)
+        var reply = answer("Finished"), cost = 0.01
+        if mode == "side-tool" { reply = toolReply(["first"]) }
+        else if sessionID == "parent" {
+            parentCount += 1
+            if parentCount == 1 {
+                reply = ModelReply(message:ChatMessage(role:"assistant",content:[]))
+                for n in 0..<(mode == "queued" ? 18 : 2) {
+                    let start = agentCallReply("start-\(n)","subagent_start",["task":JSON("Worker \(n)"),"mode":JSON(mode == "wait" && n == 1 ? "wait" : "background")])
+                    reply.calls += start.calls; reply.message.content += start.message.content
+                }
+            }
+            else if mode == "tool-reply" && parentCount == 2 {
+                do { while !firstSettled { try permit.check(); try await Task.sleep(for:.milliseconds(2)) } }
+                catch {
+                    let final = observation(profile,sessionID,turnID,attempt,cost:nil)
+                    try await hooks.settleAttempt(.init(scope:hooks.scope,observation:final,dispatched:true)); throw error
+                }
+                reply = toolReply(["first"])
+            }
+        } else {
+            children.append(sessionID)
+            do {
+                while !(allReleased || (firstReleased && !firstTaken)) { try permit.check(); try await Task.sleep(for:.milliseconds(2)) }
+                try permit.check(); try Task.checkCancellation()
+            } catch {
+                cancelled.append(sessionID)
+                let final = observation(profile,sessionID,turnID,attempt,cost:nil)
+                try await hooks.settleAttempt(.init(scope:hooks.scope,observation:final,dispatched:true))
+                throw error
+            }
+            let first = !firstTaken && !allReleased
+            if first { firstTaken = true }
+            cost = first ? 0.6 : 0.2
+        }
+        let observation = observation(profile,sessionID,turnID,attempt,cost:cost)
+        try await hooks.settleAttempt(.init(scope:hooks.scope,observation:observation,dispatched:true))
+        if cost == 0.6 { firstSettled = true }
+        await onObservation(observation); reply.message.requestAttemptIDs = [attempt]
+        if mode == "retry" { throw AgentError("provider_http","HTTP 503 server unavailable",attemptID:attempt) }
+        return reply
+    }
+}
+
+private actor LimitHeldTools: ToolExecuting {
+    var started = false, cancelled = false
+    var starts = 0, cancellations = 0
+    func definitions(readOnly:Bool) -> [ToolDefinition] { [ToolDefinition("first","Held fixture tool",[:])] }
+    func invoke(_ call:ToolCall,readOnly:Bool) async throws -> JSON {
+        started = true; starts += 1
+        do { while true { try await Task.sleep(for:.milliseconds(2)) } }
+        catch { cancelled = true; cancellations += 1; throw error }
+    }
+}

+/// Sides never start or message sub-agents (owner, 2026-10-16). They keep the
+/// parent's offered tools for its prompt cache and refuse the call instead.
+final class SideDelegationTests: XCTestCase {
+    func testSidesAtEveryDepthRefuseDelegationWithTheParentsExactTools() async throws {
+        let root = try temporaryDirectory(); defer { try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:root) }
+        let parent = try AgentSession(id:"parent",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+            resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:ScriptClient([]),tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore())
+        await parent.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await parent.enableAgentSteering(AgentSteeringCoordinator())
+        let parentTools = await parent.sessionDefinitions()
+        XCTAssertTrue(parentTools.contains { $0.name == "subagent_start" },"The fixture parent can delegate")
+        var ancestor = parent, sides: [AgentSession] = []
+        for depth in 1...3 {
+            let seed = await ancestor.sideSeed()
+            let side = try AgentSession(id:"side-\(depth)",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+                resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:ScriptClient([]),tools:RecordingTools(),traces:TraceStore(),seed:seed.messages,parent:seed.info)
+            _ = try await side.preserveSide()
+            await side.enableSubagents(SubagentCoordinator()); await side.enableAgentSteering(AgentSteeringCoordinator())
+            let offered = await side.sessionDefinitions()
+            XCTAssertEqual(offered,parentTools,"depth \(depth): the side offers the parent's exact tools")
+            for name in ["subagent_start","subagent_send","subagent"] {
+                let call = ToolCall(id:name,name:name,arguments:["task":"Work","mode":"background","child_id":"child","message":"More"])
+                let refusal = await side.sideRefusal(call)
+                XCTAssertEqual(refusal?.code,"read_only","depth \(depth): \(name)")
+                XCTAssertTrue(refusal?.message.contains("main chat") == true,"depth \(depth): \(name) points to the main chat")
+                do { _ = try await side.invokeTool(call); XCTFail("depth \(depth): \(name) must be refused") }
+                catch { XCTAssertEqual((error as? AgentError)?.code,"read_only") }
+            }
+            // Reading or stopping children a 0.1.128 side already owns stays.
+            for name in ["subagent_wait","subagent_status","subagent_stop"] {
+                let refused = await side.sideDelegationRefusal(ToolCall(id:name,name:name,arguments:[:]))
+                XCTAssertNil(refused,"depth \(depth): \(name)")
+            }
+            let state = await side.agentState(), plans = await side.subagents.plans
+            XCTAssertTrue(state.turns.isEmpty); XCTAssertTrue(plans.isEmpty)
+            ancestor = side; sides.append(side)
+        }
+        // A fork is a chat of its own: it may still delegate.
+        let fork = await parent.sideSeed()
+        var info = fork.info; info["relationship"] = "fork"
+        let forked = try AgentSession(id:"fork",profile:fixtureProfile(),apiKey:"fixture",cwd:root,directory:root,readOnly:true,
+            resources:Resources(cwd:root,home:root),client:ScriptClient([]),tools:DisabledTools(),traces:TraceStore(),seed:fork.messages,parent:info)
+        let allowed = await forked.sideDelegationRefusal(ToolCall(id:"start",name:"subagent_start",arguments:[:]))
+        XCTAssertNil(allowed)
+        await forked.close()
+        for side in sides.reversed() { await side.close() }
+        await parent.close()
+    }

# Cost limit pauses the family; sides never delegate — 0.1.129

Branch `dev/a129-limit-pause`, based on `dev/next` 9d4123f6 (released 0.1.128).
Owner decisions, 2026-10-16:

- A. "Pause immediately, and support resume once I increase the limit" — "Wait for Resume click".
- B. "Do not allow side to start their own" sub-agents.

All evidence uses generated fixtures, loopback gateways and the build root
`/Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/build-limit-pause` (logs in `logs/`).
No installed app, real preferences, Keychain, real chats or paid provider was used.

## A. The limit-pause state machine

`AgentSession.stopFamilyAtLimit` stays the only budget-induced Stop. It no longer
waits for a drain fence (`inFlightBudgetAttempts.isEmpty && !modelActive`).

| From | Event | To |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Running family (any member has a run, queued input or an unsealed child turn) | Any charge reaches the root's limit: own, side, nested side, sub-agent or side-owned sub-agent settlement; a late correction; adoption; or lowering the limit | **Paused**: `costPaused` is persisted in the run state *before* anything is cancelled. Then Stop's cancellation: every request permit, run task (retry waits, tools, summaries) and, through `AgentSteeringCoordinator.pause`, every child run. Sides are reached through the root's weak side callbacks and pause the same way. |
| Owner with nothing unfinished | Same event | Gates close (one Stop, as before); no durable pause. A side that pauses registers with its root (`costPausedMembers`), and the root then shows the pause too. |
| Paused, a child turn running | Its run ends (cancelled, failed, or the limit refused it) | **Parked**: owner and child journals record the turn as `queued` with no result; its runtime is released. A child that reaches its final boundary during the pause does not seal (it would read as interrupted); its answer stays in place. A turn that had completed seals normally. |
| Paused, a child turn queued | — | Stays `queued` (never `not_executed`), keeps its acceptance order and undelivered parent messages. |
| Paused | Accounting for aborted requests arrives | Accepted; reported cost counts, unreported stays unknown. |
| Paused | Quit, relaunch or helper restart | Still paused: `costPaused` restores; recovery keeps unsealed turns `queued` (a turn still `running` because the helper died mid-pause is requeued, owner and child mirror), pending parent messages stay pending. |
| Paused | Limit raised (or removed) | Still paused. Nothing starts. |
| Paused | New user message | Queued for after Resume (`delivery: after-resume`). |
| Paused | Resume (`run.continue`) at or over the limit | Refused, `cost_limit`: "Still at the cost limit. Raise the limit above the current spend, then choose Resume." (a side checks its root's limit). `queue.resume` and `turn.retry` refuse while paused too. |
| Paused | Resume below the limit | **Running**: the pause ends; the run resumes its own cut-off work if any, else waits at the family boundary for the resumed children; parked turns are re-queued under the run's new execution (`AgentChildTurn.continuations`, +1 per Resume); queued follow-ups go after. The reply names paused sides (`pausedMembers`); the app resumes each. A resumed turn whose task was delivered continues from its own context (task not resent); one that had answered seals with that answer. |

Legacy v2 delegation (steering disabled; not shipped) has no resumable turn; its
children are cancelled at the pause. Chats that never shared a budget keep their
0.1.128 between-request stop (see *Needs owner decision*).

Journal compatibility: no new status. `continuations` is optional and ignored by
older helpers (identity comparisons pass); an older helper reopening a paused family
seals its turns as interrupted, as for any crash. `costPaused`/`costPausedMembers`
are absent unless set.

### App

- Main chat and paused sides: **Paused at the cost limit** card with live spend and
  limit (`$X spent of the $Y limit.` / `of the main chat’s $Y limit.`), *Raise limit…*
  while the spend is at the limit (Resume unavailable, reason in the detail), then
  **Paused · cost limit raised** with *Resume*. Resume from any member resumes the
  root, then every side it names (opening unloaded ones). A chat read only from its
  journal shows Resume and lets the helper refuse it at the limit.
- Sub-agent cards, picker rows, child readers and footers say *Paused at cost limit* /
  *Paused*, with no Stop and no spinner/working badge. Sidebar: *Paused · cost limit*.
- The cold journal reader keeps the pause (and a run held across a crash mid-pause
  reads paused, not interrupted).

## B. Sides cannot delegate

`AgentSession.sideDelegationRefusal` refuses `subagent_start`, `subagent_send` and v2
`subagent` in any side (kept or not, any depth) with `read_only`: "Side chats cannot
start or message sub-agents: … Ask in the main chat to delegate this work." It runs
before acceptance (no operation, plan, child or adoption seed). The offered tool list
is unchanged and byte-equal to the parent's (`SideDelegationTests` compares the full
`ToolDefinition`s at depths 1–3), so the prompt-cache prefix is untouched. The side's
hidden note (sent once, after the inherited prefix) now also says it cannot start or
message sub-agents; existing sides keep theirs. Wait, status and Stop remain for
children a 0.1.128 side already owns; their history is unchanged. No UI became dead.

import Foundation

// Which chat is open, and everything that has to be true by the time it is
// on screen: its display loaded or built, its page fetched, its composer
// focused, and the displays of chats nobody is reading let go of.

extension WorkspaceModel {
    /// `focusesComposer` false: the chat opens for a side beside it, which
    /// takes the cursor (`showSide`, `selectSide`).
    func select(_ id: String, revealInSidebar: Bool = true, preserveArchiveSwitch: Bool = false, reopensSide: Bool = true,
                focusesComposer: Bool = true) async {
        guard let item = chats.first(where: { $0.id == id }) else { return }
        releasedHelperSessions.remove(id)
        if item.isSubagent { await openSubagentTab(id); return }
        let focusesComposer = focusesComposer && !item.isSubagent
        if revealInSidebar || preserveArchiveSwitch { quietSidebarReveal = [] }
        // A background request is listed on its own page, not the sidebar:
        // the menu bar's running requests and the report open it there.
        if item.isBackgroundTask { openBackgroundRequests(selecting: id); return }
        if reselectOpenChat(id, item: item, revealInSidebar: revealInSidebar) {
            do { try await attachManagedSubagent(item) }
            catch is CancellationError { }
            catch { displays[id]?.notice = error.localizedDescription }
            return
        }
        let (view, selection, heldRows) = prepareSelection(id, item: item, revealInSidebar: revealInSidebar, preserveArchiveSwitch: preserveArchiveSwitch,
                                                           focusesComposer: focusesComposer)
        restoreShownSide(of: id, selection: selection, reopensSide: reopensSide)
        releaseUnreadDisplays(keeping: id)
        let generation = view.presentationGeneration
        PerformanceProbe.shared.observe("selectionLoadingFeedbackMs", milliseconds: PerformanceProbe.now - view.presentation.startedAt)
        let task = Task { [weak self, weak view] in
            guard let self, let view else { return }
            await self.loadSelectedChat(id, item: item, into: view, selection: selection, generation: generation, heldRows: heldRows,
                                        focusesComposer: focusesComposer)
        }
        navigationTask = task; view.presentation.navigation = task
        await withTaskCancellationHandler { await task.value } onCancel: { task.cancel() }
    }
    func readerPaneVisibilityChanged() {
        if let id = selectedID, let side = sides[id], !transcriptShows(side.id) {
            displays[side.id]?.retireInitialPresentation()
        }
        resumeVisibleReaders()
    }
    /// Retirement only rejects publication. Still-wanted initial content must
    /// be hydrated under a fresh intent once its reader is visible again.
    /// Defer to the next actor turn so selection/pane mutations have settled.
    func resumeVisibleReaders() {
        DispatchQueue.main.async { [weak self] in
            guard let self, !self.isShutDown else { return }
            for tab in self.tabs.allTabs.compactMap({ $0 as? SubagentTab }) where self.subagentTabIsShown(tab.key) {
                tab.ensureLoaded()
                self.displays[tab.key]?.findHost?.resumeFindNavigation()
            }
            guard self.page == .chats, let id = self.selectedID else { return }
            self.displays[id]?.findHost?.resumeFindNavigation()
            if let side = self.sides[id], self.transcriptShows(side.id) { self.displays[side.id]?.findHost?.resumeFindNavigation() }
            if let view = self.displays[id], view.needsVisibleHistoryLoad,
               let item = self.record(id), !item.isSubagent {
                let held = view.beginHistoryPresentation(), generation = view.presentationGeneration, selection = self.selectionRevision
                let task = Task { [weak self, weak view] in
                    guard let self, let view else { return }
                    await self.loadSelectedChat(id, item: item, into: view, selection: selection,
                        generation: generation, heldRows: held, focusesComposer: false)
                }
                view.presentation.navigation = task
            }
            if let side = self.sides[id], !side.pending, self.transcriptShows(side.id),
               let child = self.record(side.id), let view = self.displays[side.id],
               view.needsVisibleHistoryLoad {
                view.beginHistoryPresentation()
                let generation = view.presentationGeneration
                Task { [weak self, weak view] in
                    guard let self, let view, self.transcriptShows(child.id), view.presentationGeneration == generation else { return }
                    await self.loadSideDisplay(child, view: view)
                }
            }
        }
    }
    /// Opening the chat that is already open, with its page or reading it:
    /// the chat is focused and looked at, and nothing is read again.
    /// Returns whether it was that chat.
    private func reselectOpenChat(_ id: String, item: ChatRecord, revealInSidebar: Bool) -> Bool {
        // A chat whose load ended without a page (nothing is reading it any
        // more) is read again rather than left on "Preparing…" for good.
        if selectedID == id, let selected, selected.historyState != .dormant,
           !(selected.historyState == .loading && selected.presentation.navigation == nil) {
            page = .chats; focusedSessionID = id
            // A run that failed while another app was in front marked this
            // chat; clicking it is looking at it.
            clearFailureMark(sessionID: id)
            if revealInSidebar { revealProjectChat(item) }
            // Keep the transcript idempotent while allowing an expired or
            // missing optional preview to recover after helper eviction.
            if !item.isSubagent, selected.presentation.readyAt != nil { scheduleAutomaticContext(id) }
            return true
        }
        return false
    }
    /// The switch itself, before anything is read: the chat being left stops
    /// its reads, the sidebar shows the new one, and its display, kept or new,
    /// becomes the selection and starts loading. Returns that display, the
    /// selection's revision, and the rows it held.
    private func prepareSelection(_ id: String, item: ChatRecord, revealInSidebar: Bool, preserveArchiveSwitch: Bool,
                                  focusesComposer: Bool) -> (view: SessionDisplay, selection: Int, heldRows: HeldRows) {
        navigationTask?.cancel()
        if let outgoing = selected {
            outgoing.presentation.cancel()
            if let child = sides[outgoing.id] { displays[child.id]?.presentation.cancel() }
        }
        selectionRevision += 1
        let selection = selectionRevision
        let previous = selectedID
        if preserveArchiveSwitch {
            setProjectExpanded(item.workspaceID, expanded: true)
            if let topicID = effectiveTopicID(for: item) { setTopicExpanded(topicID, expanded: true) }
        } else if revealInSidebar { revealProjectChat(item) }
        PerformanceProbe.shared.count("sessionSelectionCalls")
        PerformanceProbe.shared.beginSelection(id, hasHistory: item.path != nil)
        let view = displays[id] ?? SessionDisplay(id: id)
        // Rows from a run that finished while the chat was in the background
        // are not kept on the page: they are the run as the reader left it,
        // and they would change under the reader when the finished page came.
        // The chat opens as a chat opened for the first time does.
        if view.hasPresentedRows, view.heldRowsOutlived { view.messages = []; view.presentation.identity = nil }
        let held = view.beginHistoryPresentation()
        view.contextSelectionReady = false; view.browsingHistory = true
        view.draftReady = false
        view.used = Date(); displays[id] = view
        adoptContextReading(view, item: item)
        // Opened for a side beside it, which takes the cursor, the chat's
        // composer does not: no request is made for it below, and the
        // composer made anew for the switch does not act on the last one an
        // earlier visit made. Either, acted on once the side had the cursor,
        // put it back in the chat, and the side never took it.
        view.composerFocusSettled = focusesComposer ? 0 : view.composerFocusRequest
        selectedID = id; selected = view; profileChoice = item.profileID
        focusedSessionID = id; page = .chats
        // An empty New chat is dropped once the next chat is in its place, so
        // the selection changes once: through nil first, it read as a second
        // navigation to anything waiting on this one (`revealMessage`).
        if let previous, previous != id, isPendingEmpty(previous) { discardPendingChat(previous) }
        view.publishTranscript()
        clearFailureMark(sessionID: id)
        if item.workspaceID != WorkspaceRecord.scratchID { selectedWorkspaceID = item.workspaceID }
        return (view, selection, held)
    }
    /// The side shown beside this chat comes back with it: the one open in
    /// this launch, or else the saved side it showed when the app last
    /// closed (`WorkspaceLaunchSelection.swift`).
    private func restoreShownSide(of id: String, selection: Int, reopensSide: Bool) {
        var shownSide: (child: ChatRecord, view: SessionDisplay)?
        if let info = sides[id], let sideView = displays[info.id], let child = record(info.id) {
            sideView.beginHistoryPresentation(); sideView.browsingHistory = true
            sideView.draftReady = info.pending
            sideView.publishTranscript()
            shownSide = (child, sideView)
        } else if reopensSide, sides[id] == nil, !installPreparing, let child = rememberedSide(of: id) {
            shownSide = (child, mountSide(child, beside: id))
        }
        if case let (child, sideView)? = shownSide {
            // Nor does the side's composer, made anew beside it, act on an
            // earlier visit's request: the chat takes the cursor, or whoever
            // opened the chat for this side gives it to the side.
            sideView.composerFocusSettled = sideView.composerFocusRequest
            let sideGeneration = sideView.presentationGeneration
            Task { [weak self, weak sideView] in
                guard let self, let sideView, self.selectedID == id, self.sides[id]?.id == child.id,
                      self.selectionRevision == selection, sideView.presentationGeneration == sideGeneration else { return }
                await self.loadSideDisplay(child, view: sideView)
            }
        }
    }
    /// The displays of chats nobody is reading are let go of, least recently
    /// used first, until no more than eight are kept.
    func releaseUnreadDisplays(keeping id: String) {
        // A new chat that was never sent has nothing written anywhere (see
        // `materializeChat`): its display is the only place its draft lives,
        // so it is not let go of while it holds one.
        // Imports belong to this exact composer; keep it until its images
        // have arrived, even off screen.
        for other in displays.values.sorted(by: { $0.used < $1.used }) where displays.count > 8 && other.id != id && !other.hasWork && !other.loading
            && subagentTab(other.id) == nil && other.imageImports == 0 && other.id != record(id)?.delegation?.budgetOwnerSessionID
            && !(pendingChatIDs.contains(other.id) && !isPendingEmpty(other.id)) && !sides.values.contains(where: { $0.id == other.id || $0.parentID == other.id }) {

+import XCTest
+@testable import PiApp
+
+/// How a family paused at its shared cost limit reads (owner, 2026-10-16):
+/// the card with spend and limit, Raise limit… until the limit is above the
+/// spend, then Resume; sub-agent cards, picker rows and readers say Paused.
+final class CostPausePresentationTests: XCTestCase {
+    @MainActor private func paused(_ id: String, child: Bool = false) -> SessionDisplay {
+        let view = SessionDisplay(id: id); view.isManagedSubagent = child
+        view.observeRunState(["state":.string("paused"), "runStatus":.string("cancelled"), "queuePaused":.bool(true),
+            "continuable":.bool(!child), "costPaused":.bool(true), "errorCode":.string("cost_limit"),
+            "preflightError":.string("Paused at the cost limit: $0.60 spent of $0.50. Raise the limit above the spend, then choose Resume.")])
+        return view
+    }
+
+    @MainActor func testTheCardOffersRaiseLimitAtTheLimitAndResumeOnlyAfterARaise() throws {
+        let view = paused("main")
+        view.applyCostReading(SessionCostReading(limit: .usd(0.5), spentUSD: 0.6, reportedRequests: 3, unreportedRequests: 2))
+        var card = try XCTUnwrap(view.presentedMessages.last)
+        XCTAssertEqual(card.id, "paused:run:main"); XCTAssertEqual(card.failureCode, SessionDisplay.costPausedCode)
+        XCTAssertEqual(card.text, "$0.60 spent of the $0.50 limit.")
+        XCTAssertEqual(card.detail, "Raise the limit above the spend. Nothing resumes until you choose Resume. 2 requests reported no cost, so the spend may be higher.")
+        XCTAssertFalse(view.offersResume, "Resume is unavailable while the spend is at the limit")
+        XCTAssertEqual(view.runHold, "paused")
+        // Raised: the card changes, and still nothing resumes by itself.

--- side identity ---
import Foundation

// A side chat's requests extend its parent's. Its first request repeats the
// parent's last one (tools, instructions, the conversation so far) and adds
// only what the side asks, so it joins the parent's prompt cache: same tools,
// same cache key, and a hidden note that it is a read-only side instead of a
// shorter tool list. Ours: pi has no side chats; this follows Codex CLI's
// /side, which keeps the parent's tools and cache key and adds a hidden
// boundary message, and Claude Code, which keeps its tools and refuses a call
// when it runs.

extension AgentSession {
    /// A chat opened from another's context that is not a fork of it: open
    /// and kept sides alike, since the origin is journaled with a kept side.
    var isSideChat: Bool { parentInfo["parentSessionId"].text != nil && parentInfo["relationship"].text != "fork" }

    /// The prompt cache this session's requests join: a side joins the cache
    /// its parent's requests went to, any other chat its own (pi's session id).
    var promptCacheSessionID: String {
        guard isSideChat else { return id }
        return parentInfo["cacheSessionId"].text ?? parentInfo["parentSessionId"].text ?? id
    }

    /// Whether requests offer the read-only tool list. A read-only side offers
    /// its parent's list, which has the editing tools when the parent can
    /// edit, and refuses those calls when they run (`sideRefusal`). A chat
    /// that is read-only itself offers the read-only list, as pi removes tools.
    var offersReadOnlyTools: Bool { readOnly && !(isSideChat && parentInfo["parentToolMode"].text == "editing") }

    /// What a read-only side answers to a call of an editing tool, before
    /// anything runs. The app keeps a side read-only; a chat forked from it
    /// can have its editing tools turned on.
    func sideRefusal(_ call: ToolCall) -> AgentError? {
        if let refusal = sideDelegationRefusal(call) { return refusal }
        guard readOnly, isSideChat, Self.editingTools.contains(call.name) else { return nil }
        return AgentError("read_only", "Side chats are read-only: \(call.name) is not available here. To make this change, ask in the main chat, or fork this side with /fork and choose Enable Editing Tools… in the new chat's menu.")
    }
    /// Starting or messaging a sub-agent (owner, 2026-10-16): sides at any
    /// depth never delegate. The offered tools stay the parent's, for its
    /// prompt cache; the call is refused before anything is accepted.
    /// Waiting, status and Stop of children a 0.1.128 side already owns stay.
    static let sideDelegationTools: Set<String> = ["subagent", "subagent_start", "subagent_send"]
    func sideDelegationRefusal(_ call: ToolCall) -> AgentError? {
        guard isSideChat, Self.sideDelegationTools.contains(call.name) else { return nil }
        return AgentError("read_only", "Side chats cannot start or message sub-agents: \(call.name) is not available here. Ask in the main chat to delegate this work.")
    }

    static let sideNote = ContextNote(kind: "side-read-only", text: "This is a side conversation, branched from the conversation above. It is read-only: write, edit and bash are unavailable here, and it cannot start or message sub-agents, so answer from the conversation and the read-only tools.")
    static let editingNote = ContextNote(kind: "editing-on", text: "Editing tools are now on in this conversation: write, edit and bash are available.")

    /// The hidden note the next user message carries, if any. A read-only
    /// side needs its note once, after the history it inherited: its first
    /// message carries it, and it stays in the context, so every later
    /// request repeats the same prefix. It is sent again only when the
    /// context lost it (an edit before it, a compaction that summarized it).
    /// A chat that holds a side's note and has its editing tools on says so.
    func pendingContextNote() -> ContextNote? {
        var scope = context[...]
        // A side's own note follows what it inherited: a side opened from a
        // saved side inherits that side's note, which is not its own.
        if isSideChat, let cutoff = parentInfo["cutoffEntryId"].text, let index = context.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == cutoff }) {
            scope = context[context.index(after: index)...]
        }
        let latest = scope.last(where: { $0.contextNote != nil })?.contextNote?.kind
        if readOnly { return isSideChat && latest != Self.sideNote.kind ? Self.sideNote : nil }
        return latest == Self.sideNote.kind ? Self.editingNote : nil
    }
}

--- automatic context eligible ---
    }
    func displayedContext(_ view: SessionDisplay) -> [String: WireValue] { contextPresentation(view).context }
    private func previewMatchesInput(_ summary: [String: WireValue], view: SessionDisplay) -> Bool {
        guard let expected=view.footer.contextInputIdentity else { return ContextInputIdentity(summary) == nil || view.footer.contextState.isEmpty }
        return ContextInputIdentity(summary) == expected
    }
    private func matchingPreparedContext(_ view: SessionDisplay) -> PreparedContextMetrics? {
        guard let preview = view.footer.preparedContext, let item = record(view.id),
              preview.binding == ContextPreviewBinding(item), preview.configurationRevision == configuration.revision,
              preview.directCommand == view.directCommand, view.editingMessageID == nil, view.queueEditingID == nil,
              preview.params == contextPreviewParams(item,view:view), previewMatchesInput(preview.summary,view:view),
              (preview.summary["mode"]?.string == "active-context") == view.busy,
              Date().timeIntervalSince(preview.createdAt) <= 300 else { return nil }
        return preview
    }

    func automaticContextActivation(_ view: SessionDisplay) -> AutomaticContextActivation {
        AutomaticContextActivation(eligible: automaticContextEligible(view.id),
            binding: record(view.id).map(ContextPreviewBinding.init), configurationRevision: configuration.revision, inputIdentity:view.footer.contextInputIdentity)
    }
    private func automaticContextSignature(_ item: ChatRecord, view: SessionDisplay) -> AutomaticContextSignature {
        AutomaticContextSignature(binding: ContextPreviewBinding(item), params: contextPreviewParams(item, view: view),
                                  configurationRevision: configuration.revision, directCommand: view.directCommand, inputIdentity:view.footer.contextInputIdentity)
    }
    private func automaticContextEligible(_ id: String) -> Bool {
        guard !isShutDown, !installPreparing, page == .chats, (focusedSessionID ?? selectedID) == id, !pendingChatIDs.contains(id),
              let item = record(id), let view = displays[id], !view.loading,
              view.contextSelectionReady || (side(id) != nil && opened.contains(id)),
              !item.imported, !item.isArchived, !item.isBackgroundTask,
              !view.hasWork, view.runState == .idle, !view.uncertain, view.recovered.isEmpty, view.editingMessageID == nil, view.queueEditingID == nil,
              !workspaceChangesInFlight.contains(item.workspaceID), let workspace = workspace(for: item.workspaceID), workspace.trusted,
              let profile = profiles.first(where: { $0.id == item.profileID }), profile.api == LiteLLMConfiguration.supportedAPI,
              !LeadingCommand.begins(view.draft, directInput: view.directCommand) else { return false }
        return true
    }
    func requireAutomaticContext(_ id: String) throws {
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        guard automaticContextEligible(id) else { throw CancellationError() }
    }
    /// Selecting a chat previews after a short pause; typing waits longer so
    /// the helper is not asked to recount the draft on every keystroke.
    static let selectionPreviewDelay: Duration = .milliseconds(180)
    static let typingPreviewDelay: Duration = .milliseconds(1_500)
    /// Only the focused idle chat counts. Tab changes and draft edits share a
    /// debounce; output deltas do not start fresh preview calculations.
    func scheduleAutomaticContext(_ id: String, delay: Duration = WorkspaceModel.selectionPreviewDelay) {
        guard automaticContextEligible(id), let view = displays[id], let item = record(id) else { cancelAutomaticContext(id); return }
        guard matchingPreparedContext(view) == nil else { cancelAutomaticContext(id); return }
        // The reading the pill shows was counted for this input and still
        // stands: nothing to count, and no helper to open for it. A helper
        // already open for the chat counts at no such cost.
        if !opened.contains(id), servingContextReading(view, forScheduling: true) != nil { cancelAutomaticContext(id); return }
        let signature = automaticContextSignature(item, view: view)
        if let pending = automaticContextTask, pending.id == id, pending.signature == signature { return }
        // A keystroke restarts this chat's own estimate, which stays
        // "calculating" throughout: clearing the flag and setting it again
        // published the footer twice per key, redrawing the context pill,
        // the cost-limit control and the sidebar row with nothing changed.
        if let pending = automaticContextTask, pending.id == id { automaticContextTask = nil; pending.task.cancel() } else { cancelAutomaticContext() }
        let token = UUID(), operation = automaticContextOperation
        if !view.footer.preparingContext { view.footer.preparingContext = true }
        let task = Task { [weak self, weak view] in
            // Coalesce rapid edits and tab traversal before opening the helper.
            do { try await Task.sleep(for: delay) } catch { return }
            guard let self, let view else { return }
            defer {
                if automaticContextTask?.token == token { automaticContextTask = nil; if view.footer.preparingContext { view.footer.preparingContext = false } }
            }
            do {
                try requireAutomaticContext(id)
                guard automaticContextTask?.token == token, automaticContextSignature(record(id) ?? item, view: view) == signature else { return }
                if !opened.contains(id) {
                    // Creating/resuming a runtime is allowed only when no
                    // interrupted work would be repaired or adopted on open.
                    if isEphemeral(id) { return }
                    if let path = item.path, !(try await history.allowsAutomaticContext(path: path, id: id)) { return }
                    if try await store?.get(WireValue.self, kind: "handoff", id: id) != nil { return }
                }
                try requireAutomaticContext(id)
                guard automaticContextTask?.token == token, let current = record(id), automaticContextSignature(current, view: view) == signature else { return }
                if let operation {
                    let result = try await operation(current, signature.params)
                    try requireAutomaticContext(id)
                    guard automaticContextTask?.token == token, displays[id] === view,
                          let latest = record(id), automaticContextSignature(latest, view: view) == signature,
                          previewMatchesInput(result,view:view) else { return }
                    view.footer.preparedContext = PreparedContextMetrics(summary: result, binding: signature.binding,
                        params: signature.params, configurationRevision: signature.configurationRevision, directCommand: signature.directCommand)
                    view.footer.preparingContext = false
                    retainContextReading(view)
                } else {
                    _ = try await preparedContext(id, automatic: true)
                    guard automaticContextTask?.token == token, displays[id] === view else { return }
                    view.footer.preparingContext = false
                    retainContextReading(view)
                }
            } catch {
                // Selection is read-only UI work. A locked key, removed project
                // or unavailable helper must not interrupt chat navigation.
                // Clicking the meter still provides explicit inspection/retry.
            }
        }
        automaticContextTask = AutomaticContextTask(id: id, signature: signature, token: token, task: task)
    }
    func cancelAutomaticContext(_ id: String? = nil) {
        guard let pending = automaticContextTask, id == nil || pending.id == id else { return }

--- park/recovery no missing file ---
import Foundation

/// Reconciliation only. Opening a family never schedules an accepted turn or
/// re-invokes a control/work tool. Parent acceptance is the authority; child
/// terminals, receipt projections and context rows are evidence, not commands.
enum AgentFamilyRecovery {
    static func recover(state: inout SubagentJournalState, parent: SessionJournal, owner: String, directory: URL,
                        accounting: inout AttemptAccounting, spend: inout SessionSpend, costPaused: Bool = false) throws {
        guard state.origin == nil, state.family?.ownerID == owner else { return }
        func write<T: Encodable>(_ kind: String, _ data: T) throws {
            let row: JSON = ["type":"custom","customType":JSON(kind),"ownerID":JSON(owner),"data":try subagentJSON(data)]
            var next = state; try next.consume(row,sessionID:owner)
            try parent.append(row,flush:true); state = next
        }
        func charge(_ kind: String, _ data: JSON) throws {
            var next = accounting, total = spend
            if try next.consume(kind:kind,data:data,spend:&total) {
                try parent.append(["type":"custom","customType":JSON(kind),"data":data],flush:true); accounting = next; spend = total
            }
        }
        // The row can be durable even when its delivery acknowledgement is not.
        for var delivery in Array(state.family!.deliveries.values) where delivery.recipientID == owner && !delivery.committed {
            if let digest = state.family!.contextRows[delivery.rowID] {
                guard digest == deliveryDigest(delivery) else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
                delivery.committed = true; try write(JournalRecordKind.agentDelivery,delivery)
            }
        }
        let plans = (state.callOrder ?? []).compactMap { state.plans[$0] }
        for plan in plans {
            let childID = plan.origin.link.childSessionID
            guard state.family!.latest(childID) != nil else { continue }
            let url = directory.appendingPathComponent(try identity(JSON(childID)) + ".jsonl")
            guard within(canonical(url.path),canonical(directory.path)) else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
            var childState = SubagentJournalState(), childAccounting = AttemptAccounting(), childSpend = SessionSpend()
            var childRows: [String:ChatMessage] = [:], child: SessionJournal?, bytes: UInt64 = 0, markerOnly = true
            let exists = FileManager.default.fileExists(atPath:url.path)
            let completed = state.family!.turns.values.contains { $0.childID == childID && ($0.status == .completed || $0.status == .outputLimited) }
            let dispatched = accounting.attempts.values.contains { $0.admission?["sourceSessionId"].text == childID && $0.admission?["state"].text == "dispatched" }
            guard exists || !completed && !dispatched else {
                throw AgentError("subagent_recovery", "A child journal is missing after possible execution. Restore it before continuing; no accepted work was restarted.")
            }
            if exists {
                try SessionJournal.verifyManagedChild(url:url,id:childID)
                let reader = try JournalRecordReader(url)
                while let row = try reader.next() {
                    if row["type"].text != "session", !JournalRecordKind.isMarker(row["customType"].text) { markerOnly = false }
                    try childState.consume(row,sessionID:childID)
                    if let kind = row["customType"].text { try childAccounting.consume(kind:kind,data:row["data"],spend:&childSpend) }
                    if row["type"].text == "message", let id = row["id"].text { childRows[id] = try ChatMessage(id:id,pi:row["message"]) }
                }
                bytes = reader.size
                guard childState.origin?.matchesAccepted(plan.origin) == true || childState.origin == nil && markerOnly else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
            }
            func childWrite<T: Encodable>(_ kind: String, _ data: T) throws {
                guard exists else { return }
                if child == nil {
                    child = try SessionJournal(url:url,id:childID,cwd:directory,binding:nil,create:false)
                    guard child?.size == bytes else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
                    try child!.promoteToSteering(managedChild:true)
                }
                let row: JSON = ["type":"custom","customType":JSON(kind),"ownerID":JSON(owner),"data":try subagentJSON(data)]
                try childState.consume(row,sessionID:childID); try child!.append(row,flush:true)
            }
            if exists, childState.origin == nil { try childWrite(JournalRecordKind.subagentOrigin,plan.origin) }
            // Validate every mirror against its immutable owning attempt/turn.
            for (id, entry) in childAccounting.attempts {
                guard let cost = entry.contribution else { continue }
                guard let admission = accounting.attempts[id]?.admission,
                      admission["state"].text == "dispatched", admission["sourceSessionId"].text == childID,
                      admission["budgetOwnerSessionId"].text == owner, admission["delegationId"].text == plan.origin.link.delegationID,
                      let scope = try? JSONDecoder().decode(RequestScope.self,from:admission["scope"].data()), scope.valid,
                      scope.delegation == plan.origin.link else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
                if let number = scope.childTurn {
                    guard let turn = state.family!.turns[AgentTurnTarget(childID:childID,turn:number).id], turn.acceptsParentExecution(scope.parentExecutionID) else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
                }
                if let update = try FamilyCharge.merge(cost,into:accounting.attempts[id],revision:accounting.revision,
                    child:.init(accepted:plan.origin,observed:childState.origin),failure:SubagentRecovery.damaged()) {
                    try charge(update.kind,update.data)
                }
            }
            for entry in accounting.attempts.values where entry.admission?["sourceSessionId"].text == childID {
                guard let cost = entry.contribution, let id = cost["attemptId"].text else { continue }
                if let update = try FamilyCharge.merge(cost,into:childAccounting.attempts[id],revision:childAccounting.revision,
                    admission:entry.admission,child:.init(accepted:plan.origin,observed:childState.origin),failure:SubagentRecovery.damaged()) {
                    try childWrite(update.kind,update.data)
                    try childAccounting.consume(kind:update.kind,data:update.data,spend:&childSpend)
                }
            }
            // Owner acceptance may precede the child-side report receipt mirror.
            for op in state.family!.operations.values where op.key.parentSessionID == childID {
                guard let sender = childRows[op.key.assistantMessageID], sender.role == "assistant",
                      sender.content.contains(where: { $0["type"].text == "toolCall" && $0["id"].text == op.key.toolCallID }) else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
                if childState.family?.operations[op.id] == nil { try childWrite(JournalRecordKind.agentOperation,op) }
            }
            for var delivery in Array(state.family!.deliveries.values) where delivery.recipientID == childID && !delivery.committed {
                if let digest = childState.family?.contextRows[delivery.rowID] {
                    guard digest == deliveryDigest(delivery) else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
                    delivery.committed = true; try write(JournalRecordKind.agentDelivery,delivery)
                    try childWrite(JournalRecordKind.agentDelivery,delivery)
                }
            }
            let turns = state.family!.turns.values.filter { $0.childID == childID }.sorted { $0.turn < $1.turn }
            for original in turns {
                if costPaused, !original.status.terminal, !(childState.family?.turns[original.id]?.status.terminal ?? false) {
                    // Paused at the family's cost limit: the turn is held for
                    // Resume, not interrupted. A run cut off mid-pause keeps
                    // its place in the queue; its child mirror agrees.
                    var held = original; held.status = .queued; held.result = nil
                    if held != original { try write(JournalRecordKind.agentTurnState,held) }
                    if let mirror = childState.family?.turns[original.id], mirror != held {
                        for step in held.mirrorSteps(from:mirror) { try childWrite(JournalRecordKind.agentTurnState,step) }
                    }
                    continue
                }
                var terminal = original
                if var evidence = childState.family?.turns[original.id], evidence.status.terminal {
                    // An older helper may seal a child before its accepted
                    // turn was mirrored. The owner's acceptance retains effort.
                    if evidence.effort == nil { evidence.effort = original.effort }
                    guard evidence.executionID == original.executionID, evidence.parentExecutionID == original.parentExecutionID,
                          let result = evidence.result, result.status == evidence.status,
                          result.metadata["sessionId"].text == childID, result.metadata["delegationId"].text == plan.origin.link.delegationID,
                          result.metadata["budgetOwnerSessionId"].text == owner,
                          result.metadata["resultRef"]["messageIds"].list.allSatisfy({ $0.text.map { childRows[$0] != nil } == true }) else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
                    if original.status.terminal { guard original == evidence else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() } }
                    terminal = evidence
                } else if !original.status.terminal {
                    let dispatched = accounting.attempts.values.contains { $0.admission?["sourceSessionId"].text == childID && $0.admission?["scope"]["childTurn"].int == original.turn && $0.admission?["state"].text == "dispatched" }
                    terminal.status = dispatched || original.status == .running || original.status == .stopping ? .interrupted : .notExecuted
                    terminal.result = SubagentToolResult(plan:plan,status:terminal.status,error:AgentError("subagent_interrupted", "The helper stopped before a sealed result. Accepted work was not replayed; inspect effects before following up."),accountingRevision:accounting.revision,began:dispatched)
                    terminal.normalizeResult()
                    try childWrite(JournalRecordKind.agentTerminal,terminal)
                } else {
                    // Publication/open can fail after the queued journal was
                    // created. Preserve the owner's sealed nonexecution result
                    // in that child too; a cold viewer must not remain queued.
                    try childWrite(JournalRecordKind.agentTerminal,terminal)
                }
                if !original.status.terminal { try write(JournalRecordKind.agentTerminal,terminal) }
                let resultID = "result:" + original.id
                if state.family!.messages[resultID] == nil {
                    let message = AgentFamilyMessage.resultEvent(terminal,task:plan.origin.description,sequence:state.family!.sequence + 1)
                    try write(JournalRecordKind.agentMessage,message)
                }
            }
            // Steering for a held turn stays pending; it is delivered after Resume.
            for var message in state.family!.pending(author:"parent") where message.childID == childID && !(costPaused && state.family!.latest(childID)?.status.terminal == false) {
                message.disposition = "not_delivered_interrupted"; try write(JournalRecordKind.agentMessage,message)
                let notice = AgentFamilyMessage(id:"undelivered:" + message.id,sequence:state.family!.sequence + 1,childID:childID,turn:message.turn,author:"subagent",kind:"not_delivered_interrupted",text:"Parent message \(message.id) is retained but was not delivered before interruption.",task:message.task,epoch:message.epoch,replyTo:message.id)
                if state.family!.messages[notice.id] == nil { try write(JournalRecordKind.agentMessage,notice) }
            }
            // Migration copies contain private bodies too; remove only this
            // exact managed sibling while holding/validating family authority.
            try? FileManager.default.removeItem(at:url.appendingPathExtension("promotion"))
        }
        for entry in Array(accounting.attempts.values) {
            if entry.contribution == nil, var admission = entry.admission, admission["state"].text == "admitted" {
                admission["state"] = "not_dispatched"; admission["accountingRevision"] = JSON(accounting.revision + 1)
                try charge(JournalRecordKind.budgetAttempt,admission)
            }
        }
        if var run = state.family!.run, !run.closed { run.closed = true; try write(JournalRecordKind.familyRun,run) }
    }
    static func deliveryDigest(_ delivery: AgentDelivery) -> String { sha256(Data(JSON.array([textBlock(delivery.payload.encoded())]).encoded().utf8)) }
}

extension AgentChildTurn {
    /// The records that bring a child's mirror of this (unsealed) turn up to
    /// the owner's: one per continuation it has not seen, then the status.
    func mirrorSteps(from mirror: AgentChildTurn) -> [AgentChildTurn] {
        let known = mirror.continuations ?? [], all = continuations ?? []
        guard all.count >= known.count, Array(all.prefix(known.count)) == known else { return [self] }
        var steps: [AgentChildTurn] = [], step = self
        for count in stride(from:known.count + 1, through:all.count, by:1) {
            step.continuations = Array(all.prefix(count)); step.status = .queued; step.result = nil; steps.append(step)
        }
        if steps.last != self { steps.append(self) }
        return steps
    }
    mutating func normalizeResult() {
        guard result != nil else { return }
        result?.envelope["version"] = 3; result?.envelope["child_id"] = JSON(childID); result?.envelope["turn"] = JSON(turn)
        result?.metadata["version"] = 2; result?.metadata["turn"] = JSON(turn); result?.metadata["executionID"] = JSON(executionID)
        result?.metadata["parentAssistantMessageId"] = JSON(call.assistantMessageID); result?.metadata["toolCallId"] = JSON(call.toolCallID)
        if let effort { result?.envelope["effort"] = JSON(effort); result?.metadata["effort"] = JSON(effort) }
        result?.messageID = nil
    }
}
extension AgentFamilyMessage {
    static func resultEvent(_ turn: AgentChildTurn, task: String, sequence: Int) -> Self {
        let full = turn.result?.envelope["text"].text ?? "", text = SubagentToolResult.bounded(full,bytes:8192)
        var event = Self(id:"result:" + turn.id,sequence:sequence,childID:turn.childID,turn:turn.turn,author:"subagent",kind:"result",text:text,task:task,epoch:turn.epoch)
        event.result = turn.result?.envelope.removing(["text"]); event.result?["text_truncated"] = JSON(text.utf8.count < full.utf8.count)
        return event
    }
}

import AppKit

// Side panels are durable child chats. A recovery intent precedes journal
// publication so an interrupted acknowledgement cannot orphan saved history.
struct SideRecord: Identifiable, Equatable {
    var id: String; var parentID: String; var workspaceID: String; var profileID: String; var title: String
    var kept = false; var keeping = false; var keepRequested = false
    /// Open on screen only; the helper session and journal appear with its first message.
    var pending = false
    var boundary: [String: WireValue] = [:]
    /// Model and reasoning overrides inherited from the parent when the side opens.
    var model: String? = nil
    var thinkingLevel: String? = nil
    var contextWindow: Int? = nil
    var maxOutputTokens: Int? = nil
    var modelOutputLimit: Int? = nil
    var outputBudgetVersion: Int? = 1
    var topicID: String?
    /// Legacy value retained for decoding only; sides follow the main budget.
    var costLimit: CostLimit? = nil
    /// What follows its chat's title in a new side's, until its first
    /// message names it.
    static let titleSuffix = " — side"
    var chat: ChatRecord { .init(id: id, workspaceID: workspaceID, title: title, path: nil, profileID: profileID, toolMode: ChatRecord.readOnlyTools, model: model, thinkingLevel: thinkingLevel, contextWindow: contextWindow, maxOutputTokens: maxOutputTokens, modelOutputLimit: modelOutputLimit, outputBudgetVersion: outputBudgetVersion, topicID: topicID, parentSessionID: parentID, costLimit: costLimit) }
}
struct SideKeepIntent: Codable, Sendable {
    /// Attachment discovery only: never listed for automatic registration.
    static let retainedKind = "side-keep-retained"
    var chat: ChatRecord
}

/// The exact pending copy consumed by a successful registration. A delayed
/// caller can acknowledge it without replaying chat/draft writes.
struct SideKeepRegistration: Codable, Sendable {
    static let kind = "side-keep-registration"
    var expected: ChatRecord
    var path: String?
}

enum SideKeepState: Sendable {
    case pending(SideKeepIntent)
    case registered(chat: ChatRecord, expected: ChatRecord)
    case missing
}

extension WorkspaceModel {
    /// Both are asked for once per sidebar row, and the sidebar redraws on every
    /// workspace change: a linear scan here is a scan of every chat per row.
    func side(_ id: String) -> SideRecord? { sidebarIndex.side(id, in: sides) }
    func record(_ id: String) -> ChatRecord? { chatRecord(id) ?? side(id)?.chat }
    func isEphemeral(_ id: String) -> Bool { side(id).map { !$0.kept } ?? false }
    var resourceTarget: SessionDisplay? { displays[resourceTargetSessionID ?? selectedID ?? ""] }
    /// The Session Inspector at the session's latest request: 🐞, ⌥⌘I and the chat's ⋯ menu.
    func inspect(_ id: String) { openInspector(session: id, focus: .latestRequest) }
    /// Shows or hides the integrated terminal under the selected chat.
    func toggleTerminal() {
        guard selectedID != nil else { return }
        terminalVisible.toggle()
        if !terminalVisible, let id = focusedSessionID ?? selectedID { displays[id]?.composerFocusRequest += 1 }
    }
    func inspectResources(_ id: String?) { resourceTargetSessionID = id; showResources = true }
    func updateHostActivity(workspaceID: String) {
        hosts[workspaceID]?.isBusy = sides.values.contains { $0.workspaceID == workspaceID && !$0.kept && !$0.pending } || displays.values.contains { ($0.hasWork || $0.loading) && record($0.id)?.workspaceID == workspaceID }
    }
    func canOpenSide(_ id: String) -> Bool {
        guard let parent = record(id), !parent.isSubagent, orphanedSideRefusal(id) == nil else { return false }
        return !parent.imported && parent.connectionTest != true && parent.workspaceID != WorkspaceRecord.scratchID
    }
    /// A saved side whose chat was deleted stays in the sidebar as a chat of
    /// its own, and opens no side of its own (the owner's choice, 0.1.116).
    /// A saved side is known by its journal, `side_‹id›.jsonl`: a chat forked
    /// from a reply also names the chat it came from, and keeps its sides.
    func orphanedSideRefusal(_ id: String) -> String? {
        guard let chat = record(id), let parentID = chat.parentSessionID, record(parentID) == nil,
              let path = chat.path, URL(fileURLWithPath: path).lastPathComponent.hasPrefix("side_") else { return nil }
        return "The chat this side was opened from was deleted, so it can't open sides of its own."
    }
    func canQuoteReply(_ id: String) -> Bool {
        guard !installPreparing, canOpenSide(id), side(id) == nil, let parent = record(id),
              !parent.isArchived, !parent.isBackgroundTask, workspace(for: parent.workspaceID) != nil else { return false }
        return true
    }
    /// Selection is quoted as unsent prose, never interpreted as a slash/skill
    /// command. Reuse an unfinished side draft without overwriting it; a saved
    /// side keeps its history while a new child opens beside the parent.
    func openQuotedSide(parentID: String, quote: TranscriptQuote) {
        guard selectedID == parentID, canQuoteReply(parentID), !quote.text.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty else { return }
        let existing = sides[parentID]
        if let existing, existing.keeping || (!existing.pending && !existing.kept) || displays[existing.id]?.loading == true {
            error = "Wait for the current side to finish opening before quoting another response."; return
        }
        let existingDraft = existing.flatMap { $0.pending ? displays[$0.id]?.draft : nil } ?? ""
        let quoted = quote.text.replacingOccurrences(of: "\r\n", with: "\n").replacingOccurrences(of: "\r", with: "\n")
            .components(separatedBy: "\n").map { "> " + $0 }.joined(separator: "\n")
        let draft = existingDraft + (existingDraft.isEmpty ? "" : "\n\n") + quoted + "\n\n"
        guard draft.utf8.count <= SubmissionLimits.messageBytes else { error = "The quoted draft exceeds 256 KiB. Select a shorter passage."; return }
        openSide(parentID: parentID)
        guard let info = sides[parentID], info.pending, let view = displays[info.id] else { return }
        view.draft = draft; view.directCommand = false; view.completionVisible = false; view.completionToken = nil
        draftChanged(view)
        focusedSessionID = info.id; view.composerFocusRequest += 1
    }
    func openSide(parentID: String? = nil, question: String = "") {
        guard !installPreparing, let parentID = parentID ?? selectedID, let parent = record(parentID), !parent.imported else { error = "Continue an imported original as a separate chat before opening a side."; return }
        // A new side opens beside its chat, which is on screen: the sidebar
        // unfolds nothing for it. A side list the reader folded stays folded,
        // the new side listed under the fold (owner, 2026-10-12).
        quietSidebarReveal = sidebarLineage(of: parentID)
        if let refusal = orphanedSideRefusal(parentID) { error = refusal; return }
        guard canOpenSide(parentID) else { error = "Connection-test chats keep tools disabled and cannot open side chats."; return }
        guard side(parentID) == nil else { error = "Close this side panel before opening a side from its saved chat."; return }
        // Another side can open while one is shown: the shown side stays a
        // saved child chat in the sidebar and comes back on click. Only a side
        // that is still being published must finish first.
        if let existing = sides[parentID], existing.pending {
            // The empty side is already waiting for its first message.
            quietSidebarReveal.insert(existing.id)
            focusedSessionID = existing.id; displays[existing.id]?.composerFocusRequest += 1
            if !question.isEmpty { displays[existing.id]?.draft = question; send(sessionID: existing.id) }
            return
        }
        if let existing = sides[parentID], !existing.kept || existing.keeping {
            quietSidebarReveal.insert(existing.id)
            focusedSessionID = existing.id
            error = "Wait for the current side to finish opening before starting another."; return
        }
        let id = UUID().uuidString, view = SessionDisplay(id: id)
        quietSidebarReveal.insert(id)
        view.historyState = .empty; view.selectionMetadataLoaded = true
        var info = SideRecord(id: id, parentID: parentID, workspaceID: parent.workspaceID, profileID: parent.profileID, title: parent.title + SideRecord.titleSuffix, model: parent.model, thinkingLevel: parent.thinkingLevel, contextWindow: parent.contextWindow, maxOutputTokens: parent.maxOutputTokens, modelOutputLimit: parent.modelOutputLimit, outputBudgetVersion: parent.outputBudgetVersion)
        info.topicID = effectiveTopicID(for: parent)
        if question.isEmpty {
            // Nothing is created until the first message: no intent, journal or helper session.
            info.pending = true; sides[parentID] = info
            displays[id] = view
            if selectedID == parentID { focusedSessionID = id }
            view.composerFocusRequest += 1
            return
        }
        sides[parentID] = info
        displays[id] = view; view.loading = true; view.draft = question
        Task {
            do {
                try await publishPendingSide(info, view: view)
                // This flag was set here, for the side's creation; the send
                // below sets its own.
                view.loading = false
                view.draft = question; send(sessionID: id)
            } catch {
                view.loading = false; view.notice = error.localizedDescription
                // Unwind the in-memory side for every failure, not only an
                // explicit rejection. A side left half-open can be neither
                // closed nor kept, and while it exists the app refuses to quit
                // and blocks every update. The saved side-keep intent still
                // lets a side the host did publish be recovered on restart.
                // Only this side: a lost host may already have put another
                // in its place holding what was typed here.
                let replaced = sides[parentID].map { $0.id != id } ?? false
                if !replaced { sides.removeValue(forKey: parentID) }
                displays.removeValue(forKey: id)
                if !replaced, let original = displays[parentID] {
                    if let recovery = draftWrites.recoveries[parentID] { await recovery.value }
                    original.draft += (original.draft.isEmpty ? "" : "\n\n") + question; original.directCommand = false; draftChanged(original)
                }
                self.error = error.localizedDescription; updateHostActivity(workspaceID: parent.workspaceID)
            }
        }
    }
    /// Creates the side on the helper: the recovery intent and draft, the
    /// parent's context snapshot as a durable child session, and its capture
    /// preference. Called when a side with a question opens, and when a
    /// pending side sends its first message.
    /// `draft` is what the kept side starts with on disk: the message being
    /// sent, whose composer has already emptied (`send`), else what the
    /// composer holds.
    func publishPendingSide(_ info: SideRecord, view: SessionDisplay, draft: DraftRecord? = nil) async throws {
        guard let store else { throw StoreError.unavailable }
        guard let parent = record(info.parentID) else { throw HostError.failure("The parent chat is no longer available.") }
        let id = info.id, parentID = info.parentID
        // A send that publishes the side holds this flag for the whole
        // submission. Clearing it here, with the first message still on its
        // way, let Send submit that message a second time.
        let wasLoading = view.loading
        view.loading = true; defer { if !wasLoading { view.loading = false } }
        var saved = info.chat
        saved.topicID = effectiveTopicID(for: parent)
        saved.path = root.appendingPathComponent("Workspaces/\(info.workspaceID)/Sessions/side_\(id).jsonl").path
        try await store.put(SideKeepIntent(chat: saved), kind: "side-keep", id: id)
        try await store.put(draft ?? DraftRecord(id: id, text: view.draft), kind: "draft", id: id)
        let host = try await open(parent); host.isBusy = true
        sides[parentID]?.pending = false
        let result: [String: WireValue]
        var written = false
        do {
            // Sides share the main chat’s budget.
            result = try await host.request("side.open", sessionID: parentID, params: ["sideSessionId": .string(id)]).object ?? [:]

            // the helper did write is still recovered from its intent; one it
            // refused leaves nothing behind, since a draft side's text is
            // never stored.
            if sides[parentID]?.id == id, sides[parentID]?.kept != true { sides[parentID]?.pending = true }
