import Foundation

extension WorkspaceModel {
    /// Side panes and copied transcript views also need the cached child names.
    /// Only seed newly inserted displays; progress updates keep their identity.
    func seedSubagentNumbers(replacing previous: [String: SessionDisplay]) {
        let added = displays.filter { previous[$0.key] !== $0.value }
        guard !added.isEmpty else { return }
        let numbers = Dictionary(chats.compactMap { chat in chat.subagentNumber.map { (chat.id, $0) } }, uniquingKeysWith: { first, _ in first })
        for display in added.values {
            display.subagentNumbers.merge(numbers, uniquingKeysWith: { _, saved in saved })
            display.subagentEfforts = subagentEfforts
            display.subagentCosts = budgetStates.reduce(into: [:]) { result, entry in
                if record(entry.key)?.delegation?.budgetOwnerSessionID == display.id, entry.value.reading.spentUSD != nil {
                    result[entry.key] = SubagentCostPresentation(costReading(for:entry.key))
                }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Recover child metadata without starting a helper or resuming any run.
    /// The scan is actor-isolated; only validated small identities reach UI.
    func reconcileSubagents(parentID: String? = nil) async {
        guard store != nil else { return }
        let projects = parentID.flatMap { record($0)?.workspaceID }.map { Set([$0]) } ?? Set(workspaces.map(\.id) + chats.map(\.workspaceID))
        for project in projects where project != WorkspaceRecord.scratchID {
            do {
                let directory = try subagentDirectory(project)
                let found = try await history.discoverSubagents(directory: directory, parents: chats.filter { $0.workspaceID == project })
                guard !Task.isCancelled, !isShutDown else { return }
                for child in found where parentID == nil || child.header.link.budgetOwnerSessionID == parentID {
                    try await registerDiscoveredSubagent(child, workspaceID: project)
                }
            } catch is CancellationError { return }
            catch { self.error = "Sub-agent history could not be reconciled. " + error.localizedDescription }
        }
    }

    func registerDiscoveredSubagent(_ found: DiscoveredSubagent, workspaceID: String, live: SubagentSummary? = nil, connection: UUID? = nil) async throws {
        guard let store, !deletingFamilies.contains(found.header.link.budgetOwnerSessionID),
              let child = try await store.registerSubagent(found, workspaceID: workspaceID) else { return }
        guard !isShutDown, !deletingFamilies.contains(found.header.link.budgetOwnerSessionID) else { return }
        try Task.checkCancellation()
        if let connection, hosts[workspaceID]?.connectionID != connection { throw CancellationError() }
        publishSubagentMetadata(child)
        publishSubagentEffort(found.header.model, child: child)
        // No terminal row means only "interrupted if restored", not evidence
        // that an attached child has stopped. Do not discard live progress on
        // a topic move, archive/restore or repeated discovery.
        let previous = subagentSummaries[child.id]
        let retained = previous.flatMap { value in
            value.link == found.header.link && value.revision > 0 &&
                ((value.turn ?? 1) > (found.turn ?? 1) || ((value.turn ?? 1) == (found.turn ?? 1) && (!found.hasTerminalRecord || value.status == found.status))) ? value : nil
        }
        let summary = live ?? retained ?? SubagentSummary(link: found.header.link, description: found.header.description, model: found.header.model.model, status: found.status, revision: 0, turn: found.turn, executionID: found.executionID, effort: found.effort ?? found.header.model.thinkingLevel)
        if let live, let previous, !live.supersedes(previous) { return }
        if subagentSummaries[child.id] != summary { subagentSummaries[child.id] = summary }
        if live != nil { observeSubagentCost(summary) }
        if let owner = displays[summary.link.budgetOwnerSessionID], owner.childSummaries[child.id] != summary { owner.childSummaries[child.id] = summary }
        displays[child.id]?.isManagedSubagent = true
        displays[child.id]?.subagentStatus = summary.status
        displays[child.id]?.subagentTurn = summary.turn
        if let issue = child.delegationIssue { displays[child.id]?.notice = issue }
        // Terminal or newly created content is indexed by the normal search
        // scheduler. Streamed progress never reaches this registration path.
    }

    func publishSubagentMetadata(_ child: ChatRecord) {
        if let at = chats.firstIndex(where: { $0.id == child.id }) {
            let current = child.merged(over: chats[at])
            if chats[at] != current { chats[at] = current }
        }
        else { chats.append(child) }
        if let number = child.subagentNumber {
            for display in displays.values where display.subagentNumbers[child.id] != number {
                display.subagentNumbers[child.id] = number
            }
        }
    }

    func interruptSubagents(workspaceID: String) {
        for child in chats where child.workspaceID == workspaceID && child.isSubagent {
            // A turn held at its family's cost limit is not running: the
            // helper's loss leaves it waiting for Resume, not interrupted.
            guard var summary = subagentSummaries[child.id], !summary.status.terminal, summary.costPaused != true else { continue }
            summary.status = .interrupted; summary.revision = 0; summary.progress = nil; summary.progressEpoch = nil
            subagentSummaries[child.id] = summary; displays[child.id]?.subagentStatus = .interrupted
            displays[summary.link.budgetOwnerSessionID]?.childSummaries[child.id] = summary
        }
    }

    /// Shows a saved child chat in the side pane of its parent, replacing the
    /// side shown there. The replaced side keeps its display and any running

    func showSide(_ id: String, revealInSidebar: Bool = true) async {

    /// Puts a saved child chat in its parent's side pane, waiting to be read.

    }

    /// its display, mirroring what selecting a chat does for the main pane.
    func loadSideDisplay(_ child: ChatRecord, view: SessionDisplay) async {
        let id = child.id, generation = view.presentationGeneration, navigation = transcriptNavigation(child.id)
        let paneIntent = tabs.navigationRevision
        let task = Task { [weak self, weak view] in
            guard let self, let view else { return }
            defer { view.finishHistoryPresentation(generation); self.resumeVisibleReaders() }
            @MainActor func current() -> Bool { !Task.isCancelled && navigation.isCurrent(in: self) && self.tabs.navigationRevision == paneIntent && self.selectedID == child.parentSessionID && self.sides[child.parentSessionID ?? ""]?.id == id && self.displays[id] === view && view.presentationGeneration == generation }
            do {
                await self.readInheritedSubagents(child, current: current)
                guard current() else { return }
                let oldDraft = view.savedDraft
                let metadata = try await self.store?.selectionMetadata(id: id, draft: !view.selectionMetadataLoaded, anchor: !view.selectionMetadataLoaded && view.scrollAnchor == nil)
                guard current() else { return }
                if !view.selectionMetadataLoaded {
                    if let draft = metadata?.draft, view.draft == oldDraft.text && view.attachments == (oldDraft.attachments ?? []) && view.skills == (oldDraft.skills ?? []),
                       view.draft.isEmpty && view.attachments.isEmpty && view.skills.isEmpty && view.editingMessageID == nil && view.queueEditingID == nil { view.restoreDraft(draft); if let queued = draft.queuedEdit { Task { await self.reconcileQueuedEdit(view, queued) } } }
                    if view.scrollAnchor == nil { view.scrollAnchor = metadata?.anchor }
                    view.selectionMetadataLoaded = true
                }
                let recovered = try await self.recoverableIntents(metadata?.recovered ?? [], for: child, view: view)
                guard current() else { return }
                view.recovered = recovered; view.uncertain = !recovered.isEmpty
                view.draftReady = true
                if self.focusedSessionID == id { view.composerFocusRequest += 1 }
                var page = try await self.readInitialWindow(child, holding: view.scrollAnchor)
                guard current() else { return }
                page.messages = await self.withAccounting(page.messages, view: view, workspaceID: child.workspaceID)
                guard current() else { return }
                self.adoptInitialHistory(page, into: view)
                if self.opened.contains(id) { self.refresh(id) }
            } catch is CancellationError {
                if current() { view.historyState = .failed("History reading was interrupted. Try loading it again.") }
            }
            catch { if current() { view.historyState = .failed(error.localizedDescription); view.refreshingCachedRows = false; view.notice = error.localizedDescription } }
        }
        view.presentation.navigation = task
        await withTaskCancellationHandler { await task.value } onCancel: { task.cancel() }
    }

    }

    /// The chat's reading with its current limit and what its helper last
    /// said of its spend.
    func costReading(for id: String) -> SessionCostReading {
        var reading = budgetStates[id]?.reading ?? displays[id]?.footer.cost ?? SessionCostReading()
        if reading.budgetOwnerID != nil { reading.costAttribution = nil }
        reading.budgetOwnerID = nil; reading.budgetSpentUSD = nil
        reading.override = record(id).map { budgetOwner(for: $0).costLimit } ?? nil; reading.defaultLimit = defaultCostLimit; reading.limit = costLimit(for: id)
        if let item = record(id) {
            let owner = budgetOwner(for: item)
            if owner.id != id {
                reading.budgetOwnerID = owner.id
                reading.budgetSpentUSD = budgetStates[owner.id]?.reading.spentUSD ?? displays[owner.id]?.footer.cost.spentUSD
                reading.costAttribution = "Counts toward " + owner.title
            }
        }
        return reading
    }
    /// Puts a chat's limit on its display: the footer's figure and the stop notice.
    func refreshCostReading(_ id: String) {
        let reading = costReading(for:id)
        if let budget = budgetStates[id], budget.reading != reading { budget.reading = reading }

        if let owner = record(id)?.delegation?.budgetOwnerSessionID, let display = displays[owner] {
            let value = reading.spentUSD == nil ? nil : SubagentCostPresentation(reading)
            if display.subagentCosts[id] != value { display.subagentCosts[id] = value }
        }
    }

    /// Coalesced cost-only use of the existing status read. No transcript
    /// display is allocated; a retired host/runtime cannot publish a late reply.
    func refreshBudgetState(_ id: String) {
        guard let item = record(id), opened.contains(id), let host = hosts[item.workspaceID], host.isReady else { return }
        let state = budgetState(for:id); state.dirty = true
        guard state.readTask == nil else { return }
        let connection = host.connectionID
        let readID = UUID(); state.readID = readID
        state.readTask = Task { [weak self, weak state] in
            guard let self, let state else { return }
            defer { if state.readID == readID { state.readTask = nil } }
            while state.dirty, !Task.isCancelled, !isShutDown {
                state.dirty = false
                do {
                    let snapshot = try await host.request("session.status",sessionID:id,params:["budgetOnly":.bool(true)]).object ?? [:]
                    guard !Task.isCancelled, state.readID == readID, opened.contains(id), hosts[item.workspaceID] === host,
                          host.connectionID == connection, budgetStates[id] === state else { return }
                    observeCost(snapshot,sessionID:id)
                } catch { return }
            }
        }
    }

    /// Sets a chat's own limit, or with nil lets it follow the default. The
    /// choice is saved with the chat and reaches its helper session at once:
    /// the next model request is checked against it, in a run that is going too.
    func setCostLimit(_ limit: CostLimit?, for id: String) async throws {
        guard let item = record(id), budgetOwner(for: item).id == id else { throw HostError.failure("This chat uses its parent’s cost limit. Change the limit in the parent.") }
        if let limit, !limit.isValid { throw HostError.failure("Enter an amount in US dollars above $0.00, up to $1,000,000.00.") }
        // An editor can choose again before the previous write finishes.
        // Compare with the saved value only after that choice settles, so
        // choosing A → B → A does not mistake the last A for a no-op.
        let previous = costLimitWrites[id]?.task, token = UUID()
        let task = Task { [weak self] in
            _ = await previous?.result
            guard let self else { return }
            try await self.persistCostLimit(limit, for: id)
        }
        costLimitWrites[id] = (token, task)
        defer { if costLimitWrites[id]?.token == token { costLimitWrites[id] = nil } }
        try await task.value
        // Only persistence is serialized: a slow helper acknowledgement
        // must not hold up the next choice's save or publication.
        await sendCostLimit(id)
    }

    /// Tells a chat's loaded helper session the limit it runs under. A chat
    /// with no session loaded is told when one opens (`costLimitParams`).
    func sendCostLimit(_ id: String) async {
        guard opened.contains(id), let item = record(id), budgetOwner(for: item).id == id, let host = hosts[item.workspaceID], host.isReady else { return }
        let limit = costLimit(for: item)
        budgetState(for:id).limitSent = limit
        displays[id]?.costLimitSent = limit
        // A failed send is not retried from here: the next change sends again,
        // and a snapshot showing the old limit asks only for a limit not yet tried.
        do { _ = try await host.request("session.configure", sessionID: id, params: ["costLimit": limit.wire]) }
        catch { displays[id]?.notice = "The new cost limit did not reach this chat's helper: " + error.localizedDescription }
        refresh(id)
    }
    /// What a session open carries: the chat's limit, and for a chat whose
    /// journal predates cost records, what the request log holds of its spend

    func costLimitParams(for item: ChatRecord) async -> [String: WireValue] {
        let limit = costLimit(for: item)

    private func costSeed(for item: ChatRecord) async -> WireValue? {
        if let costSeedRead { return await costSeedRead(item) }
        // A chat whose journal the helper creates records every cost from its first request.
        guard item.path != nil else { return nil }
        // The helper adopts saved-side journals separately. A family footer
        // here would seed those same physical attempts a second time.
        let totals = try? await traces.sessionMetrics(sessionID: item.id, workspaceID: item.workspaceID, until: Date(), includeFamily: false).gateway
        guard let totals, totals.requests > 0 else { return nil }
        let reported = max(0, totals.costSamples)
        return .object(["usd": .number(reported > 0 ? max(0, totals.costUSD ?? 0) : 0), "reported": .number(Double(reported)),
                        "unreported": .number(Double(max(0, totals.requests - reported)))])
    }

    func observeCost(_ snapshot: [String: WireValue], sessionID id: String) {
        guard let cost = snapshot["cost"]?.object else { return }
        let state = budgetState(for:id)
        if record(id)?.isSubagent == true {
            let revision = cost["accountingRevision"]?.nonnegativeInteger
            if let previous = state.childLedgerRevision, revision.map({ $0 < previous }) ?? true { return }
            if let revision { state.childLedgerRevision = revision }
        }
        // A direct snapshot also fences the progress already received. A
        // repeated list response cannot undo this newer accounting reading.
        if let summary = subagentSummaries[id], let cursor = SubagentCostCursor(summary),
           state.childCostCursor.map({ cursor.follows($0) }) ?? true { state.childCostCursor = cursor }
        let previous = state.reading
        state.paused = cost["paused"]?.bool ?? false
        var reading = costReading(for:id)
        reading.spentUSD = cost["spentUSD"]?.number
        reading.reportedRequests = cost["reportedRequests"]?.nonnegativeInteger ?? 0
        reading.unreportedRequests = cost["unreportedRequests"]?.nonnegativeInteger ?? 0
        if state.reading != reading { state.reading = reading }
        displays[id]?.applyCostReading(reading)
        if reading != previous { refreshBudgetFamily(id) }
        if reading.spentUSD != previous.spentUSD || reading.reportedRequests != previous.reportedRequests || reading.unreportedRequests != previous.unreportedRequests {
            if let owner = record(id)?.delegation?.budgetOwnerSessionID {
                subagentFamilies.removeValue(forKey:owner)
                displays[owner]?.subagentCosts[id] = SubagentCostPresentation(reading)
            }
            noteActivityChanged(id)
        }
        guard let item = record(id), budgetOwner(for: item).id == item.id else { return }
        let helper: CostLimit = cost["limitUSD"]?.number.map(CostLimit.usd) ?? .unlimited
        if helper != reading.limit, state.limitSent != reading.limit {
            state.limitSent = reading.limit
            displays[id]?.costLimitSent = reading.limit
            Task { await sendCostLimit(id) }
        }
    }

    81	        let newest = context.last { $0.role == "user" || ($0.role != "system" && $0.turn?.isEmpty == false) }
    82	        return newest.flatMap { $0.role == "user" ? $0.id : $0.turn } ?? visible.last { $0.role == "user" }?.id
    83	    }
    84	
    85	    /// `run.continue`. `overrides` are the chat's current choices (model,
    86	    /// thinkingLevel, contextWindow, maxOutputTokens, modelOutputLimit, input),
    87	    /// as for a send or a retry; absent keys mean the connection's defaults.
    88	    ///
    89	    /// Idempotent by `commandID`: the receipt is saved with the run state
    90	    /// before the run starts, so the same command sent again — a reply lost
    91	    /// to a helper that then restarted — finds it and runs nothing. A second
    92	    /// Resume with a new identity while this one runs is refused as busy.
    93	    public func continueRun(commandID: String, overrides: JSON = [:]) throws -> JSON {
    94	        try requireIndependentSession()
    95	        try requireAgentExecution()
    96	        guard !closed else { throw AgentError("session_closed", "Session runtime is unloaded") }
    97	        let receiptKey = Self.continuePrefix + commandID
    98	        if let receipt = commands.last(where: { $0["commandId"].text == commandID }) {
    99	            guard receipt["turnId"].text == receiptKey else { throw AgentError("command_conflict", "Command identity already used for another command") }
   100	            return ["accepted": true, "duplicate": true, "continued": true, "state": receipt["state"]]
   101	        }
   102	        guard runTask == nil else { throw AgentError("session_busy", "Run already active") }
   103	        guard queueEdit == nil else { throw Self.editHeldError }
   104	        // A family paused at its limit resumes only below it. Its parked
   105	        // sub-agent turns go on with the run; its sides are named for the app.
   106	        let paused = costPauseState
   107	        var members: [String] = []
   108	        if costPaused {
   109	            try enforceCostLimit()
   110	            members = endCostPause()
   111	        }
   112	        let familyOnly = paused.paused && hasParkedAgentTurns
   113	        let tailContinues = continuationTail.map { Self.continues(from: $0) } ?? false || hasPendingAgentEvents
   114	        // With nothing of its own cut off, the run waits for the resumed
   115	        // family first, as its turn's end did; follow-ups go after it.
   116	        guard !titleTask, !isConnectionTest, tailContinues || familyOnly else {
   117	            if paused.paused, queue.isEmpty, steering.isEmpty {
   118	                // Nothing of its own waits: the pause is over once saved.
   119	                commandState(Submission(commandID: commandID, turnID: receiptKey, text: ""), "completed")
   120	                queuePaused = false
   121	                if state != .error { state = .idle; runStatus = .idle }
   122	                do { try persistState() } catch {
   123	                    commands.removeAll { $0["turnId"].text == receiptKey }; restoreCostPause(paused); queuePaused = true; throw error
   124	                }
   125	                event("state")
   126	                return ["accepted": true, "continued": false, "resumedFamily": true, "pausedMembers": .array(members.map(JSON.string))]
   127	            }
   128	            // Pi: from an answered context (or none: a first message stopped
   129	            // before it was delivered), continue sends what waits instead.
   130	            // So does a chat the model is never asked to go on in by itself
   131	            // (a connection test, a title).
   132	            guard !queue.isEmpty || !steering.isEmpty else {
   133	                throw AgentError(AgentErrorCode.nothingToContinue, "There is nothing to resume; send a new message instead")
   134	            }
   135	            // Its receipt goes with the queue's release, in the same record:
   136	            // the same command sent again releases nothing twice.
   137	            commandState(Submission(commandID: commandID, turnID: receiptKey, text: ""), "completed")
   138	            do { try resumeQueue() } catch { commands.removeAll { $0["turnId"].text == receiptKey }; restoreCostPause(paused); throw error }
   139	            var reply: JSON = ["accepted": true, "continued": false, "resumedQueue": true]
   140	            if paused.paused { reply["resumedFamily"] = true; reply["pausedMembers"] = .array(members.map(JSON.string)) }
   141	            return reply
   142	        }
   143	        var submission = Submission(commandID: commandID, turnID: receiptKey, text: "")
   144	        submission.model = overrides["model"].text; submission.thinkingLevel = overrides["thinkingLevel"].text
   145	        submission.contextWindow = overrides["contextWindow"].int; submission.maxOutputTokens = overrides["maxOutputTokens"].int
   146	        submission.modelOutputLimit = overrides["modelOutputLimit"].int; submission.input = try NativeHostService.turnInput(overrides["input"])
   147	        _ = try profile.overriding(submission)
   148	        // The continuation's rows belong to the turn they continue.
   149	        let previous = (turn: currentTurnID, paused: queuePaused, message: errorMessage, code: errorCode)
   150	        if let turn = continuedTurn { currentTurnID = turn }
   151	        activeSubmission = submission; continuing = true; queuePaused = false; errorMessage = nil; errorCode = nil
   152	        familyWaitResume = !tailContinues
   153	        commandState(submission, "queued")
   154	        // Saved as a run under way, with its receipt: a helper that dies
   155	        // before the run's own first record leaves the chat interrupted, so
   156	        // it offers Resume again after the restart, never idle.
   157	        do { try persistState(active: true) } catch {
   158	            commands.removeAll { $0["turnId"].text == receiptKey }
   159	            activeSubmission = nil; continuing = false
   160	            currentTurnID = previous.turn; queuePaused = previous.paused; errorMessage = previous.message; errorCode = previous.code
   161	            restoreCostPause(paused)
   162	            throw error
   163	        }
   164	        launch()
   165	        var reply: JSON = ["accepted": true, "continued": true]
   166	        if paused.paused { reply["resumedFamily"] = true; reply["pausedMembers"] = .array(members.map(JSON.string)) }
   167	        return reply
   168	    }
   169	}
    75	    }
    76	    /// Resume after a cost-limit pause: the same turn, bound to the owner's
    77	    /// resumed execution. Its mirror records the continuation like the owner.
    78	    func resumeAgentTurn(_ turn: AgentChildTurn, owner: AgentSession, coordinator: AgentSteeringCoordinator) throws {
    79	        guard isSubagent, !closed, runTask == nil, subagents.origin?.link.budgetOwnerSessionID == owner.id,
    80	              let continuation = turn.continuations?.last else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
    81	        try journal?.promoteToSteering(managedChild:true)
    82	        // A mirror that missed earlier Resumes catches up one continuation at
    83	        // a time, as the owner recorded them.
    84	        var queued = turn; queued.status = .queued; queued.result = nil
    85	        if let saved = subagents.family?.turns[turn.id] {
    86	            for step in queued.mirrorSteps(from:saved) where step != saved { try appendAgentRecord(JournalRecordKind.agentTurnState,step) }
    87	        } else { try appendAgentRecord(JournalRecordKind.agentTurn,queued) }
    88	        budgetOwner = owner; budgetOwnerGeneration = continuation.generation
    89	        agentLease = turn; agentTurnClosed = false; agentCoordinator = coordinator
    90	        managedProgress = { [weak coordinator] in await coordinator?.progress(turn.target) }
    91	        queue.removeAll(); steering.removeAll(); queuePaused = false
    92	        managedCancellation = { Task { await coordinator.stop(owner:owner.id,target:turn.target,human:false) } }
    93	        if costPaused { costPaused = false; errorCode = nil; errorMessage = nil; try persistState() }
    94	    }
    95	    /// Whether this child's history already holds the turn's task: a resumed
    96	    /// turn then continues its run instead of being sent its task again.
    97	    func agentTurnBegan(_ turn: AgentChildTurn) -> Bool { history.contains { $0.id == turn.inputID } }
    98	    /// Continues a resumed turn from its context as it stands, like `run.continue`.
    99	    func continueAgentTurn(_ turn: AgentChildTurn) throws {
   100	        guard agentLease?.executionID == turn.executionID, !closed, runTask == nil else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
   101	        currentTurnID = turn.inputID; taskRootID = turn.inputID
   102	        activeSubmission = Submission(commandID:Self.continuePrefix + turn.executionID + ":" + String(turn.continuations?.count ?? 0),turnID:Self.continuePrefix + turn.inputID,text:"",thinkingLevel:turn.effort)
   103	        retrySubmission = nil; continuing = true; queuePaused = false; errorMessage = nil; errorCode = nil
   104	        try persistState(active:true)
   105	        launch()
   106	    }
   107	    /// The coordinator parked this turn at the owner's cost-limit pause.
   108	    func parkAgentTurn(_ turn: AgentChildTurn) throws {
   109	        guard isSubagent else { return }
   110	        endSubagentProgress()
   111	        if let saved = subagents.family?.turns[turn.id], saved.status != turn.status || saved.continuations != turn.continuations, !saved.status.terminal {
   112	            try appendAgentRecord(JournalRecordKind.agentTurnState,turn)
   113	        }
   114	        costPaused = true; queuePaused = true
   115	        if state != .error { state = .paused; runStatus = .cancelled }
   116	        errorCode = Self.costLimitCode; errorMessage = "Paused at the shared cost limit. It goes on when the main chat resumes."
   117	        try persistState(); event("state")
   118	    }
   119	    func startAgentTurn(_ turn: AgentChildTurn) throws {
   120	        guard agentLease?.executionID == turn.executionID, !closed else { throw SubagentRecovery.damaged() }
   121	        _ = try submitManaged(Submission(commandID:turn.executionID,turnID:turn.inputID,text:turn.task,thinkingLevel:turn.effort),steer:false)
   122	    }
   123	    func agentResult(_ turn: AgentChildTurn, plan: SubagentPlan, cancelled: Bool) -> SubagentToolResult {
   124	        let final = visible.last { $0.role == "assistant" && $0.taskRootID == turn.inputID && !$0.content.contains { $0["type"].text == "toolCall" } }
   125	        let status: SubagentStatus = cancelled || state == .paused || state == .stopping ? .interrupted : state == .error ? .failed : final?.stopReason == "length" ? .outputLimited : .completed

   232	    func park(_ job: Job, child: AgentSession?) async {

   251	    /// The owner paused at its family's cost limit (`AgentSession.stop` while
   252	    /// `costPaused`): stop running turns and park queued ones. Idempotent.
   253	    func pause(owner: AgentSession) async {
   254	        paused.insert(owner.id)
   255	        for job in Array(jobs.values) where job.owner === owner {
   256	            if job.allocated {
   257	                // Its runner parks the turn once the child's run has ended.
   258	                jobs[job.turn.id]?.task?.cancel()
   259	                if let child = job.child { await child.stop() }
   260	            } else if jobs[job.turn.id]?.task == nil {
   261	                await park(job,child:job.child)
   262	            }
   263	        }
   264	        await signal(owner.id).pulse()
   265	    }

   267	    /// current execution, in acceptance order, through the ordinary slots.
   268	    /// Turns parked across a relaunch are found in the journal, not memory.
   269	    func resumeParked(owner parent: AgentSession) async throws {
   270	        paused.remove(parent.id)

   291	    func finishJob(_ job: Job, child: AgentSession?) async {
   292	        let lock = gate(job.owner.id)
   293	        do {
   294	            try await lock.acquire()
   149	                let continued=continuing
   150	                continuing=false
   151	                if continued { try startAgentEpoch() }
   152	                // Resume after a cost-limit pause: parked sub-agent turns go on
   153	                // under this run's execution, before anything is asked again.
   154	                if resumingCostPause, !isSubagent {
   155	                    resumingCostPause=false
   156	                    try await agentCoordinator?.resumeParked(owner:self)
   157	                }
   158	                // Nothing of the parent's own was cut off: wait for the resumed
   159	                // family as the turn's end would, and ask the model only once
   160	                // something arrives for it.
   161	                var familyOnly=false
   162	                if familyWaitResume {
   163	                    familyWaitResume=false
   164	                    if let coordinator=agentCoordinator, try await coordinator.boundary(self,final:true) {} else { familyOnly=true }
   165	                }
   166	                // Pi's _overflowRecoveryAttempted: one compact-and-retry until a
   167	                // user message arrives or a reply completes.
   168	                var overflowRecoveryAttempted=retryFirstRequest && contextRecovery["consumed"].flag == true
   169	                var rounds=0
   170	                if familyOnly {
   171	                    try finishPresentedTask("completed")
   172	                    if let activeSubmission { commandState(activeSubmission,"completed") }; self.activeSubmission=nil
   173	                }
   174	                while !familyOnly {
   175	                    // Pi's agent loop has no limit on model requests per run.
   176	                    try Task.checkCancellation(); rounds += 1
   177	                    // Retry repeats the failed model request before pending steering
   178	                    // reaches its next complete model/tool boundary.
   179	                    let resumingFailedRequest=retryFirstRequest && rounds == 1
   180	                    // Each round makes a model request. At the chat's cost
   181	                    // limit it stops here, before pending steering is delivered.
   182	                    try enforceCostLimit()
   183	                    let humanDrained=resumingFailedRequest ? false : try await drainSteering()
   184	                    let agentDrained=resumingFailedRequest || agentCoordinator == nil ? false : try await agentCoordinator!.boundary(self,final:false)
   185	                    let drained = humanDrained || agentDrained
   186	                    if drained { overflowRecoveryAttempted=false }
   187	                    // A run started for pending input that delivered none (a
   188	                    // queued edit took the hold first, or the message left)
   189	                    // settles without asking the model about the old context.
   190	                    if rounds == 1, !retryFirstRequest, !continued, !startedFollowUp, !drained { break }
   191	                    // A resumed sub-agent turn that had already answered when
   192	                    // its family paused has nothing to ask the model again.
   193	                    if rounds == 1, continued, isSubagent, !drained, let tail=continuationTail, !Self.continues(from:tail) {
   194	                        try finishPresentedTask("completed")
   195	                        if let activeSubmission { commandState(activeSubmission,"completed") }; self.activeSubmission=nil
   196	                        break
   197	                    }
   198	                    let resourceSnapshot: ResourceSnapshot
   199	                    if let appliedSnapshot { resourceSnapshot=appliedSnapshot }
   200	                    else { resourceSnapshot=try await resources.resolve(); appliedSnapshot=resourceSnapshot }
    43	    /// (and restores `CostPauseState` if that fails). The next run resumes the
    44	    /// parked turns. Returns the sides the app resumes as well.
    45	    func endCostPause() -> [String] {
    46	        guard costPaused else { return [] }
    47	        costPaused = false; budgetStopIssued = false
    48	        if familyStopReason?.code == Self.costLimitCode { familyStopReason = nil }
    49	        if errorCode == Self.costLimitCode { errorCode = nil; errorMessage = nil }
    50	        resumingCostPause = hasParkedAgentTurns
    51	        let members = costPausedMembers; costPausedMembers = []
    52	        if let root = sideBudgetParents.last { let side = id; Task { await root.forgetPausedMember(side) } }
    53	        return members
    54	    }
    55	    struct CostPauseState { var paused: Bool, members: [String], reason: AgentError?, issued: Bool, code: String?, message: String? }
    56	    var costPauseState: CostPauseState { .init(paused:costPaused,members:costPausedMembers,reason:familyStopReason,issued:budgetStopIssued,code:errorCode,message:errorMessage) }
    57	    func restoreCostPause(_ saved: CostPauseState) {
    58	        costPaused = saved.paused; costPausedMembers = saved.members; familyStopReason = saved.reason
    59	        budgetStopIssued = saved.issued; errorCode = saved.code; errorMessage = saved.message
    60	        resumingCostPause = false; familyWaitResume = false
    61	    }
    47	    /// its run and its own sub-agents. Refused while the spend is at the limit.
    48	    func resumeCostPausedFamily(from item: ChatRecord) {
    49	        guard !installPreparing else { return }
    50	        // Unknown spend goes to the helper, which refuses at the limit.
    51	        guard !costReading(for: item.id).reached else {
    52	            displays[item.id]?.notice = "Still at the cost limit. Raise the limit above the spend, then choose Resume."
    53	            return
    54	        }
    55	        let root = budgetOwner(for: item)
    56	        latestVersion(sessionID: item.id)
    57	        var views: [SessionDisplay] = []
    58	        for view in [displays[root.id], displays[item.id]] { if let view, !views.contains(where: { $0 === view }) { views.append(view) } }
    59	        for view in views { view.resuming = true }
    60	        resumeSteps?("accepted")
    61	        Task {
    62	            defer { for view in views { view.resuming = false }; updateHostActivity(workspaceID: item.workspaceID) }
    63	            var members: [String] = []
    64	            if root.id == item.id || isCostPaused(root.id) {
    65	                guard let reply = await performResume(root, view: displays[root.id], member: root.id != item.id) else { return }
    66	                members = reply["pausedMembers"]?.array?.compactMap(\.string) ?? []
    67	            }
    68	            var order = members.filter { $0 != root.id }
    69	            if item.id != root.id, !order.contains(item.id) { order.append(item.id) }
    70	            for id in order {
    71	                guard let member = record(id), !member.isArchived, member.workspaceID == root.workspaceID else { continue }
    72	                _ = await performResume(member, view: displays[id], member: true)
    73	            }
    74	        }
    75	    }

        if operation != "subagent" {
            if accepted == false { return "Not accepted" }
            if heldByUser { return "Stopped by you" + ((operation == "subagent_start" ? summary?.turn ?? receiptTurn : receiptTurn).map { " · turn \($0)" } ?? "") }
            if let messageState {

                case "not_delivered_interrupted": return "Not delivered · interrupted"
                case "held": return "Pending for parent Resume"

            if route == "follow_up" { return "Follow-up accepted" + suffix }
            return "Accepted" + suffix
        }
        if summary?.pausedAtCostLimit == true { return "Paused at cost limit" }
        guard !status.terminal, status != .queued, status != .stopping else { return status.label }
        switch summary?.progress?.phase {
        case "retry": return "Retrying"
        case "compacting": return "Compacting"
        default: return status.label
        }
    }

extension HistoryReader {
    /// Match helper recovery's SubagentOrigin.matchesAccepted rule without
    /// dropping fields absent from the desktop's smaller SubagentHeader type.
    /// Older helpers omit optional model capabilities; no other origin field
    /// or explicit capability difference is compatible.
    static func subagentOriginMatchesAccepted(_ mirror: WireValue, accepted: WireValue?) -> Bool {
        guard let accepted, let owner = accepted.object, var child = mirror.object,
              let ownerModel = owner["model"]?.object, var childModel = child["model"]?.object else { return false }
        if childModel["reasoning"] == nil || childModel["reasoning"] == .null { childModel["reasoning"] = ownerModel["reasoning"] }
        child["model"] = .object(childModel)
        return .object(child) == accepted
    }

        case "pi-app.agent-operation.v1": row["data"]?.object?["plan"]?.object
        default: nil
        }

codex
The Resume lifecycle can strand or incorrectly terminate accepted child turns and leave paused sides behind. Tests were not run in the read-only environment.

Full review comments:

- [P1] Clear the coordinator pause even when no turns are parked — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/packages/swift-host/Sources/PiAgentCore/SessionContinue.swift:50-50
  If the parent's request reaches the limit after its children have completed, `stop()` still adds the owner to `AgentSteeringCoordinator.paused`. Here `hasParkedAgentTurns` is false, so `resumeParked()`—the only method removing that entry—is never called. The parent resumes, but subsequent `subagent_start` jobs remain queued forever because `pump()` still considers it paused. Clear the coordinator hold on every successful Resume, including the no-run path, to preserve the [family-Resume requirement](NEXT-RELEASE.md#L7).

- [P1] Finish parking old jobs before reopening family admission — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/packages/swift-host/Sources/PiAgentCore/AgentSteeringCoordinator.swift:270-273
  The parent now becomes resumable without waiting for its cancelled children. If Resume arrives while a child is still flushing or parking, its existing job excludes it from this snapshot. Clearing `paused` first then lets the old runner either seal it as interrupted or finish parking without any replacement job; the accepted turn never receives its continuation. Await completion of the pause before clearing the gate and collecting turns, as required by the [whole-family Resume contract](NEXT-RELEASE.md#L7).

- [P1] Determine child delivery from durable evidence — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/packages/swift-host/Sources/PiAgentCore/SessionAgentCommands.swift:95-97
  After a child compacts away its initial input, reopening from `JournalCheckpoint` loads only the retained history window. This check therefore returns false for an already-delivered task. The runner calls `startAgentTurn()` with the original input ID, which `validate()` rejects as `duplicate_turn` using the saved command receipt, and seals the child as interrupted instead of continuing it. Consult durable delivery evidence rather than the loaded window to satisfy the [resumption requirement](NEXT-RELEASE.md#L7).

- [P2] Preserve accepted but undelivered child input on Resume — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/packages/swift-host/Sources/PiAgentCore/SessionAgentCommands.swift:91-93
  If cancellation occurs after `submitManaged()` records the initial submission but before `deliver()` writes its user message, reopening restores that submission in the child's queue. Clearing it here leaves its command receipt intact. Since `agentTurnBegan()` is false, the runner resubmits the same identity and receives `duplicate_turn`, losing the resumable task. Preserve and release the already-accepted submission instead of submitting it again; the [release requirement](NEXT-RELEASE.md#L7) explicitly keeps unsealed work for Resume.

- [P2] Retain side membership until each side resumes — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/packages/swift-host/Sources/PiAgentCore/SessionContinue.swift:51-52
  This list is cleared and persisted before the app sends any side Resume commands. If the root reply is lost, the app exits during fan-out, or a side's Resume fails, the root has already forgotten that still-paused side. The duplicate-command response also omits `pausedMembers`, so retry/recovery cannot reconstruct the operation. Retain durable membership or a resumable fan-out intent until each side acknowledges resumption, preserving the [every-paused-side guarantee](NEXT-RELEASE.md#L7).

- [P2] Read the root's pause state before resuming a cold side — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/apps/macos/PiApp/Workspaces/WorkspaceResume.swift:64-66
  After relaunch, opening a nested paused side need not load its root's display or budget snapshot. `isCostPaused(root.id)` treats that unknown state as false, so this branch skips the root and resumes only the selected side. `performResume()` subsequently opens the root as a budget dependency, but never revisits the decision; the root and other paused sides remain held. Read authoritative root state before choosing the fan-out path so cold Resume honors the [whole-family requirement](NEXT-RELEASE.md#L7).

- [P2] Apply the final child boundary before the no-request exit — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/packages/swift-host/Sources/PiAgentCore/SessionRun.swift:193-196
  For a resumed child whose answer already exists, this exit bypasses `coordinator.boundary(final:true)`. Its turn remains unsealed while final request-link writes complete, so a concurrent `subagent_send` is accepted as steering for that turn. The child never polls again, and `seal()` marks the accepted message `not_delivered_interrupted`. Use the normal final boundary here so concurrent messages are either delivered before completion or routed to a follow-up turn.

- [P2] Validate Resume overrides before clearing pause state — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/packages/swift-host/Sources/PiAgentCore/SessionContinue.swift:108-110
  `endCostPause()` clears the pause and side membership before `turnInput()` and `profile.overriding()` validate the request. A Resume with an invalid override, such as an unsupported thinking level, throws without reaching either rollback handler. No work starts, but the runtime now reports `costPaused == false` and has forgotten its paused sides. Validate first or restore the saved pause state on every subsequent error, not only persistence failures.

- [P2] Restore paused sub-agent summaries during cold discovery — /Users/admin/Library/Caches/BelloSwiftWork/wt-limit-pause/packages/swift-host/Sources/PiAgentCore/SubagentTypes.swift:81-83
  This flag is populated by live coordinator listings, but `HistoryReader.discoverSubagents()` still reconstructs every unsealed turn as `.interrupted`, and `registerDiscoveredSubagent()` creates its summary without `costPaused`. Consequently, after a full app relaunch, paused children's cards and family rows show Interrupted until a helper starts; paused history does not automatically start one. Carry the persisted pause into cold discovery and retain the queued status so presentation preserves the [pause-across-relaunch requirement](NEXT-RELEASE.md#L7).
